#### File: ./client/src/components/OfferReportCard.tsx
```
import type { ReportCardReply } from '@shared/offers';

/**
 * The offer report card: how many offers have been graded, how many had a catch, and per store how they split.
 * Offers a parent audited are counted and marked "from a parent", so they never pass as Bundle's own checks.
 * All numbers come from the server (the same grades /api/offer-audit serves); this screen adds nothing.
 */
export default function OfferReportCard({ report }: { report: ReportCardReply }) {
  const graded = report.brands.reduce((a, b) => a + (b.offersChecked ?? 0), 0);
  const caught = report.brands.reduce((a, b) => a + (b.offersCaught ?? 0), 0);
  const anyCaughtKnown = report.brands.some((b) => b.offersCaught !== null);
  const parents = report.fromParents;
  return (
    <section aria-label="Offer report card" data-testid="offer-report-card" className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper p-4">
      <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">Offer report card</p>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] font-bold leading-snug text-ink">
        We’ve graded {graded} offer{graded === 1 ? '' : 's'}{parents > 0 ? ` (${parents} from ${parents === 1 ? 'a parent' : 'parents'})` : ''}.
        {anyCaughtKnown ? ` ${caught} had a catch.` : ''}
      </p>
      <ul className="mt-3 space-y-3">
        {report.brands.map((b) => {
          const total = b.offersChecked ?? 0;
          const bad = b.offersCaught ?? 0;
          return (
            <li key={b.store} className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.4fr)_auto] items-center gap-3 text-[14px]">
              <span className="min-w-0">
                <span className="block font-bold text-ink">{b.store}</span>
                {b.fromParents > 0 && <span className="mt-0.5 inline-flex rounded-full bg-[#FBEBCB] px-2 py-0.5 text-[11.5px] font-bold text-[#7A5410]">from a parent</span>}
              </span>
              {b.offersCaught !== null && total > 0 ? (
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#F1ECE4]">
                  <span className="bg-[#1E8E5A]" style={{ width: `${((total - bad) / total) * 100}%` }} />
                  <span className="bg-[#E0A52B]" style={{ width: `${(bad / total) * 100}%` }} />
                </span>
              ) : <span />}
              <span className="text-right font-semibold text-ink-2">{total} graded</span>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
      {anyCaughtKnown && <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] text-ink-2">Green approved · amber had a catch or was blocked</p>}
    </section>
  );
}

import type { BundleReceipt } from '@shared/bundle';
import { daysUntil, fmtUsdShort } from '@/lib/bundle';

/** Shown instead of "all clear" when no item was checked (no purchases connected, or the Recall Checker could not run). */
export const NOT_CHECKED_TEXT = 'Connect your data to safety-check items';

interface Props {
  receipt: BundleReceipt;
  /** Verified recall cards in this feed (0 = all clear). */
  recallCount: number;
  today?: string;
}

/** The Bundle Receipt: money back, benefits you likely qualify for, deadlines and items safety-checked. */
export default function ReceiptCard({ receipt, recallCount, today }: Props) {
  const next = receipt.nextDeadline ? daysUntil(receipt.nextDeadline, today) : null;
  const nextText = next === null ? null : next <= 0 ? 'next is today' : next === 1 ? 'next in 1 day' : `next in ${next} days`;
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="receipt-title">
      <h2 id="receipt-title" className="eyebrow mt-5 text-ink-2">Your Bundle Receipt</h2>
      <div className="bundle-card mt-2 p-5">
        <p data-testid="receipt-money-back" className="tabular text-[48px] font-extrabold leading-none tracking-[-0.04em] text-coral">
          {fmtUsdShort(receipt.moneyBackCents)}
        </p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] font-bold text-ink">money back</p>
        <p className="text-[14px] text-ink-2">Refunds and price adjustments to claim</p>

        <div className="my-4 border-t border-dashed border-line" />

        <p data-testid="receipt-benefits" className="tabular text-[34px] font-extrabold leading-none tracking-[-0.03em] text-ink">
          {fmtUsdShort(receipt.likelyBenefitsCents)}
        </p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] font-bold text-ink">in benefits you likely qualify for</p>
        <p className="text-[14px] text-ink-2">Credits and payments from official programs</p>

        <div className="my-4 border-t border-dashed border-line" />

        <dl className="space-y-2 text-[15px]">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <dt className="font-semibold text-ink">{receipt.deadlineCount} {receipt.deadlineCount === 1 ? 'deadline' : 'deadlines'}</dt>
            <dd className="font-bold text-coral-deep">{nextText ?? 'none coming up'}</dd>
          </div>
          {receipt.itemsChecked === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <dt className="font-semibold text-ink">Safety check</dt>
              <dd data-testid="receipt-safety" className="text-right font-bold text-ink-2">{NOT_CHECKED_TEXT}</dd>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <dt className="font-semibold text-ink">{receipt.itemsChecked} {receipt.itemsChecked === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'} safety-checked</dt>
              <dd data-testid="receipt-safety" className={recallCount > 0 ? 'font-bold text-kind-recall' : 'font-bold text-kind-clawback'}>
                {recallCount > 0 ? `${recallCount} ${recallCount === 1 ? 'recall' : 'recalls'}` : 'all clear'}
              </dd>
            </div>
          )}
        </dl>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

  amountCents: 2899,
  deadline: null,
  verdict: 'likely',
  sources: [
    { label: 'IRS Publication 502', url: 'https://www.irs.gov/publications/p502' },
    { label: 'Store receipt', url: 'https://example.com/receipt' },
  ],

  });

  });

    expect(screen.queryByText('money back')).toBeNull();
  });
});

});

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';

export const MADE_UP_DETAILS_NOTICE = 'Please use made-up details only — this is a test app.';

type GateState = 'checking' | 'open' | 'locked';

function gateHinted(): boolean {
  try { return /(?:^|;\s*)bundle_gate=on(?:;|$)/.test(document.cookie); } catch { return false; }
}

/**
 * Tester entry screen. Asks the server once whether a tester code is needed (only on the web host, where
 * TESTER_ACCESS_CODE is set). If it is and this phone hasn't typed it yet, shows one field; the server then remembers
 * this phone with a cookie, so every later request just works. On the laptop no code is set and the app opens directly.
 */
export default function TesterGate({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  // The server leaves a "bundle_gate=on" cookie on the page when a code is set. Without it (laptop) the app opens at once.
  const [state, setState] = useState<GateState>(() => (gateHinted() ? 'checking' : 'open'));
  // Tester mode = the site has a code (web host). Then a slim "made-up details" line stays above every screen.
  const [testerMode, setTesterMode] = useState<boolean>(() => gateHinted());

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    if (typeof fetch !== 'function') { setState('open'); return; }
    fetch('/api/tester-access', { credentials: 'same-origin' })
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((s: { required?: boolean; ok?: boolean } | null) => {
        if (!live) return;
        setTesterMode(Boolean(s?.required));
        setState(s && s.required && !s.ok ? 'locked' : 'open');
      })
      // Can't reach the server: let the app show its own "couldn't reach Bundle" screens rather than a gate.
      .catch(() => { if (live) setState('open'); });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, []);

  if (state === 'open') return testerMode ? <><TestNoticeLine />{children}</> : <>{children}</>;
  if (state === 'checking') return <div className="min-h-[100dvh] bg-cream" aria-busy="true" />;
  return <GateScreen onUnlocked={() => setState('open')} />;
}

/**
 * The persistent reminder while testing: one slim line in the normal page flow at the very top (not floating), so it
 * never covers a button and scrolls away with the page.
 */
export function TestNoticeLine() {
  return (
    <p
      role="note"
      data-testid="made-up-line"
      className="w-full bg-coral-tint px-4 py-1.5 text-center text-[12px] font-semibold leading-snug text-ink-2"
    >
      {MADE_UP_DETAILS_NOTICE}
    </p>
  );
}

export function GateScreen({ onUnlocked }: { onUnlocked: () => void }) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!code.trim() || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/tester-access', {
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ code: code.trim() }),
      });
      if (r.ok) return onUnlocked();
      const body = (await r.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string };
      setError(body.error || 'That code didn’t work. Please try again.');
    } catch {
      setError('We couldn’t reach Bundle. Check your connection and try again.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-[100dvh] bg-cream text-ink">
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[480px] px-5 pt-5 pb-10" aria-labelledby="gate-title">
        <span className="text-[26px] font-extrabold tracking-[-0.03em]">bundle<span className="text-coral">.</span></span>
        <h1 id="gate-title" className="mt-10 text-[28px] font-extrabold leading-tight tracking-[-0.02em]">Welcome, tester</h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] text-ink-2">Bundle is in testing. Enter the tester code you were sent to start.</p>

        <p
          role="note"
          data-testid="made-up-notice"
          className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border-2 border-coral bg-coral-tint px-4 py-3 text-[15px] font-bold leading-snug text-ink"
        >
          {MADE_UP_DETAILS_NOTICE}
        </p>

        <label htmlFor="tester-code" className="mt-6 block text-[15px] font-bold">Enter the tester code you were sent</label>
        <input
          id="tester-code"
          name="tester-code"
          type="text"
          autoComplete="off"
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoCorrect="off"
          spellCheck={false}
          value={code}
          onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
          className="mt-2 block min-h-[56px] w-full rounded-2xl border-2 border-line bg-paper px-4 text-[18px] text-ink outline-none focus:border-ink"
        />
        {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-[15px] font-bold text-kind-recall">{error}</p>}

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={busy || !code.trim()}
          className="mt-5 flex min-h-[56px] w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-ink text-[17px] font-bold text-cream disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {busy ? 'Checking…' : 'Start testing'}
        </button>
        <p className="mt-4 text-[14px] text-ink-3">No code? Ask the person who sent you the link.</p>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, cleanup, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import TesterGate, { MADE_UP_DETAILS_NOTICE } from '../TesterGate';

type Reply = { status: number; body: unknown };

function mockFetch(replies: Record<string, Reply[]>) {
  const calls: { url: string; init?: RequestInit }[] = [];
  (global as any).fetch = jest.fn(async (url: string, init?: RequestInit) => {
    calls.push({ url, init });
    const key = `${init?.method || 'GET'} ${url}`;
    const r = replies[key]?.shift();
    if (!r) throw new Error(`no reply for ${key}`);
    return { ok: r.status < 400, status: r.status, json: async () => r.body } as Response;
  });
  return calls;
}

afterEach(() => { cleanup(); delete (global as any).fetch; document.cookie = 'bundle_gate=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/'; });

describe('TesterGate', () => {
  it('opens the app straight away when no tester code is needed (laptop)', async () => {
    mockFetch({ 'GET /api/tester-access': [{ status: 200, body: { required: false, ok: true } }] });
    render(<TesterGate><p>the app</p></TesterGate>);
    expect(await screen.findByText('the app')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText('Enter the tester code you were sent')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('made-up-line')).toBeNull(); // no tester mode on the laptop
  });

  it('opens the app when this phone already typed the code', async () => {
    mockFetch({ 'GET /api/tester-access': [{ status: 200, body: { required: true, ok: true } }] });
    render(<TesterGate><p>the app</p></TesterGate>);
    expect(await screen.findByText('the app')).toBeTruthy();
    expect((await screen.findByTestId('made-up-line')).textContent).toBe(MADE_UP_DETAILS_NOTICE); // stays visible in tester mode
  });

  it('shows the one-field gate with the made-up-details notice when a code is needed', async () => {
    mockFetch({ 'GET /api/tester-access': [{ status: 200, body: { required: true, ok: false } }] });
    render(<TesterGate><p>the app</p></TesterGate>);
    expect(await screen.findByLabelText('Enter the tester code you were sent')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('made-up-notice').textContent).toBe(MADE_UP_DETAILS_NOTICE);
    expect(screen.queryByText('the app')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('shows the server message on a wrong code, then opens the app on the right one', async () => {
    const calls = mockFetch({
      'GET /api/tester-access': [{ status: 200, body: { required: true, ok: false } }],
      'POST /api/tester-access': [
        { status: 401, body: { error: 'That code didn’t work.' } },
        { status: 200, body: { ok: true } },
      ],
    });
    render(<TesterGate><p>the app</p></TesterGate>);
    const input = await screen.findByLabelText('Enter the tester code you were sent');
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'wrong' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start testing' }));
    expect((await screen.findByRole('alert')).textContent).toBe('That code didn’t work.');
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: ' right ' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start testing' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('the app')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('made-up-line').textContent).toBe(MADE_UP_DETAILS_NOTICE); // still shown after unlocking
    const posts = calls.filter((c) => c.init?.method === 'POST');
    expect(JSON.parse(String(posts[1].init?.body))).toEqual({ code: 'right' });
  });

  it('does not block the app when the server cannot be reached', async () => {
    (global as any).fetch = jest.fn(async () => { throw new Error('offline'); });
    render(<TesterGate><p>the app</p></TesterGate>);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('the app')).toBeTruthy());
  });

  it('when the site says a gate is on, the app is not shown before the check finishes', async () => {
    document.cookie = 'bundle_gate=on; path=/';
    mockFetch({ 'GET /api/tester-access': [{ status: 200, body: { required: true, ok: false } }] });
    render(<TesterGate><p>the app</p></TesterGate>);
    expect(screen.queryByText('the app')).toBeNull();
    expect(await screen.findByLabelText('Enter the tester code you were sent')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('with no gate note and no fetch available, the app shows immediately', () => {
    delete (global as any).fetch;
    render(<TesterGate><p>the app</p></TesterGate>);
    expect(screen.getByText('the app')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { fetchLocker, forgetMyItems, type Locker, type LockerItem } from '@/lib/photoPrep';
import { ForgetItemsCard } from '@/pages/tabs/Extras';
import { useFreezeSpot } from '@/lib/scrollSpot';
import { useScan } from './ScanContext';
import { ScanButton } from './ScanButtons';
import { LockerReceiptRow, RecallLine, Thumb } from './ResultCards';
import { dismissPhoto, fetchPendingPhotos, retryPhoto, type PhotoStatusView } from './photoJob';

type Load = { s: 'loading' } | { s: 'error'; message: string } | { s: 'ready'; locker: Locker };

/** Loads the family's locker, and again whenever something is saved or forgotten (the scan context's version goes up). */
export function useLocker(familyId: string): Load & { reload: () => void } {
  const { version } = useScan();
  const [state, setState] = useState<Load>({ s: 'loading' });
  const [n, setN] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    fetchLocker(familyId)
      .then((locker) => { if (live) setState({ s: 'ready', locker }); })
      .catch((e) => { if (live) setState({ s: 'error', message: (e as Error).message }); });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [familyId, version, n]);
  return { ...state, reload: useCallback(() => setN((x) => x + 1), []) };
}

const total = (l: Locker) => l.items.length + l.receipts.length;

/** Photos still being read, or stopped with a message. Checks again every few seconds while any is still reading. */
export function usePendingPhotos(familyId: string, pollMs = 4000): { photos: PhotoStatusView[]; reload: () => void } {
  const { version } = useScan();
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<PhotoStatusView[]>([]);
  const [n, setN] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    const load = async () => {
      const list = await fetchPendingPhotos(familyId);
      if (!live) return;
      setPhotos(list);
      if (list.some((p) => p.status === 'reading')) timer = setTimeout(() => setN((x) => x + 1), pollMs);
    };
    void load();
    return () => { live = false; if (timer) clearTimeout(timer); };
  }, [familyId, version, n, pollMs]);
  return { photos, reload: useCallback(() => setN((x) => x + 1), []) };
}

function PendingRow({ p, familyId, onChange }: { p: PhotoStatusView; familyId: string; onChange: () => void }) {
  const { openScan, track } = useScan();
  const what = p.kind === 'receipt' ? 'receipt' : 'gear photo';
  if (p.status === 'reading') {
    return (
      <li className="flex items-start gap-3 py-3" data-testid="photo-reading">
        <Thumb src={p.thumbnail} alt={`Your ${what}, being read`} kind={p.kind === 'receipt' ? 'receipt' : 'gear'} />
        <div className="min-w-0 grow" role="status">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[16px] font-extrabold leading-snug">
            <span className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-line border-t-coral" aria-hidden="true" /> Reading…
          </p>
          <p className="text-[13.5px] leading-snug text-ink-2">{p.message ?? `We're reading your ${what}. It appears here when it's done.`}</p>
        </div>
      </li>
    );
  }
  const retry = async () => {
    if (!p.canRetry) { openScan(); return; }
    const out = await retryPhoto(familyId, p.photoId).catch(() => 'retake' as const);
    if (out === 'retake') openScan(); else track(familyId, p.photoId);
    onChange();
  };
  const remove = async () => { await dismissPhoto(familyId, p.photoId).catch(() => undefined); onChange(); };
  return (
    <li className="flex items-start gap-3 py-3" data-testid="photo-problem-row">
      <Thumb src={p.thumbnail} alt={`Your ${what}`} kind={p.kind === 'receipt' ? 'receipt' : 'gear'} />
      <div className="min-w-0 grow">
        <p className="text-[16px] font-extrabold leading-snug text-[#8A5B00]">Couldn’t read this one</p>
        <p className="text-[14px] leading-snug text-ink-2">{p.message}</p>
        <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2">
          <button type="button" onClick={retry} className="min-h-[44px] rounded-xl bg-ink px-3 text-[14px] font-bold text-cream">{p.canRetry ? 'Try again' : 'Take a new photo'}</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={remove} className="min-h-[44px] px-2 text-[14px] font-bold text-ink underline underline-offset-4">Remove</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

function GearRow({ item }: { item: LockerItem & { manufacturedOn?: string | null; lotCode?: string | null } }) {
  return (
    <li className="flex items-start gap-3 py-3">
      <Thumb src={item.thumbnail} alt={`Photo of ${item.productName}`} kind="gear" />
      <div className="min-w-0 grow">
        <p className="text-[16px] font-extrabold leading-snug">{item.productName}</p>
        {(item.modelNumber || item.brand) && <p className="text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">{[item.brand, item.modelNumber ? `Model ${item.modelNumber}` : null, item.manufacturedOn ? `Made ${item.manufacturedOn}` : null, item.lotCode ? `Lot ${item.lotCode}` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}</p>}
        {item.recall && <div className="mt-1.5"><RecallLine recall={item.recall} compact /></div>}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

/** The Gear Locker page: every gear item and receipt saved for this family, with a scan button and the privacy line. */
export function GearLockerView({ familyId }: { familyId: string }) {
  useFreezeSpot(); // the tab's scroll spot is kept while the locker is open, and the page returns to it on Back
  const { closeLocker, bump } = useScan();
  const load = useLocker(familyId);
  const pending = usePendingPhotos(familyId);
  const locker = load.s === 'ready' ? load.locker : null;
  const busy = pending.photos;
  return (
    // The "Gear locker" region appears once the locker has loaded, so a screen reader never lands on an empty one.
    <Shell ready={load.s === 'ready'}>
      <button type="button" onClick={closeLocker} className="-ml-1 flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-1 px-1 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink"><span aria-hidden="true">‹</span> Back</button>
      <h1 className="mt-1 text-[30px] font-extrabold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-0.03em]">Your gear locker</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">We check each item against official recall lists.</p>
      {load.s === 'loading' && <p role="status" className="mt-4 text-[15px] text-ink-2">Opening your locker…</p>}
      {load.s === 'error' && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-[#FBE3E0] px-3 py-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-[#9E2A21]">{load.message}</p>}
      {locker && total(locker) === 0 && busy.length === 0 && <EmptyLocker />}
      {locker && total(locker) + busy.length > 0 && (
        <div className="bundle-card mt-4 px-4">
          <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
            {busy.map((p) => <PendingRow key={`p-${p.photoId}`} p={p} familyId={familyId} onChange={() => { pending.reload(); bump(); }} />)}
            {locker.items.map((it, i) => <GearRow key={`${it.id ?? 'x'}-${i}`} item={it} />)}
            {locker.receipts.map((r) => <LockerReceiptRow key={`r-${r.photoId}`} r={r} />)}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
      {locker && total(locker) + busy.length > 0 && <ScanButton className="mt-4" />}
      <ForgetItemsCard familyId={familyId} forget={async (id) => { const n = await forgetMyItems(id); bump(); return n; }} />
    </Shell>
  );
}

function Shell({ ready, children }: { ready: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return ready
    ? <section aria-label="Gear locker" data-testid="gear-locker" className="mt-2">{children}</section>
    : <div data-testid="gear-locker-loading" className="mt-2">{children}</div>;
}

function EmptyLocker() {
  return (
    <div className="mt-4">
      <p className="bundle-card p-4 text-[15px] leading-snug text-ink-2" data-testid="locker-empty">No gear yet — scan a car seat sticker or a receipt to start.</p>
      <ScanButton className="mt-3 !bg-coral" />
    </div>
  );
}

/** "Brand Product", without saying the brand twice when the product name already starts with it. */
const gearTitle = (it: LockerItem) => (it.brand && !it.productName.toLowerCase().startsWith(it.brand.toLowerCase()) ? `${it.brand} ${it.productName}` : it.productName);

/** Savings tab: every scanned gear item, so a clean result (no recall, no money back) is still shown, not swallowed. */
function InspectedGear({ items }: { items: LockerItem[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="mt-3" data-testid="inspected-gear">
      <p className="text-[15px] font-extrabold">Inspected nursery gear</p>
      <ul className="mt-1 divide-y divide-line">
        {items.map((it, i) => {
          const details = [it.modelNumber ? `Model: ${it.modelNumber}` : null, it.upc ? `UPC: ${it.upc}` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
          return (
            <li key={`${it.id ?? 'x'}-${i}`} className="flex items-start gap-3 py-3" data-testid="inspected-item">
              <Thumb src={it.thumbnail} alt={`Photo of ${it.productName}`} kind="gear" />
              <div className="min-w-0 grow">
                <p className="text-[16px] font-extrabold leading-snug">{gearTitle(it)}</p>
                {details && <p className="text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">{details}</p>}
                {/* "No recalls found", never "Verified Safe" (round 3 R7): an empty recall list is not a safety test. */}
                {it.recall?.found !== false
                  ? it.recall && <div className="mt-1.5"><RecallLine recall={it.recall} compact /></div>
                  : <span data-testid="no-recalls" className="mt-1.5 inline-block rounded-full bg-[#E3F3EA] px-2.5 py-1 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-[#17643F]">✓ No recalls found · 0 recalls{it.recall?.source ? ` on ${it.recall.source}` : ''}</span>}
              </div>
            </li>

}

/** A small locker card for the Savings tab (and the Account tab): how many things are saved, "Open ›", or the empty state with a scan button. `list` also names each gear item (the Account tab uses it); `inspected` shows each item with its recall result (the Savings tab uses it). */

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { LockerReceipt, RecallInfo, ScannedItem } from '@/lib/photoPrep';
import { CheckIcon, GearIcon, ReceiptIcon, ShieldCheckIcon } from './icons';

/** "Oct 25, 2026" from "2026-10-25" (no time zone shifts). */
export function prettyDate(iso: string | null | undefined): string {
  const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(iso ?? '');
  if (!m) return '';
  return new Date(Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3])).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });
}

const nf = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString('en-US');
const listName = (r: RecallInfo) => (r.source === 'NHTSA' ? 'NHTSA car-seat recalls' : 'CPSC recalls');

/** The recall answer. Never "safe": "No recalls found" only when a real check ran; otherwise a possible match or a plain "not checked". */
export function RecallLine({ recall, compact = false }: { recall: RecallInfo; compact?: boolean }) {
  if (recall.found === true) {
    return (
      <div role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-[#E7B3A9] bg-[#FBE3E0] px-3 py-2.5 text-[14.5px] text-[#7A1F17]" data-testid="recall-found">
        <p><b>Possible recall.</b> This looks like a product on the {recall.source} list. Check the notice, and stop using it if it is the same product.</p>
        <ul className="mt-1.5 space-y-1.5">
          {(recall.matches ?? []).map((m) => (
            <li key={m.id}>
              <span className="font-semibold">{m.title}</span>{m.recallDate ? ` (${prettyDate(m.recallDate)})` : ''}
              {m.url && <> <a href={m.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="font-bold underline underline-offset-2">Read the notice →</a></>}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (recall.found === null) {
    return (
      <p className="rounded-xl bg-[#F1ECE4] px-3 py-2.5 text-[14px] leading-snug text-ink-2" data-testid="recall-unchecked">
        <b className="text-ink">Not checked for recalls.</b> {recall.note ?? 'The recall list could not be reached.'}
      </p>
    );
  }
  const checked = recall.recordsChecked != null ? `Checked against ${nf(recall.recordsChecked)} ${listName(recall)}.` : `Checked the ${recall.source} recall list.`;
  if (compact) {
    return (
      <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-[13.5px] font-semibold leading-snug text-[#17643F]">
        <span className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"><ShieldCheckIcon size={15} /></span>
        <span><b>No recalls found</b> · {checked.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + checked.slice(1)}</span>
      </p>
    );
  }
  return (
    <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#E3F3EA] px-3 py-2.5 text-[15px] leading-snug text-[#17643F]">
      <span className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"><ShieldCheckIcon size={16} /></span>
      <span><b>No recalls found</b> as of {prettyDate(recall.checkedOn)}. {checked}</span>
    </p>
  );
}

export const SampleBadge = () => <span className="rounded-full bg-[#FBF0D3] px-2 py-0.5 text-[11.5px] font-extrabold text-[#8A5B00]">Sample</span>;

/** The little picture: the saved thumbnail, or a drawn stand-in. */
export function Thumb({ src, alt, kind }: { src?: string | null; alt: string; kind: 'gear' | 'receipt' }) {
  return (
    <span className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-[#FCE9E1] text-coral-deep">
      {src ? <img src={src} alt={alt} className="h-full w-full object-cover" /> : kind === 'gear' ? <GearIcon /> : <ReceiptIcon />}
    </span>
  );
}

export function SampleNote() {
  return (
    <p role="note" className="mb-3 rounded-xl border border-[#EBD9A6] bg-[#FBF0D3] px-3 py-2 text-[13.5px] leading-snug text-[#6B4A00]" data-testid="sample-note">
      <b>Practice mode.</b> There is no photo-reading key here, so this answer is a made-up sample, not read from your photo.
    </p>
  );
}

const joinDot = (parts: ReactNode[]) => parts.filter(Boolean).flatMap((p, i) => (i ? [<span key={`d${i}`} aria-hidden="true"> · </span>, p] : [p]));

/** Result of a gear photo. */
export function GearResult({ item, thumbnail, sample, already }: { item: ScannedItem; thumbnail?: string | null; sample?: boolean; already?: boolean }) {
  const reg = item.recall?.registerUrl;
  return (
    <article aria-label={item.productName} className="rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#1E8A5A] bg-paper p-4" data-testid="gear-result">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
        <Thumb src={thumbnail} alt={`Photo of ${item.productName}`} kind="gear" />
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h3 className="text-[17px] font-extrabold leading-snug">{item.productName}</h3>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
            {joinDot([
              item.modelNumber ? <span key="m">Model {item.modelNumber}</span> : null,
              item.upc ? <span key="u">UPC {item.upc}</span> : null,
              typeof item.manufacturedOn === 'string' && item.manufacturedOn ? <span key="d">Made {item.manufacturedOn}</span> : null,
              item.lotCode ? <span key="l">Lot {item.lotCode}</span> : null,
            ])}
            {sample && <> <SampleBadge /></>}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      {item.recall && <div className="mt-3"><RecallLine recall={item.recall} /></div>}
      {item.recall && item.recall.found !== null && item.recall.note && <p className="mt-2 text-[14px] leading-snug text-ink-2" data-testid="recall-note">{item.recall.note}</p>}
      {!item.manufacturedOn && item.recall?.found !== true && (
        <p className="mt-2 text-[13.5px] leading-snug text-ink-2" data-testid="no-date-tip">We couldn’t read the date made. Recalls often cover only some dates, so check the sticker for it.</p>
      )}
      {reg && (
        <p className="mt-3 text-[15px]">
          <a href={reg} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="font-bold text-coral-deep underline underline-offset-2">Register it with {item.brand || 'the maker'} →</a>
          <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">This is how you’d hear about a future recall.</span>
        </p>
      )}
      <p className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[15px] font-bold text-[#17643F]"><CheckIcon size={18} /> {already ? 'Already in your gear locker.' : 'Saved to your gear locker.'}</p>
    </article>
  );
}

/** Result of a receipt photo: one card with every line, its money-back check and its recall check. */
export function ReceiptResult({ items, store, purchasedOn, thumbnail, sample, already }: { items: ScannedItem[]; store?: string | null; purchasedOn?: string | null; thumbnail?: string | null; sample?: boolean; already?: boolean }) {
  const title = `Receipt · ${items.length} ${items.length === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}`;
  return (
    <article aria-label={title} className="rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#1E8A5A] bg-paper p-4" data-testid="receipt-result">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Thumb src={thumbnail} alt="Photo of your receipt" kind="receipt" />
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h3 className="text-[17px] font-extrabold leading-snug">{title}</h3>
          <p className="text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
            {joinDot([store ? <span key="s">{store}</span> : null, purchasedOn ? <span key="d">{prettyDate(purchasedOn)}</span> : null])}
            {sample && <> <SampleBadge /></>}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <ul className="mt-3 divide-y divide-line border-t border-line">
        {items.map((it, i) => (
          <li key={`${it.productName}-${i}`} className="py-3">
            <p className="text-[16px] font-bold leading-snug">{it.productName}</p>
            {it.fsaEligible !== undefined && (
              <p className={`mt-1.5 inline-block rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[13px] font-bold ${it.fsaEligible ? 'bg-[#E3F3EA] text-[#17643F]' : 'bg-[#FBF0D3] text-[#8A5B00]'}`}>
                {it.fsaEligible ? `${it.fsaAccount === 'HSA' ? 'HSA' : 'FSA'}-eligible: claim it back from your ${it.fsaAccount === 'HSA' ? 'HSA' : 'FSA'}` : 'No money back found'}
              </p>

            {it.recall && <div className="mt-1.5"><RecallLine recall={it.recall} compact /></div>}

        ))}
      </ul>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">Only items on the official FSA/HSA list are flagged. Price drops are checked when you run your check again.</p>
      <p className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[15px] font-bold text-[#17643F]"><CheckIcon size={18} /> {already ? 'Already in your gear locker.' : 'Saved to your gear locker.'}</p>
    </article>
  );
}

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { doneNotice, pollPhoto, type PhotoStatusView } from './photoJob';

/** A "your photo is read" note shown once a background read finishes. */
export interface PhotoNotice { photoId: number; text: string; ok: boolean }

/** What the scan entry points (Home card, header Scan button, Savings card, empty locker, Home's "Add a receipt") share. */
export interface ScanApi {
  /** Opens the "What are you scanning?" sheet. */
  openScan: () => void;
  closeScan: () => void;
  sheetOpen: boolean;
  /** Opens the Gear Locker page. */
  openLocker: () => void;
  closeLocker: () => void;
  lockerOpen: boolean;
  /** Goes up by one every time something is saved or forgotten, so the locker reloads. */
  version: number;
  bump: () => void;
  /** Background reading: keep checking this photo until it is read, then show a notice and reload the locker. */
  track: (familyId: string, photoId: number) => void;
  /** The latest known state of a tracked photo. */
  photos: Record<number, PhotoStatusView>;
  /** Finished reads the parent has not looked at yet (badge + note). */
  notices: PhotoNotice[];
  clearNotices: () => void;
}

const NONE: ScanApi = {
  openScan: () => {}, closeScan: () => {}, sheetOpen: false, openLocker: () => {}, closeLocker: () => {}, lockerOpen: false, version: 0, bump: () => {},
  track: () => {}, photos: {}, notices: [], clearNotices: () => {},
};
const Ctx = createContext<ScanApi>(NONE);

export const useScan = (): ScanApi => useContext(Ctx);

/** Owns the open/closed state of the scan sheet and the locker page. VersionB mounts the sheet and the locker page itself. */
export function ScanProvider({ children, pollMs = 3000 }: { children: ReactNode; pollMs?: number }) {
  const [sheetOpen, setSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [lockerOpen, setLockerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(0);
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<Record<number, PhotoStatusView>>({});
  const [notices, setNotices] = useState<PhotoNotice[]>([]);
  const stops = useRef(new Map<number, () => void>());
  useEffect(() => () => { stops.current.forEach((s) => s()); stops.current.clear(); }, []);

  const openScan = useCallback(() => setSheetOpen(true), []);
  const closeScan = useCallback(() => setSheetOpen(false), []);
  const openLocker = useCallback(() => { setSheetOpen(false); setLockerOpen(true); setNotices([]); window.scrollTo?.({ top: 0 }); }, []);
  const closeLocker = useCallback(() => setLockerOpen(false), []);
  const bump = useCallback(() => setVersion((v) => v + 1), []);
  const clearNotices = useCallback(() => setNotices([]), []);
  const track = useCallback((familyId: string, photoId: number) => {
    if (stops.current.has(photoId)) return;
    const stop = pollPhoto(familyId, photoId, {
      onUpdate: (v) => setPhotos((p) => ({ ...p, [photoId]: v })),
      onDone: (v) => {
        stops.current.delete(photoId);
        setNotices((n) => [...n.filter((x) => x.photoId !== photoId), { photoId, text: doneNotice(v), ok: v.status === 'done' }]);
        setVersion((x) => x + 1);
      },
      onGone: () => { stops.current.delete(photoId); },
    }, pollMs);
    stops.current.set(photoId, stop);
  }, [pollMs]);

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({ openScan, closeScan, sheetOpen, openLocker, closeLocker, lockerOpen, version, bump, track, photos, notices, clearNotices }),
    [openScan, closeScan, sheetOpen, openLocker, closeLocker, lockerOpen, version, bump, track, photos, notices, clearNotices],
  );
  const latest = notices[notices.length - 1];
  return (
    <Ctx.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      {latest && !sheetOpen && !lockerOpen && (
        <div role="status" aria-live="polite" data-testid="photo-notice"
          className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-4 z-40 mx-auto flex w-[calc(100%-32px)] max-w-[448px] items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-ink px-4 py-3 text-cream shadow-2xl">
          <p className="grow text-[15px] font-semibold leading-snug">{latest.text}</p>
          <button type="button" onClick={openLocker} className="min-h-[44px] shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-coral px-3 text-[14px] font-bold text-cream">Open</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={clearNotices} aria-label="Dismiss" className="min-h-[44px] shrink-0 px-1 text-[20px] leading-none">×</button>
        </div>
      )}
    </Ctx.Provider>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ChangeEvent } from 'react';
import { checkPickedFile, preparePhoto, type PhotoReadResponse } from '@/lib/photoPrep';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useScan } from './ScanContext';
import { CameraIcon, CheckIcon, GearIcon, ReceiptIcon } from './icons';
import { GearResult, ReceiptResult, SampleNote } from './ResultCards';
import { CAPTURE_TIP, EXAMPLES, STROLLER_TIP, retryPhoto, startPhoto, type StartResponse } from './photoJob';

type Kind = 'gear' | 'receipt';
type OkResponse = Extract<PhotoReadResponse, { status: 'ok' }>;
type Step =
  | { s: 'choose' }
  | { s: 'capture'; kind: Kind }
  | { s: 'reading'; kind: Kind }
  /** Sent: the server is reading it in the background. The sheet can be closed; the locker gets a notice when done. */
  | { s: 'started'; kind: Kind; photoId: number; message: string }
  | { s: 'result'; kind: Kind; res: OkResponse }
  | { s: 'problem'; kind: Kind; message: string; retryId?: number };

export interface ScanDeps {
  prepare: typeof preparePhoto;
  send: (body: { familyId: string; kind: 'item' | 'receipt'; mimeType: string; imageBase64: string; thumbnail?: string }) => Promise<StartResponse>;
  /** Loads an example label picture as a file (the "Try the example" button). */
  loadExample?: (src: string) => Promise<File>;
}
async function loadExampleFile(src: string): Promise<File> {
  const res = await fetch(src);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Could not open the example. Please try again.');
  return new File([await res.blob()], `${src.split('/').pop()}.png`, { type: 'image/png' });
}
const REAL: ScanDeps = { prepare: preparePhoto, send: startPhoto, loadExample: loadExampleFile };

/** The exact tip for the gear camera view (round 3, R7). */
export const GEAR_TIP = "Tip: frame the white manufacturer label or barcode sticker. It's usually under a car seat, on the back of a high chair, or on a stroller's rear frame.";
export const NO_MODEL = "We couldn't find a model number. Try the white label.";
export const TRUST_LINE = 'Photos are saved with your family’s profile only. We strip location data. Delete anytime.';

/** The words under "Where are you pointing the phone". */
const PHONE_GEAR = 'On your phone, point at the sticker on the bottom of the car seat.';

function Choice({ icon, title, sub, onClick }: { icon: JSX.Element; title: string; sub: string; onClick: () => void }) {
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={onClick} className="bundle-card flex w-full items-center gap-3 p-3.5 text-left transition active:scale-[0.99]">
      <span className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#FCE9E1] text-coral-deep">{icon}</span>
      <span className="min-w-0">
        <span className="block text-[17px] font-extrabold leading-snug">{title}</span>
        <span className="block text-[14px] leading-snug text-ink-2">{sub}</span>
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

/**
 * The scan sheet: "What are you scanning?" (gear or a receipt) -> camera view with a framing guide -> reading -> result card.
 * Opened from every scan entry point through the shared scan context. The phone redraws the picture first (location and phone
 * details are dropped), the server reads it and checks recalls, and a small copy is kept in the gear locker.
 */
export default function ScanSheet({ familyId, deps = REAL }: { familyId: string; deps?: ScanDeps }) {
  const { sheetOpen, closeScan, openLocker, bump, track, photos } = useScan();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>({ s: 'choose' });
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'phone' | 'computer'>('phone');
  const live = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => { live.current = true; return () => { live.current = false; }; }, []);

  // A fresh sheet every time it opens.
  useEffect(() => { if (sheetOpen) { setStep({ s: 'choose' }); setTab('phone'); } }, [sheetOpen]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sheetOpen) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeScan(); };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [sheetOpen, closeScan]);

  // A background read finishing while the sheet is still open: show the result (or the problem) right here.
  const watched = step.s === 'started' ? photos[step.photoId] : undefined;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (step.s !== 'started' || !watched || watched.status === 'reading') return;
    if (watched.status === 'done' && watched.result && watched.result.items?.length) {
      setStep({ s: 'result', kind: step.kind, res: { ...watched.result, stored: watched.result.already ? 0 : watched.result.stored } });
    } else {
      setStep({ s: 'problem', kind: step.kind, message: watched.message ?? 'We could not read that photo.', retryId: watched.canRetry ? watched.photoId : undefined });
    }
  }, [step, watched]);

  if (!sheetOpen) return null;

  async function onPick(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>, kind: Kind) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = ''; // so choosing the same photo again still fires
    if (!file) return;
    await readFile(file, kind);
  }

  async function tryExample(src: string) {
    setStep({ s: 'reading', kind: 'gear' });
    try { await readFile(await (deps.loadExample ?? loadExampleFile)(src), 'gear'); }
    catch (err) { if (live.current) setStep({ s: 'problem', kind: 'gear', message: (err as Error).message || 'Could not open the example.' }); }
  }

  async function tryAgain(kind: Kind, photoId: number) {
    try {
      const out = await retryPhoto(familyId, photoId);
      if (out === 'retake') { setStep({ s: 'capture', kind }); return; }
      track(familyId, photoId);
      setStep({ s: 'started', kind, photoId, message: "Thanks! We're reading your photo again. You can close this." });
    } catch { setStep({ s: 'capture', kind }); }
  }

  async function readFile(file: File, kind: Kind) {
    const bad = checkPickedFile(file);
    if (bad) { setStep({ s: 'problem', kind, message: bad }); return; }
    setStep({ s: 'reading', kind });
    try {
      const prepared = await deps.prepare(file);
      const res = await deps.send({ familyId, kind: kind === 'gear' ? 'item' : 'receipt', mimeType: prepared.mimeType, imageBase64: prepared.imageBase64, thumbnail: prepared.thumbnail });
      if (!live.current) return;
      if (res.status === 'reading') {
        track(familyId, res.photoId);
        setStep({ s: 'started', kind, photoId: res.photoId, message: res.message });
        bump();
        return;
      }
      if (res.status !== 'ok') { setStep({ s: 'problem', kind, message: res.message }); return; }
      if (res.items.length === 0) { setStep({ s: 'problem', kind, message: kind === 'gear' ? NO_MODEL : 'We could not find any items on that receipt. Try a flatter, brighter photo.' }); return; }
      setStep({ s: 'result', kind, res });
      bump();
    } catch (err) {
      if (live.current) setStep({ s: 'problem', kind, message: (err as Error).message || 'Could not read that photo. Please try again.' });
    }
  }

  const kind = step.s === 'choose' ? null : step.kind;
  const title = step.s === 'choose' ? 'What are you scanning?' : step.s === 'result' ? 'Your scan' : step.s === 'problem' ? 'Scan problem' : step.s === 'started' ? 'Photo sent' : kind === 'gear' ? 'Take a photo' : 'Take a photo of your receipt';

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center bg-ink/40" onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && step.s !== 'reading') closeScan(); }}>
      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="scan-title" className="max-h-[92dvh] w-full max-w-[480px] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-3xl bg-cream px-4 pb-8 pt-3 shadow-2xl">
        <div aria-hidden="true" className="mx-auto mb-3 h-1.5 w-11 rounded-full bg-line" />

        {step.s === 'capture' && (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setStep({ s: 'choose' })} className="-ml-1 mb-1 flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-1 px-1 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink">
            <span aria-hidden="true">‹</span> Back
          </button>
        )}
        <h2 id="scan-title" className={cn('text-[24px] font-extrabold tracking-[-0.02em]', step.s === 'result' && 'sr-only')}>{title}</h2>

        {step.s === 'choose' && (
          <div className="mt-3 space-y-2.5">
            <Choice icon={<GearIcon />} title="Gear (the sticker on the item)" sub="We check it against official recall lists" onClick={() => setStep({ s: 'capture', kind: 'gear' })} />
            <Choice icon={<ReceiptIcon />} title="A receipt" sub="Money back (FSA-eligible items, price drops) and a recall check on each item" onClick={() => setStep({ s: 'capture', kind: 'receipt' })} />
            <p className="px-2 pt-1 text-center text-[13.5px] leading-snug text-ink-2">{TRUST_LINE}</p>
            <button type="button" onClick={closeScan} className="mx-auto flex min-h-[44px] items-center px-3 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink underline decoration-2 underline-offset-4">Cancel</button>
          </div>
        )}

        {step.s === 'capture' && (
          <div className="mt-3">
            {step.kind === 'gear' ? (
              <>

        )}

/** A fetch stand-in: each URL pattern answers from a list (the last answer repeats). */
function fakeFetch(routes: [RegExp, unknown[]][]) {
  const seen = new Map<RegExp, number>();
  const f = jest.fn(async (url: string) => {
    const hit = routes.find(([re]) => re.test(String(url)));
    if (!hit) return { ok: false, status: 404, json: async () => ({}) };
    const i = seen.get(hit[0]) ?? 0; seen.set(hit[0], i + 1);
    const body = hit[1][Math.min(i, hit[1].length - 1)];
    return { ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => body };
  });
  (global as any).fetch = f;
  return f;
}

// Background photo reading, phone side. The photo is sent once; the server saves it and answers straight away
// ("Thanks, we're reading your photo"), reads it in the background, and the app checks back every few seconds.
import type { PhotoReadResponse } from '@/lib/photoPrep';

export type PhotoStatus = 'reading' | 'done' | 'needs_clearer_photo' | 'rejected' | 'failed';

/** One photo's state, as the server reports it (product facts only). */
export interface PhotoStatusView {
  photoId: number;
  kind: 'item' | 'receipt';
  status: PhotoStatus;
  message: string | null;
  thumbnail: string | null;
  /** The reading (same shape as an instant read) once status is 'done'. */
  result?: Extract<PhotoReadResponse, { status: 'ok' }> & { already?: boolean };
  /** True when "Try again" can re-read the same photo; false means take a new photo. */
  canRetry: boolean;
}

/** What the upload answers: the instant reading (older servers, practice) or "we're reading it" with the photo's id. */
export type StartResponse = PhotoReadResponse | { status: 'reading'; photoId: number; message: string; kind?: 'item' | 'receipt' };

/** The one-line tip under the example labels: exactly what to capture. */
export const CAPTURE_TIP = 'Find the white sticker under the seat with the model number and date made.';
export const STROLLER_TIP = 'On a stroller it is usually on the frame near a back wheel.';

/** The made-up example labels (served by the photo routes from data/sample/photos). */
export const EXAMPLES = [
  { id: 'car-seat', title: 'Car seat sticker', src: '/api/photo/examples/car-seat', alt: 'Example car seat sticker (made-up brand): model number ZF-CS100, date of manufacture 2026/02/09, lot CS0209B' },
  { id: 'stroller', title: 'Stroller sticker', src: '/api/photo/examples/stroller', alt: 'Example stroller sticker (made-up brand): model number TM-ST200, date of manufacture 2026/03/14, lot 0314A' },
] as const;

const json = { 'content-type': 'application/json' };

/** Sends the prepared photo for background reading. */
export async function startPhoto(
  body: { familyId: string; kind: 'item' | 'receipt'; mimeType: string; imageBase64: string; thumbnail?: string },
  fetchFn?: typeof fetch,
): Promise<StartResponse> {
  const res = await (fetchFn ?? globalThis.fetch)('/api/photo/read', { method: 'POST', headers: json, body: JSON.stringify({ ...body, background: true }) });
  const out = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as StartResponse & { error?: string };
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(out.error || 'Could not send that photo. Please try again.');
  return out;
}

export async function fetchPhotoStatus(familyId: string, photoId: number, fetchFn?: typeof fetch): Promise<PhotoStatusView | null> {
  const res = await (fetchFn ?? globalThis.fetch)(`/api/photo/status/${photoId}?familyId=${encodeURIComponent(familyId)}`);
  if (res.status === 404) return null;
  if (!res.ok) throw Object.assign(new Error('Could not check that photo.'), { status: res.status });
  return (await res.json()) as PhotoStatusView;
}

/** The family's photos still being read, or stopped with a message. An older server (or a blip) simply gives none. */
export async function fetchPendingPhotos(familyId: string, fetchFn?: typeof fetch): Promise<PhotoStatusView[]> {
  try {
    if (!fetchFn && typeof globalThis.fetch !== 'function') return [];
    const res = await (fetchFn ?? globalThis.fetch)(`/api/families/${encodeURIComponent(familyId)}/photos`);
    if (!res.ok) return [];
    const out = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { photos?: PhotoStatusView[] };
    return Array.isArray(out.photos) ? out.photos : [];
  } catch { return []; }
}

/** "Try again": 'reading' when the same photo is being read again, 'retake' when a new photo is needed. */
export async function retryPhoto(familyId: string, photoId: number, fetchFn?: typeof fetch): Promise<'reading' | 'retake'> {
  const res = await (fetchFn ?? globalThis.fetch)('/api/photo/retry', { method: 'POST', headers: json, body: JSON.stringify({ familyId, photoId }) });
  if (res.status === 202) return 'reading';
  if (res.status === 410 || res.status === 404) return 'retake';
  throw new Error('Could not try that photo again. Please try again.');
}

export async function dismissPhoto(familyId: string, photoId: number, fetchFn?: typeof fetch): Promise<void> {
  await (fetchFn ?? globalThis.fetch)('/api/photo/dismiss', { method: 'POST', headers: json, body: JSON.stringify({ familyId, photoId }) });
}

/** Failed checks in a row before we stop checking one photo (the locker still shows it on the next open). */
export const MAX_STATUS_FAILURES = 8;

/**
 * Checks one photo every `intervalMs` until it is no longer 'reading'. Network blips are retried; a photo the server
 * no longer knows (404) stops at once. Returns a stop function.
 */
export function pollPhoto(
  familyId: string, photoId: number,
  h: { onUpdate?: (v: PhotoStatusView) => void; onDone: (v: PhotoStatusView) => void; onGone?: () => void },
  intervalMs = 3000, fetchFn?: typeof fetch,
): () => void {
  let stopped = false;
  let failures = 0;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  const tick = async () => {
    try {
      const v = await fetchPhotoStatus(familyId, photoId, fetchFn);
      if (stopped) return;
      failures = 0;
      if (!v) return h.onGone?.();
      h.onUpdate?.(v);
      if (v.status !== 'reading') return h.onDone(v);
    } catch {
      if (stopped) return;
      if (++failures >= MAX_STATUS_FAILURES) return h.onGone?.();
    }
    if (!stopped) timer = setTimeout(tick, intervalMs);
  };
  timer = setTimeout(tick, intervalMs);
  return () => { stopped = true; if (timer) clearTimeout(timer); };
}

/** The plain-language "done" line for a finished photo: what was added and what the recall check said. */
export function doneNotice(v: PhotoStatusView): string {
  if (v.status !== 'done') return v.message ?? 'We could not read that photo.';
  const items = v.result?.items ?? [];
  const first = items[0]?.productName ?? (v.kind === 'receipt' ? 'Your receipt' : 'Your item');
  const what = v.kind === 'receipt' ? `Your receipt (${items.length} ${items.length === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'})` : first;
  const found = items.some((i) => i.recall?.found === true);
  const none = items.length > 0 && items.every((i) => i.recall?.found === false);
  const tail = found ? 'Possible recall: open it to check.' : none ? 'No recalls found.' : 'Open it to see the recall check.';
  return `${what} is in your Gear Locker. ${tail}`;
}

import * as React from "react"
import useEmblaCarousel, {
  type UseEmblaCarouselType,
} from "embla-carousel-react"
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

type CarouselApi = UseEmblaCarouselType[1]
type UseCarouselParameters = Parameters<typeof useEmblaCarousel>
type CarouselOptions = UseCarouselParameters[0]
type CarouselPlugin = UseCarouselParameters[1]

type CarouselProps = {
  opts?: CarouselOptions
  plugins?: CarouselPlugin
  orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical"
  setApi?: (api: CarouselApi) => void
}

type CarouselContextProps = {
  carouselRef: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[0]
  api: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[1]
  scrollPrev: () => void
  scrollNext: () => void
  canScrollPrev: boolean
  canScrollNext: boolean
} & CarouselProps

const CarouselContext = React.createContext<CarouselContextProps | null>(null)

function useCarousel() {
  const context = React.useContext(CarouselContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useCarousel must be used within a <Carousel />")
  }

  return context
}

const Carousel = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & CarouselProps
>(
  (
    {
      orientation = "horizontal",
      opts,
      setApi,
      plugins,
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const [carouselRef, api] = useEmblaCarousel(
      {
        ...opts,
        axis: orientation === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y",
      },
      plugins
    )
    const [canScrollPrev, setCanScrollPrev] = React.useState(false)
    const [canScrollNext, setCanScrollNext] = React.useState(false)

    const onSelect = React.useCallback((api: CarouselApi) => {
      if (!api) {
        return
      }

      setCanScrollPrev(api.canScrollPrev())
      setCanScrollNext(api.canScrollNext())
    }, [])

    const scrollPrev = React.useCallback(() => {
      api?.scrollPrev()
    }, [api])

    const scrollNext = React.useCallback(() => {
      api?.scrollNext()
    }, [api])

    const handleKeyDown = React.useCallback(
      (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
          event.preventDefault()
          scrollPrev()
        } else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
          event.preventDefault()
          scrollNext()
        }
      },
      [scrollPrev, scrollNext]
    )

    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!api || !setApi) {
        return
      }

      setApi(api)
    }, [api, setApi])

    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!api) {
        return
      }

      onSelect(api)
      api.on("reInit", onSelect)
      api.on("select", onSelect)

      return () => {
        api?.off("select", onSelect)
      }
    }, [api, onSelect])

    return (
      <CarouselContext.Provider
        value={{
          carouselRef,
          api: api,
          opts,
          orientation:
            orientation || (opts?.axis === "y" ? "vertical" : "horizontal"),
          scrollPrev,
          scrollNext,
          canScrollPrev,
          canScrollNext,
        }}
      >
        <div
          ref={ref}
          onKeyDownCapture={handleKeyDown}
          className={cn("relative", className)}
          role="region"
          aria-roledescription="carousel"
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </CarouselContext.Provider>
    )
  }
)
Carousel.displayName = "Carousel"

const CarouselContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {

  return (
    <div ref={carouselRef} className="overflow-hidden">
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex",
          orientation === "horizontal" ? "-ml-4" : "-mt-4 flex-col",

        )}

    </div>

})

import * as React from "react"
import * as RechartsPrimitive from "recharts"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

// Format: { THEME_NAME: CSS_SELECTOR }
const THEMES = { light: "", dark: ".dark" } as const

export type ChartConfig = {
  [k in string]: {
    label?: React.ReactNode
    icon?: React.ComponentType
  } & (
    | { color?: string; theme?: never }
    | { color?: never; theme: Record<keyof typeof THEMES, string> }
  )
}

type ChartContextProps = {
  config: ChartConfig
}

const ChartContext = React.createContext<ChartContextProps | null>(null)

function useChart() {
  const context = React.useContext(ChartContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useChart must be used within a <ChartContainer />")
  }

  return context
}

const ChartContainer = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    config: ChartConfig
    children: React.ComponentProps<
      typeof RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer
    >["children"]
  }
>(({ id, className, children, config, ...props }, ref) => {
  const uniqueId = React.useId()
  const chartId = `chart-${id || uniqueId.replace(/:/g, "")}`

  return (
    <ChartContext.Provider value={{ config }}>
      <div
        data-chart={chartId}
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex aspect-video justify-center text-xs [&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground [&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border/50 [&_.recharts-curve.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-dot[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-layer]:outline-none [&_.recharts-polar-grid_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-radial-bar-background-sector]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-rectangle.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-reference-line_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-sector[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-sector]:outline-none [&_.recharts-surface]:outline-none",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <ChartStyle id={chartId} config={config} />
        <RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
          {children}
        </RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </ChartContext.Provider>
  )
})
ChartContainer.displayName = "Chart"

const ChartStyle = ({ id, config }: { id: string; config: ChartConfig }) => {
  const colorConfig = Object.entries(config).filter(
    ([_, config]) => config.theme || config.color
  )

  if (!colorConfig.length) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <style
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: Object.entries(THEMES)
          .map(
            ([theme, prefix]) => `
${prefix} [data-chart=${id}] {
${colorConfig
  .map(([key, itemConfig]) => {
    const color =
      itemConfig.theme?.[theme as keyof typeof itemConfig.theme] ||
      itemConfig.color
    return color ? `  --color-${key}: ${color};` : null
  })
  .join("\n")}
}
`
          )
          .join("\n"),
      }}
    />
  )
}

const ChartTooltipContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip> &

>(

      const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
      const value =
        !labelKey && typeof label === "string"
          ? config[label as keyof typeof config]?.label || label
          : itemConfig?.label

      if (labelFormatter) {
        return (
          <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>
            {labelFormatter(value, payload)}
          </div>
        )
      }

      if (!value) {

      }

      return <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>{value}</div>
    }, [
      label,
      labelFormatter,

      labelKey,
    ])

    if (!active || !payload?.length) {

    }

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "grid min-w-[8rem] items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-xl",
          className
        )}

            const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
            const indicatorColor = color || item.payload.fill || item.color

            return (
              <div
                key={item.dataKey}
                className={cn(

                      !hideIndicator && (

                              "w-1": indicator === "line",
                              "w-0 border-[1.5px] border-dashed bg-transparent":
                                indicator === "dashed",
                              "my-0.5": nestLabel && indicator === "dashed",
                            }
                          )}
                          style={
                            {
                              "--color-bg": indicatorColor,
                              "--color-border": indicatorColor,
                            } as React.CSSProperties
                          }
                        />
                      )
                    )}
                    <div
                      className={cn(
                        "flex flex-1 justify-between leading-none",
                        nestLabel ? "items-end" : "items-center"
                      )}
                    >
                      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                        {nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                          {itemConfig?.label || item.name}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {item.value && (
                        <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums text-foreground">
                          {item.value.toLocaleString()}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
)
ChartTooltipContent.displayName = "ChartTooltip"

const ChartLegend = RechartsPrimitive.Legend

const ChartLegendContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> &
    Pick<RechartsPrimitive.LegendProps, "payload" | "verticalAlign"> & {
      hideIcon?: boolean
      nameKey?: string
    }
>(
  (
    { className, hideIcon = false, payload, verticalAlign = "bottom", nameKey },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { config } = useChart()

    if (!payload?.length) {
      return null
    }

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center justify-center gap-4",
          verticalAlign === "top" ? "pb-3" : "pt-3",
          className
        )}
      >
        {payload.map((item) => {
          const key = `${nameKey || item.dataKey || "value"}`
          const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)

          return (
            <div
              key={item.value}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground"
              )}
            >
              {itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
                <itemConfig.icon />
              ) : (
                <div
                  className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: item.color,
                  }}
                />
              )}
              {itemConfig?.label}
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    )
  }
)
ChartLegendContent.displayName = "ChartLegend"

// Helper to extract item config from a payload.
function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(
  config: ChartConfig,
  payload: unknown,
  key: string
) {
  if (typeof payload !== "object" || payload === null) {
    return undefined
  }

  const payloadPayload =
    "payload" in payload &&
    typeof payload.payload === "object" &&
    payload.payload !== null
      ? payload.payload
      : undefined

  let configLabelKey: string = key

  if (
    key in payload &&
    typeof payload[key as keyof typeof payload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payload[key as keyof typeof payload] as string
  } else if (
    payloadPayload &&
    key in payloadPayload &&
    typeof payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payloadPayload[
      key as keyof typeof payloadPayload
    ] as string
  }

  return configLabelKey in config
    ? config[configLabelKey]
    : config[key as keyof typeof config]
}

export {
  ChartContainer,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent,
  ChartLegend,
  ChartLegendContent,
  ChartStyle,
}

import * as React from "react"
import * as LabelPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-label"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import {
  Controller,
  ControllerProps,
  FieldPath,
  FieldValues,
  FormProvider,
  useFormContext,
} from "react-hook-form"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"

const Form = FormProvider

type FormFieldContextValue<
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>
> = {
  name: TName
}

const FormFieldContext = React.createContext<FormFieldContextValue>(
  {} as FormFieldContextValue
)

const FormField = <
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>
>({
  ...props
}: ControllerProps<TFieldValues, TName>) => {
  return (
    <FormFieldContext.Provider value={{ name: props.name }}>
      <Controller {...props} />
    </FormFieldContext.Provider>
  )
}

const useFormField = () => {
  const fieldContext = React.useContext(FormFieldContext)
  const itemContext = React.useContext(FormItemContext)
  const { getFieldState, formState } = useFormContext()

  const fieldState = getFieldState(fieldContext.name, formState)

  if (!fieldContext) {
    throw new Error("useFormField should be used within <FormField>")
  }

  const { id } = itemContext

  return {
    id,
    name: fieldContext.name,
    formItemId: `${id}-form-item`,
    formDescriptionId: `${id}-form-item-description`,
    formMessageId: `${id}-form-item-message`,
    ...fieldState,
  }
}

type FormItemContextValue = {
  id: string
}

const FormItemContext = React.createContext<FormItemContextValue>(
  {} as FormItemContextValue
)

const FormItem = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const id = React.useId()

  return (
    <FormItemContext.Provider value={{ id }}>
      <div ref={ref} className={cn("space-y-2", className)} {...props} />
    </FormItemContext.Provider>
  )
})
FormItem.displayName = "FormItem"

const FormLabel = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formItemId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <Label
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(error && "text-destructive", className)}
      htmlFor={formItemId}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
FormLabel.displayName = "FormLabel"

const FormControl = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof Slot>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Slot>
>(({ ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <Slot
      ref={ref}
      id={formItemId}
      aria-describedby={
        !error
          ? `${formDescriptionId}`
          : `${formDescriptionId} ${formMessageId}`
      }
      aria-invalid={!!error}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
FormControl.displayName = "FormControl"

const FormDescription = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { formDescriptionId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <p
      ref={ref}
      id={formDescriptionId}
      className={cn("text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
FormDescription.displayName = "FormDescription"

const FormMessage = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>
>(({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formMessageId } = useFormField()
  const body = error ? String(error?.message) : children

  if (!body) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <p
      ref={ref}
      id={formMessageId}
      className={cn("text-sm font-medium text-destructive", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {body}
    </p>
  )
})
FormMessage.displayName = "FormMessage"

export {
  useFormField,
  Form,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormMessage,
  FormField,
}

```
import * as React from "react"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import { VariantProps, cva } from "class-variance-authority"
import { PanelLeft } from "lucide-react"

import { useIsMobile } from "@/hooks/useMobile"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator"
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton"
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip"

const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME = "sidebar:state"
const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH = "16rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE = "18rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON = "3rem"
const SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT = "b"

type SidebarContext = {
  state: "expanded" | "collapsed"
  open: boolean
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void
  openMobile: boolean
  setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void
  isMobile: boolean
  toggleSidebar: () => void
}

const SidebarContext = React.createContext<SidebarContext | null>(null)

function useSidebar() {
  const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext)
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider.")
  }

  return context
}

const SidebarProvider = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    defaultOpen?: boolean
    open?: boolean
    onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
  }
>(
  (
    {
      defaultOpen = true,
      open: openProp,
      onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
      className,
      style,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const isMobile = useIsMobile()
    const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false)

    // This is the internal state of the sidebar.
    // We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
    const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen)
    const open = openProp ?? _open
    const setOpen = React.useCallback(
      (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
        if (setOpenProp) {
          return setOpenProp?.(
            typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value
          )
        }

        _setOpen(value)

        // This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.
        document.cookie = `${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${open}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}`
      },
      [setOpenProp, open]
    )

    // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
    const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
      return isMobile
        ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open)
        : setOpen((open) => !open)
    }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile])

    // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
    React.useEffect(() => {
      const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (
          event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT &&
          (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)
        ) {
          event.preventDefault()
          toggleSidebar()
        }
      }

      window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
      return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
    }, [toggleSidebar])

    // We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
    // This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
    const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed"

    const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContext>(
      () => ({
        state,
        open,
        setOpen,
        isMobile,
        openMobile,
        setOpenMobile,
        toggleSidebar,
      }),
      [state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, setOpenMobile, toggleSidebar]
    )

    return (
      <SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
        <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
          <div
            style={
              {
                "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
                "--sidebar-width-icon": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
                ...style,
              } as React.CSSProperties
            }
            className={cn(
              "group/sidebar-wrapper flex min-h-svh w-full text-sidebar-foreground has-[[data-variant=inset]]:bg-sidebar",
              className
            )}
            ref={ref}
            {...props}
          >
            {children}
          </div>
        </TooltipProvider>
      </SidebarContext.Provider>
    )
  }
)
SidebarProvider.displayName = "SidebarProvider"

const Sidebar = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    side?: "left" | "right"
    variant?: "sidebar" | "floating" | "inset"
    collapsible?: "offcanvas" | "icon" | "none"
  }
>(
  (
    {
      side = "left",
      variant = "sidebar",
      collapsible = "offcanvas",
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { isMobile, state, openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar()

    if (collapsible === "none") {
      return (
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex h-full w-[--sidebar-width] flex-col bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground",
            className
          )}
          ref={ref}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      )
    }

    if (isMobile) {
      return (
        <Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} {...props}>
          <SheetContent
            data-sidebar="sidebar"
            data-mobile="true"
            className="w-[--sidebar-width] bg-sidebar p-0 text-sidebar-foreground [&>button]:hidden"
            style={
              {
                "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE,
              } as React.CSSProperties
            }
            side={side}
          >
            <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
          </SheetContent>
        </Sheet>
      )
    }

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className="group peer hidden md:block"
        data-state={state}
        data-collapsible={state === "collapsed" ? collapsible : ""}
        data-variant={variant}
        data-side={side}
      >
        {/* This is what handles the sidebar gap on desktop */}

            "group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:w-0",

            variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"

              : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[--sidebar-width-icon]"
          )}
        />
        <div
          className={cn(
            "duration-200 fixed inset-y-0 z-10 hidden h-svh w-[--sidebar-width] transition-[left,right,width] ease-linear md:flex",
            side === "left"
              ? "left-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:left-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]"
              : "right-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:right-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]",
            // Adjust the padding for floating and inset variants.
            variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
              ? "p-2 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)_+_theme(spacing.4)_+2px)]"
              : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[--sidebar-width-icon] group-data-[side=left]:border-r group-data-[side=right]:border-l",
            className
          )}
          {...props}
        >
          <div
            data-sidebar="sidebar"
            className="flex h-full w-full flex-col bg-sidebar group-data-[variant=floating]:rounded-lg group-data-[variant=floating]:border group-data-[variant=floating]:border-sidebar-border group-data-[variant=floating]:shadow"
          >

        </div>
      </div>

)
