const sidebarMenuButtonVariants = cva(
  "peer/menu-button flex w-full items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-md p-2 text-left text-sm outline-none ring-sidebar-ring transition-[width,height,padding] hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 active:bg-sidebar-accent active:text-sidebar-accent-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 group-has-[[data-sidebar=menu-action]]/menu-item:pr-8 aria-disabled:pointer-events-none aria-disabled:opacity-50 data-[active=true]:bg-sidebar-accent data-[active=true]:font-medium data-[active=true]:text-sidebar-accent-foreground data-[state=open]:hover:bg-sidebar-accent data-[state=open]:hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground group-data-[collapsible=icon]:!size-8 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:!p-2 [&>span:last-child]:truncate [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground",
        outline:
          "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_hsl(var(--sidebar-border))] hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground hover:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_hsl(var(--sidebar-accent))]",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-8 text-sm",
        sm: "h-7 text-xs",
        lg: "h-12 text-sm group-data-[collapsible=icon]:!p-0",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

const SidebarMenuButton = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLButtonElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
    asChild?: boolean
    isActive?: boolean
    tooltip?: string | React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipContent>
  } & VariantProps<typeof sidebarMenuButtonVariants>
>(
  (
    {
      asChild = false,
      isActive = false,
      variant = "default",
      size = "default",
      tooltip,
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button"
    const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar()

    const button = (
      <Comp
        ref={ref}
        data-sidebar="menu-button"
        data-size={size}
        data-active={isActive}
        className={cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant, size }), className)}
        {...props}
      />
    )

    if (!tooltip) {
      return button
    }

    if (typeof tooltip === "string") {
      tooltip = {
        children: tooltip,
      }
    }

    return (
      <Tooltip>
        <TooltipTrigger asChild>{button}</TooltipTrigger>
        <TooltipContent
          side="right"
          align="center"
          hidden={state !== "collapsed" || isMobile}
          {...tooltip}
        />
      </Tooltip>
    )
  }
)
SidebarMenuButton.displayName = "SidebarMenuButton"

```
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '@/lib/bundle';
import { loadClaims, loadDismissed, saveClaims, saveDismissed } from '@/lib/tabs';

/** How long the "Undo" bar stays up after "Not relevant". */
export const UNDO_SECONDS = 6;

export interface UndoBar { id: string; title: string; cents: number }

/** Tell the server, but never let a slow or missing server get in the parent's way. */
function tellServer(run: () => Promise<unknown>): void {
  try { void run().catch(() => undefined); } catch { /* no network: the browser copy still works */ }
}

/**
 * One place for "I got this", "Not relevant" and "Undo", used by the tabs and by the card detail page so they never disagree.
 * The browser keeps the answer at once (so numbers move instantly); the server copy (claims + feedback tables, and the Coach) follows.
 */
export function useClaims(familyId: string) {
  const [claims, setClaims] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(() => loadClaims(familyId));
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(() => loadDismissed(familyId));
  const [bar, setBar] = useState<UndoBar | null>(null);
  // The family can arrive after the first render (a card opened in a new tab loads its run first): read this family's answers again.
  useEffect(() => { setClaims(loadClaims(familyId)); setDismissed(loadDismissed(familyId)); }, [familyId]);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const clearTimer = () => { if (timer.current) { clearTimeout(timer.current); timer.current = null; } };
  useEffect(() => clearTimer, []);

  const put = useCallback((nextClaims: Record<string, boolean>, nextDismissed: Record<string, boolean>) => {
    setClaims(nextClaims); saveClaims(familyId, nextClaims);
    setDismissed(nextDismissed); saveDismissed(familyId, nextDismissed);
  }, [familyId]);

  const without = (m: Record<string, boolean>, id: string) => { const { [id]: _gone, ...rest } = m; return rest; };

  const claim = useCallback((id: string) => {
    put({ ...claims, [id]: true }, without(dismissed, id));
    tellServer(() => api.feedback({ familyId, cardId: id, kind: 'got_it' }));
  }, [claims, dismissed, familyId, put]);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id: string, title: string, cents: number) => {
    put(without(claims, id), { ...dismissed, [id]: true });
    tellServer(() => api.feedback({ familyId, cardId: id, kind: 'not_relevant' }));
    clearTimer();
    setBar({ id, title, cents });
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => setBar(null), UNDO_SECONDS * 1000);
  }, [claims, dismissed, familyId, put]);

  const undo = useCallback((id: string) => {
    put(without(claims, id), without(dismissed, id));
    tellServer(() => api.undoClaim({ familyId, cardId: id }));
    setBar((b) => { if (b?.id === id) clearTimer(); return b?.id === id ? null : b; });
  }, [claims, dismissed, familyId, put]);

  const closeBar = useCallback(() => { clearTimer(); setBar(null); }, []);

  return { claims, dismissed, bar, claim, dismiss, undo, closeBar };
}
export type Claims = ReturnType<typeof useClaims>;

```

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { FeedCard } from '@shared/bundle';
import { SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS, searchOffers } from '@/lib/offers';

/**
 * The live offer search, run in the background (R3). It never holds the page up and it never shows an error:
 *   searching: the request is out (saved offers are already on screen);
 *   practice:  practice mode skips the search;
 *   found:     the court-graded new offers (may be none);
 *   quiet:     it failed, ran out of time (10 seconds), or there is no key or no internet. The saved offers just stay.
 */
export type LiveOffers =
  | { phase: 'searching' }
  | { phase: 'practice' }
  | { phase: 'found'; cards: FeedCard[]; sitesSearched: number }
  | { phase: 'quiet' };

export function useLiveOffers(): LiveOffers {
  const [state, setState] = useState<LiveOffers>({ phase: 'searching' });
  useEffect(() => {
    let settled = false;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const finish = (next: LiveOffers) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); setState(next); };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { finish({ phase: 'quiet' }); controller.abort(); }, SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS);
    void searchOffers(controller.signal).then((r) => {
      finish(r.kind === 'live' ? { phase: 'found', cards: r.cards, sitesSearched: r.sitesSearched } : r.kind === 'practice' ? { phase: 'practice' } : { phase: 'quiet' });
    });
    return () => { settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); controller.abort(); };
  }, []);
  return state;
}

import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}

#### File: ./client/src/hooks/useToast.ts
```
import * as React from "react"

import type {
  ToastActionElement,
  ToastProps,
} from "@/components/ui/toast"

const TOAST_LIMIT = 1
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000

type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
  id: string
  title?: React.ReactNode
  description?: React.ReactNode
  action?: ToastActionElement
}

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
} as const

let count = 0

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  return count.toString()
}

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes

type Action =
  | {
      type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"]
      toast: ToasterToast
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"]
      toast: Partial<ToasterToast>
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"]
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"]
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
    }

interface State {
  toasts: ToasterToast[]
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId)
    dispatch({
      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",
      toastId: toastId,
    })
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY)

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout)
}

export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "ADD_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
      }

    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t
        ),
      }

    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
      const { toastId } = action

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId)
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id)
        })
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
                ...t,
                open: false,
              }
            : t
        ),
      }
    }
    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: [],
        }
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
      }
  }
}

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = []

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] }

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action)
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState)
  })
}

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId()

  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({
      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",
      toast: { ...props, id },
    })
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id })

  dispatch({
    type: "ADD_TOAST",
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss()
      },
    },
  })

  return {
    id: id,
    dismiss,
    update,
  }
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState)
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState)
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1)
      }
    }
  }, [state])

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
  }
}

export { useToast, toast }

```

@tailwind components;

/*
  Bundle design tokens (from presentation/deck/design-system.md).
  Warm cream background, white cards, one coral accent.
  shadcn/ui variables are mapped onto the same palette (HSL triplets).
*/
@layer base {
  :root {
    --cream: #FBF6EF;
    --paper: #FFFFFF;
    --ink: #1B1714;
    --ink-2: #5C534B;
    --ink-3: #8A8076;

    --background: 35 65% 96%;        /* cream */
    --foreground: 26 13% 9%;         /* ink */
    --card: 0 0% 100%;
    --card-foreground: 26 13% 9%;
    --popover: 0 0% 100%;
    --popover-foreground: 26 13% 9%;
    --primary: 26 13% 9%;            /* ink buttons */
    --primary-foreground: 35 65% 96%;
    --secondary: 18 81% 93%;         /* coral tint */
    --secondary-foreground: 13 75% 41%;

    --accent: 18 81% 93%;

    --border: 34 33% 87%;            /* line */

    expect(titles({ ...base, household: 'two', parent1Work: 'paycheck', parent2Work: 'paycheck', insurance: 'job' })).toEqual([
      'State and federal family benefits', 'Insurance deadline to add your baby', 'Daycare tax savings and Dependent Care FSA',
      'Free registry gifts and welcome boxes', 'Every result double-checked against its official source',
    ]);
  });

    expect(t.at(-2)).toBe('Your items vs. official recall lists');

  });

    expect(titles({ ...base, household: 'two', parent1Work: 'paycheck', parent2Work: 'not_working' }).join()).not.toMatch(/aycare|FSA/);
    expect(titles({ ...base, household: null, parent1Work: null })).toContain('Daycare tax savings (general)');
    expect(titles(undefined)).toContain('Daycare tax savings (general)');
  });

});

// "How we got this number" labels must match what the agents really ask Zetaris. These tests tie the screen's matchers to the
// real SQL text in the server files (read from disk), so if a query is reworded the labels fail loudly instead of going blank.
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import type { FeedCard } from '@shared/bundle';
import type { TraceLine } from '../bundle';
import { zetarisForCard } from '../howWeChecked';

const server = (f: string) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '../../../../server/agents', f), 'utf8');

const card = (id: string, kind: FeedCard['kind']): FeedCard => ({ id, kind, title: id, body: '', amountCents: null, deadline: null, verdict: 'verified', sources: [], traceId: '' });
let n = 0;
const z = (sql: string): TraceLine => ({ timestamp: '2026-10-23T00:00:00Z', trace_id: `z${n++}`, agent_name: 'zetaris', action: 'query_cached', input_summary: sql, output_summary: '1 rows (sample cache)', target_agent: null, confidence: null, retry_count: 0, status: 'ok' });

describe('the Fact-Checker queries the labels depend on are still in the server', () => {
  const fc = server('factChecker.ts');
  it('money-back (FSA) is re-read as "v_purchase_items WHERE id = N"', () => {
    expect(fc).toContain('FROM bundle_pg.v_purchase_items WHERE id = ${quoteInt(claim.itemId)} AND family_id');
  });
  it('price-drop is re-read as "v_purchase_items p JOIN ... WHERE p.id = N"', () => {
    expect(fc).toContain("'FROM bundle_pg.v_purchase_items p '");
    expect(fc).toContain('`WHERE p.id = ${quoteInt(claim.itemId)} AND p.family_id');
  });
  it('money-back queries read purchase_items only through v_purchase_items (no bank views)', () => {
    for (const f of ['clawback.ts', 'recall.ts', 'factChecker.ts']) {
      const src = server(f);
      expect(src).toContain('v_purchase_items');
      expect(src).not.toMatch(/v_clawback_tx|v_recall_orders/);
    }
  });
});

describe('a money-back card is tied to the queries that built it', () => {
  // The same statements the server sends, with an item id filled in.
  const fsaVerify = "SELECT price_cents AS amount_cents, family_id FROM bundle_pg.v_purchase_items WHERE id = 4 AND family_id = 'maya'";
  const priceVerify = "SELECT p.price_cents AS amount_cents, p.purchased_on AS tx_date FROM bundle_pg.v_purchase_items p JOIN bundle_pg.store_policies sp ON lower(sp.store) = lower(COALESCE(p.store, p.seller)) JOIN bundle_pg.price_observations po ON lower(po.store) = lower(sp.store) WHERE p.id = 5 AND p.family_id = 'maya'";
  const fsaMain = "SELECT DISTINCT p.id AS item_id FROM bundle_pg.v_purchase_items p JOIN bundle_pg.fsa_eligible_categories c ON c.account IN ('FSA', 'HSA') WHERE p.family_id = 'maya'";
  const priceMain = "SELECT p.id AS item_id FROM bundle_pg.v_purchase_items p JOIN bundle_pg.store_policies sp ON 1=1 JOIN bundle_pg.price_observations po ON 1=1 WHERE p.family_id = 'maya' AND po.price_cents < p.price_cents ORDER BY p.purchased_on, p.id";
  const otherItem = "SELECT p.price_cents FROM bundle_pg.v_purchase_items p JOIN bundle_pg.store_policies sp ON 1=1 JOIN bundle_pg.price_observations po ON 1=1 WHERE p.id = 55 AND p.family_id = 'maya'";
  const lines = [z(fsaVerify), z(priceVerify), z(fsaMain), z(priceMain), z(otherItem)];

  it('FSA card: its own check plus the FSA list, with plain-English sources', () => {
    const v = zetarisForCard(card('clawback-fsa-4', 'clawback'), lines)!;
    expect(v.queries).toBe(2);
    expect(v.sources).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['Your purchases (private, Neon)', 'FSA eligibility list']));
    expect(v.sql.join(' ')).not.toMatch(/maya/);

  it('price-drop card: its own check (by "p.id") plus the price query, and never another item\'s check', () => {
    const v = zetarisForCard(card('clawback-price-5', 'clawback'), lines)!;
    expect(v.queries).toBe(2); // verification for item 5 + the run-wide price query, not item 55

  });
  it('does not mix up item 5 with item 55', () => {
    const only55 = zetarisForCard(card('clawback-price-5', 'clawback'), [z(otherItem)]);
    expect(only55).toBeNull();
  });
});

import { fitWithin, checkPickedFile, preparePhoto, sendPhoto, forgetMyItems, MAX_SIDE, MAX_PICK_BYTES, type PhotoCodec } from '../photoPrep';

const file = (type: string, size = 1000) => ({ type, size, name: 'x' }) as unknown as File;

describe('fitWithin', () => {
  it('shrinks the long side to the limit and keeps the shape', () => {
    expect(fitWithin(4000, 3000, 1600)).toEqual({ width: 1600, height: 1200 });
    expect(fitWithin(3000, 4000, 1600)).toEqual({ width: 1200, height: 1600 });
  });
  it('never makes a small picture bigger', () => {
    expect(fitWithin(800, 600, 1600)).toEqual({ width: 800, height: 600 });
  });
  it('never returns a zero side', () => {
    expect(fitWithin(5000, 1, 1600)).toEqual({ width: 1600, height: 1 });
  });
});

describe('checkPickedFile', () => {
  it('accepts jpeg, png and phone formats; refuses other files and huge ones', () => {
    expect(checkPickedFile(file('image/jpeg'))).toBeNull();
    expect(checkPickedFile(file('image/png'))).toBeNull();
    expect(checkPickedFile(file('image/heic'))).toBeNull();
    expect(checkPickedFile(file('application/pdf'))).toMatch(/photo/i);
    expect(checkPickedFile(file('image/jpeg', MAX_PICK_BYTES + 1))).toMatch(/big/i);
  });
});

describe('preparePhoto', () => {
  it('redraws onto a fresh picture (which drops location data) at the smaller size and returns JPEG base64', async () => {
    const drawn: { w: number; h: number }[] = [];
    const codec: PhotoCodec = {
      decode: async () => ({ width: 4000, height: 3000 }),
      redrawAsJpeg: async (_src, w, h) => { drawn.push({ w, h }); return 'QUJD'; },
    };
    const out = await preparePhoto(file('image/jpeg'), codec);
    expect(drawn).toEqual([{ w: MAX_SIDE, h: 1200 }]);
    expect(out).toEqual({ mimeType: 'image/jpeg', imageBase64: 'QUJD' });
  });
  it('says so when the picture cannot be opened', async () => {
    const codec: PhotoCodec = { decode: async () => { throw new Error('bad'); }, redrawAsJpeg: async () => '' };
    await expect(preparePhoto(file('image/jpeg'), codec)).rejects.toThrow(/open that photo/i);
  });
});

describe('sendPhoto', () => {

import { pollRun, MAX_POLL_FAILURES, type PollApi } from '../poll';
import type { RunStatus } from '../bundle';

const running: RunStatus = { runId: 'r1', familyId: 'maya', status: 'running', startedAt: '2026-10-23T00:00:00Z', result: null, error: null };
const done: RunStatus = { ...running, status: 'done', result: { familyId: 'maya', runId: 'r1', receipt: { moneyBackCents: 0, likelyBenefitsCents: 0, deadlineCount: 0, nextDeadline: null, itemsChecked: 0 }, cards: [], banner: null } };
const httpError = (status: number) => Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${status}`), { status });

/** Let the pending promise chain settle, then advance the 1s timer. */
async function step(ms = 1000) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) await Promise.resolve();
  jest.advanceTimersByTime(ms);
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) await Promise.resolve();
}

function setup(responses: (RunStatus | Error)[]) {
  let i = 0;
  const api: PollApi = {
    run: jest.fn(async () => { const r = responses[Math.min(i++, responses.length - 1)]; if (r instanceof Error) throw r; return r; }),
    trace: jest.fn(async () => []),
  };
  const h = { onStatus: jest.fn(), onDone: jest.fn(), onFailed: jest.fn(), onGiveUp: jest.fn() };
  return { api, h };
}

beforeEach(() => jest.useFakeTimers());
afterEach(() => jest.useRealTimers());

describe('pollRun', () => {
  it('4 failed polls in a row then success keeps polling and finishes', async () => {
    const fail = httpError(502);
    const { api, h } = setup([fail, fail, fail, fail, running, done]);
    const stop = pollRun('r1', api, h);
    for (let n = 0; n < 7; n++) await step();
    expect(h.onGiveUp).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(h.onStatus).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(h.onDone).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(api.run).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(6);
    stop();
  });

  it(`${MAX_POLL_FAILURES} failed polls in a row gives up with 'lost'`, async () => {
    const { api, h } = setup([new TypeError('Failed to fetch')]);
    pollRun('r1', api, h);
    for (let n = 0; n < 8; n++) await step();
    expect(h.onGiveUp).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(h.onGiveUp).toHaveBeenCalledWith('lost');
    expect(api.run).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(MAX_POLL_FAILURES);
  });

  it('a success resets the failure count', async () => {
    const f = httpError(500);
    const { api, h } = setup([f, f, f, f, running, f, f, f, f, done]);
    pollRun('r1', api, h);
    for (let n = 0; n < 12; n++) await step();
    expect(h.onGiveUp).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(h.onDone).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('a 404 stops immediately with expired', async () => {
    const { api, h } = setup([httpError(404), running]);
    pollRun('r1', api, h);
    for (let n = 0; n < 4; n++) await step();
    expect(h.onGiveUp).toHaveBeenCalledWith('expired');
    expect(api.run).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});

// ---------- followRun with a fake EventSource ----------

class FakeES {
  static last: FakeES | null = null;
  listeners: Record<string, ((e: { data: string }) => void)[]> = {};
  onerror: (() => void) | null = null;
  onmessage: ((e: { data: string }) => void) | null = null;
  closed = false;
  constructor(public url: string) { FakeES.last = this; }
  addEventListener(t: string, fn: (e: { data: string }) => void) { (this.listeners[t] ||= []).push(fn); }
  close() { this.closed = true; }
  emit(type: string, payload: unknown) { for (const fn of this.listeners[type] ?? []) fn({ data: JSON.stringify(payload) }); }
  fail() { this.onerror?.(); }
}
const ES = FakeES as unknown as typeof EventSource;

const running: RunStatus = { runId: 'r1', familyId: 'maya', status: 'running', startedAt: '2026-10-25T00:00:00Z', result: null, error: null };
const finished: RunStatus = { ...running, status: 'done', result: { familyId: 'maya', runId: 'r1', receipt: { moneyBackCents: 0, likelyBenefitsCents: 0, deadlineCount: 0, nextDeadline: null, itemsChecked: 0 }, cards: [card('p1', 'recall')], banner: null } };

async function flush() { for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) await Promise.resolve(); }
beforeEach(() => { jest.useFakeTimers(); FakeES.last = null; });
afterEach(() => jest.useRealTimers());

function setup(responses: RunStatus[]) {
  let i = 0;
  const api: PollApi = { run: jest.fn(async () => responses[Math.min(i++, responses.length - 1)]), trace: jest.fn(async () => []) };
  const h = { onStream: jest.fn(), onStatus: jest.fn(), onDone: jest.fn(), onFailed: jest.fn(), onGiveUp: jest.fn() };
  return { api, h };
}

describe('followRun', () => {
  it('streams cards and pills without polling, then finishes through one poll when the stream ends', async () => {
    const { api, h } = setup([finished]);
    followRun('r1', api, h, { EventSourceCtor: ES });
    const es = FakeES.last!;
    expect(es.url).toBe('/api/runs/r1/events');
    es.emit('agent_status', ev({ type: 'agent_status', agent: 'recall', state: 'working' }, 1));
    es.emit('card_ready', ev({ type: 'card_ready', card: card('p1', 'recall') }, 2));
    const last = h.onStream.mock.calls[h.onStream.mock.calls.length - 1][0];
    expect(last.cards.map((c: FeedCard) => c.id)).toEqual(['p1']);
    expect(pillLines(last).map((p) => p.text)).toEqual(['Checking recalls…']);
    expect(api.run).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    es.emit('end', {});
    await flush();
    expect(es.closed).toBe(true);
    expect(h.onDone).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(h.onDone.mock.calls[0][0].result.cards.map((c: FeedCard) => c.id)).toEqual(['p1']); // final state = polled result
  });

  it('also reads default "message" events that carry the type inside the data', () => {
    const { api, h } = setup([running]);
    followRun('r1', api, h, { EventSourceCtor: ES });
    FakeES.last!.onmessage?.({ data: JSON.stringify(ev({ type: 'card_ready', card: card('m1', 'benefit') })) });
    expect(h.onStream.mock.calls.pop()![0].cards).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('a stream error closes it and polling resumes', async () => {
    const { api, h } = setup([running, finished]);
    followRun('r1', api, h, { EventSourceCtor: ES, intervalMs: 1000 });
    expect(api.run).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    FakeES.last!.fail();
    expect(FakeES.last!.closed).toBe(true);
    await flush();
    expect(api.run).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    jest.advanceTimersByTime(1000); await flush();
    expect(h.onDone).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('polls straight away when the browser has no EventSource', async () => {
    const { api, h } = setup([finished]);
    followRun('r1', api, h, { EventSourceCtor: null });
    await flush();
    expect(h.onDone).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('falls back to polling if the stream goes quiet', async () => {
    const { api, h } = setup([finished]);
    followRun('r1', api, h, { EventSourceCtor: ES });
    jest.advanceTimersByTime(STREAM_STALL_MS + 10);
    await flush();
    expect(FakeES.last!.closed).toBe(true);
    expect(h.onDone).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('the stop function closes the stream and stops everything', async () => {
    const { api, h } = setup([running]);
    const stop = followRun('r1', api, h, { EventSourceCtor: ES });
    stop();
    expect(FakeES.last!.closed).toBe(true);
    FakeES.last!.fail();
    await flush();
    expect(api.run).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('ignores garbage data without breaking', () => {
    const { api, h } = setup([running]);
    followRun('r1', api, h, { EventSourceCtor: ES });
    expect(() => FakeES.last!.listeners['card_ready'][0]({ data: 'not json' })).not.toThrow();

});

afterEach(() => { try { localStorage.clear(); } catch { /* ignore */ } });

describe('tabs and cards', () => {
  it('has the five Version B tabs in order', () => {
    expect(TABS.map((t) => t.label)).toEqual(['Home', 'Taxes', 'Savings', 'Insurance', 'Deals']);
  });

  it('sends every real card of a sample run to one tab (or none for coming-soon tiles)', () => {
    const { result } = sampleRun('maya');
    const by = (tab: string) => result.cards.filter((c) => tabForCard(c) === tab).map((c) => c.id);
    // database serial ids change on re-seed, so find the real card by kind/prefix
    const fsaId = result.cards.find((c) => c.id.startsWith('clawback-fsa-'))!.id;
    expect(by('taxes')).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['benefit-federal_child_tax_credit', 'benefit-ma_child_tax_credit', 'benefit-dcfsa_life_event']));
    expect(by('insurance')).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['benefit-insurance_add_baby', 'benefit-ma_pfml']));
    expect(by('savings')).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['benefit-trump_account', fsaId, 'recall-cpsc-10560']));
    expect(by('deals').every((id) => id.startsWith('discount-'))).toBe(true);
    expect(by('deals').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const c of result.cards.filter((x) => x.kind === 'coming_soon')) expect(tabForCard(c)).toBeNull();
    // nothing is lost: every card is either on a tab or a coming-soon tile
    expect(result.cards.filter((c) => c.kind !== 'coming_soon' && tabForCard(c) === null)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('knows the Dependent Care FSA and paid-leave cards are "Check with your job"', () => {
    expect(isCheckWithJob(card('benefit-dcfsa_life_event', 'benefit', { verdict: 'info' }))).toBe(true);
    expect(isCheckWithJob(card('benefit-ma_pfml', 'benefit'))).toBe(true);
    expect(isCheckWithJob(card('benefit-trump_account', 'benefit', { amountCents: 100000 }))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('tells expecting from baby-is-here by the date the family gave', () => {
    expect(stageOf(sampleRun('leo').family)).toBe('expecting');
    expect(stageOf(sampleRun('maya').family)).toBe('born');
    expect(stageOf(undefined)).toBe('born');
  });
});

    const { result } = sampleRun('maya');
    const t = homeTotals(result);
    expect(t.totalCents).toBe(result.receipt.moneyBackCents + result.receipt.likelyBenefitsCents);
    const gifts = result.cards.filter((c) => c.kind === 'discount' && c.verdict !== 'info').reduce((a, c) => a + (c.valueScore?.trueValueCents ?? c.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
    expect(t.giftsCents).toBe(gifts);

// Small browser-side helpers for the Account tab: the plan's optional name, "Start over", "Forget everything", and a hand-off
// that lets another tab open one answer's editor on the Account tab (the Insurance tab's "Change" link).

// ---------- "Save your plan": an optional name, kept on this device ----------

export interface PlanInfo { name: string | null; /** the parent tapped "Not now" */ hidden: boolean }
const planKey = (familyId: string) => `bundle:plan:${familyId}`;

export function loadPlan(familyId: string): PlanInfo {
  try {
    const p = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(planKey(familyId)) ?? '{}') as Partial<PlanInfo>;
    return { name: typeof p.name === 'string' && p.name.trim() ? p.name.trim().slice(0, 40) : null, hidden: !!p.hidden };
  } catch { return { name: null, hidden: false }; }
}

export function savePlan(familyId: string, plan: PlanInfo): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(planKey(familyId), JSON.stringify(plan)); } catch { /* storage blocked: lasts until the page closes */ }
}

// ---------- Start over ----------

/** Set by "Start over" so the opening screen shows the questions even though a saved profile exists. */
export const START_OVER_KEY = 'bundle:start-over';
export function markStartOver(): void { try { sessionStorage.setItem(START_OVER_KEY, '1'); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
/** True when "Start over" was just tapped. Reading it does not clear it: React may read twice while a screen opens, so the screen clears it with `clearStartOver` in an effect. */
export function peekStartOver(): boolean {
  try { return sessionStorage.getItem(START_OVER_KEY) === '1'; } catch { return false; }
}
export function clearStartOver(): void { try { sessionStorage.removeItem(START_OVER_KEY); } catch { /* ignore */ } }

// ---------- Forget everything: the browser's side ----------

/** Clears everything this browser saved: localStorage, and this tab's remembered runs, tabs and scroll spots. */
export function clearBrowserData(): void {
  try { localStorage.clear(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  try {
    for (const k of Object.keys(sessionStorage)) {
      if (/^bundle:(run:|last$|tab:|scroll:|start-over$)/.test(k)) sessionStorage.removeItem(k);
    }
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

// ---------- Open one answer's editor on the Account tab ----------

export type EditKey = 'stage' | 'date' | 'zip' | 'work' | 'insurance';
let pendingEdit: EditKey | null = null;
export function askEdit(k: EditKey): void { pendingEdit = k; }
/** Which editor was asked for. Reading it does not clear it (React may read twice); call `clearEdit` in an effect. */
export function peekEdit(): EditKey | null { return pendingEdit; }
export function clearEdit(): void { pendingEdit = null; }

import type { BundleResult, FeedCard, CardKind, Household, InsuranceType, Source, Verdict, WorkStatus } from '@shared/bundle';

/** One line of the agents' audit trail, as served by GET /api/runs/:runId/trace. */
export interface TraceLine {
  timestamp: string;
  trace_id: string;
  agent_name: string;
  action: string;
  input_summary: string;
  output_summary: string;
  target_agent: string | null;
  confidence: number | null;
  retry_count: number;
  status: 'ok' | 'retry' | 'blocked' | 'fallback' | 'error';
}

export interface FamilyView {
  name: string; birthDate: string | null; dueDate: string | null;
  /** 2-letter state from the ZIP, when the server sends it */
  state?: string;
  /** The ZIP the family gave (shown on the Account tab; absent on older saved runs). */
  zip?: string;
  /** The parent's Q4 and Q5 answers (null = prefer not to say; absent on runs saved before V2). */
  household?: Household | null; parent1Work?: WorkStatus | null; parent2Work?: WorkStatus | null; insurance?: InsuranceType | null;
  /** True when the family has saved purchases to check (the recall line on the checking screen shows only then). */
  hasItems?: boolean;
}

export interface RunStatus {
  runId: string;
  familyId: string;
  status: 'running' | 'done' | 'failed';
  startedAt: string;
  family?: FamilyView;
  today?: string;
  /** true for the sample families, which are evaluated at a fixed demo date */
  demoDate?: boolean;
  result: BundleResult | null;
  error: string | null;
}

// ---------- money and dates ----------

/** 2899 -> "$28.99". Cards always show cents so amounts are exact. */
export function fmtUsd(cents: number): string {
  return (cents / 100).toLocaleString('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' });
}

/** Receipt headline numbers: drop ".00" so big totals read cleanly ("$3,640", "$48.99"). */
export function fmtUsdShort(cents: number): string {
  const whole = cents % 100 === 0;
  return (cents / 100).toLocaleString('en-US', {
    style: 'currency', currency: 'USD',
    minimumFractionDigits: whole ? 0 : 2, maximumFractionDigits: whole ? 0 : 2,
  });
}

export function localToday(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

const dayMs = 86_400_000;
const utc = (iso: string) => Date.parse(`${iso}T00:00:00Z`);

/** Whole days from today to an ISO date (negative when it has passed). */
export function daysUntil(iso: string, today: string = localToday()): number {
  return Math.round((utc(iso) - utc(today)) / dayMs);
}

/** "2026-11-02" -> "Nov 2" (adds the year when it is not this year's). */
export function fmtDate(iso: string, today: string = localToday()): string {
  const sameYear = iso.slice(0, 4) === today.slice(0, 4);
  return new Date(`${iso}T00:00:00Z`).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', ...(sameYear ? {} : { year: 'numeric' }), timeZone: 'UTC' });
}

/** Deadlines within this many days are shown as a countdown in coral; later ones as a calm date. */
export const URGENT_DAYS = 30;

export function deadlineText(iso: string, today?: string): string {
  const d = daysUntil(iso, today);
  if (d < 0) return `Closed ${fmtDate(iso, today)}`;
  if (d === 0) return 'Due today';
  if (d === 1) return '1 day left';
  return `${d} days left`;
}

/**
 * Header chip, e.g. "Baby Maya · day 20" or "Leo · due in 45 days" for a sample family. A family the parent typed in is
 * "Your family · day 20" / "Your family · due in 45 days": onboarding never asks for a name, so none is shown (never "Baby Guest").
 * Typed in = a saved `guest-` id, or a name that is not a sample family's.
 */
export function familyChip(f: FamilyView | undefined, today?: string, familyId?: string): string | null {
  return familyChipParts(f, today, familyId)?.full ?? null;
}

/** The chip in two sizes: `short` is just who it is ("Maya", "Your family"), for a narrow phone header; `full` adds the stage. */
export function familyChipParts(f: FamilyView | undefined, today?: string, familyId?: string): { short: string; full: string } | null {
  if (!f) return null;
  const typedIn = (familyId !== undefined && /^guest-/.test(familyId)) || !/\(sample family\)\s*$/i.test(f.name ?? '');
  const first = f.name.replace(/\s*\(.*\)\s*$/, '').trim() || 'Baby';
  const short = typedIn ? 'Your family' : first;
  if (f.birthDate) return { short, full: `${typedIn ? 'Your family' : `Baby ${first}`} · day ${Math.max(0, -daysUntil(f.birthDate, today))}` };
  if (f.dueDate) {
    const d = daysUntil(f.dueDate, today);
    return { short, full: d > 0 ? `${short} · due in ${d} days` : `${short} · due now` };
  }
  return { short, full: short };
}

/** "Demo date: Oct 23, 2026" for the sample families (they run at a fixed date), otherwise null. */
export function demoDateLabel(demoDate: boolean | undefined, today: string | undefined): string | null {
  if (!demoDate || !today || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(today)) return null;
  return `Demo date: ${new Date(`${today}T00:00:00Z`).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' })}`;
}

// ---------- cards ----------

export const KIND_META: Record<CardKind, { label: string; section: string; dot: string; text: string }> = {
  clawback: { label: 'Money back', section: 'Money back', dot: 'bg-kind-clawback', text: 'text-kind-clawback' },
  recall: { label: 'Recall', section: 'Safety check', dot: 'bg-kind-recall', text: 'text-kind-recall' },
  benefit: { label: 'Benefit', section: 'Benefits', dot: 'bg-coral', text: 'text-coral-deep' },
  discount: { label: 'Discount', section: 'Deals whose fine print checks out', dot: 'bg-kind-discount', text: 'text-kind-discount' },
  coming_soon: { label: 'Coming soon', section: 'Coming soon', dot: 'bg-ink-3', text: 'text-ink-2' },
};

export const VERDICT_LABEL: Record<Verdict, string> = {
  verified: 'Verified',
  likely: 'Likely eligible',
  all_clear: 'All clear',
  info: 'Not yet verified',
  blocked: 'Blocked',
};

/** Only http(s) links are rendered, so a bad source URL (e.g. "javascript:") can never become a clickable link. */
export const safeSources = (sources: Source[]): Source[] => sources.filter((s) => /^https?:\/\//i.test(s.url));

export const isDcfsa = (c: FeedCard) => c.id.startsWith('clawback-dcfsa');
/** Work-based items we cannot see: the Dependent Care FSA and paid family leave. They get the gentle "Check with your job" card (no dollar amount, never in a total). */
export const isCheckWithJob = (c: FeedCard) => c.kind === 'benefit' && /^benefit-(dcfsa|.+_pfml?$|.+_pfl$)/.test(c.id);
/** The insurance card is pinned first only when it was actually checked; a "Not yet verified" stand-in is not promoted. */
export const isInsurance = (c: FeedCard) => c.kind === 'benefit' && /insurance/i.test(c.id) && c.verdict !== 'info';

/** The small word under a card amount. DCFSA is the family's own pre-tax money, so it is "eligible spend", never "money back". */
export function amountCaption(c: FeedCard): string | null {
  if (c.amountCents === null) return null;
  if (isCheckWithJob(c)) return null;
  if (c.verdict === 'info') return 'not yet verified';
  if (isDcfsa(c)) return 'eligible spend';
  if (c.kind === 'clawback') return 'money back';
  if (c.kind === 'benefit') return 'likely benefit';
  if (c.kind === 'discount') return 'savings';
  return null;
}

const ORDER: CardKind[] = ['clawback', 'recall', 'benefit', 'discount', 'coming_soon'];

/** Section title for deals that never went through Fine Print Court (bundled stand-ins shown when the court could not run). */
export const UNCHECKED_DEALS_SECTION = 'Offers we haven’t checked yet';

export interface CardGroup { kind: CardKind; cards: FeedCard[]; /** true = offers the court has not checked */ unchecked?: boolean }

/**
 * Pinned insurance card first, then groups in the fixed order clawback, recall, benefit, discount, coming_soon.
 * Discounts the court did not check (verdict "info") get their own group and title, never "passed Fine Print Court".
 */
export function groupCards(cards: FeedCard[]): { pinned: FeedCard | null; groups: CardGroup[] } {
  const pinned = cards.find(isInsurance) ?? null;
  const rest = cards.filter((c) => c !== pinned);
  const groups: CardGroup[] = [];
  for (const kind of ORDER) {
    if (kind === 'discount') {
      const checked = rest.filter((c) => c.kind === 'discount' && c.verdict !== 'info');
      const unchecked = rest.filter((c) => c.kind === 'discount' && c.verdict === 'info');
      if (checked.length) groups.push({ kind, cards: checked });
      if (unchecked.length) groups.push({ kind, cards: unchecked, unchecked: true });
    } else {
      const inKind = rest.filter((c) => c.kind === kind);
      if (inKind.length) groups.push({ kind, cards: inKind });
    }
  }
  return { pinned, groups };
}

// ---------- trace ----------

const AGENT_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  orchestrator: 'Orchestrator',
  clawback: 'Clawback Finder',
  recall: 'Recall Checker',
  benefits: 'Benefits Planner',
  fine_print_court: 'Fine print check',
  deal_hunter: 'Deal Hunter',
  fine_print_lawyer: 'Fine Print Lawyer',
  judge: 'Judge',
  fact_checker: 'Fact-Checker',
  memory: 'Memory',
  zetaris: 'Zetaris',
  fallback: 'Saved copy',
};

/** Deadline line for a card: a countdown when it is close, otherwise "By Oct 3, 2027" / "Ends Oct 3, 2027". */
export function cardDeadline(kind: CardKind, iso: string, today: string = localToday()): { text: string; urgent: boolean } {
  const d = daysUntil(iso, today);
  if (d <= URGENT_DAYS) return { text: deadlineText(iso, today), urgent: true };
  return { text: `${kind === 'discount' ? 'Ends' : 'By'} ${fmtDate(iso, today)}`, urgent: false };
}

export function agentLabel(name: string): string {
  return AGENT_LABEL[name] ?? name.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, (m) => m.toUpperCase());
}

const clip = (s: string, n = 90) => (s.length > n ? `${s.slice(0, n - 1)}…` : s);

/** A short plain-English sentence for one trace line (used in the live progress list). */
export function describeLine(l: TraceLine): string {
  const who = agentLabel(l.agent_name);
  if (l.status === 'fallback' && /model unavailable|no model answer/i.test(l.output_summary)) return `${who} used its backup check (AI offline)`;
  if (l.action === 'start') return 'Started your Bundle';
  if (l.action === 'retry_transient') return `A data source was slow, so we asked again (${l.input_summary})`;
  if (l.agent_name === 'fact_checker') {
    const kind = l.input_summary.split(' ')[0] || 'a';
    if (l.status === 'ok') return `Fact-Checker confirmed a ${kind} card`;
    if (l.status === 'retry') return `Fact-Checker sent 1 back: ${clip(l.output_summary, 70)}`;
    return `Fact-Checker dropped a ${kind} card: ${clip(l.output_summary, 60)}`;
  }
  if (l.agent_name === 'memory' && l.action === 'rule_recalled') {
    const [id, conf] = l.output_summary.split('|');
    const pct = Number.isFinite(Number(conf)) && conf !== '' ? ` (${Math.round(Number(conf) * 100)}%)` : '';
    return id ? `Memory recalled rule ${id}${pct}` : 'Memory recalled a rule';
  }
  if (l.agent_name === 'judge') return `Judge ruled on ${l.input_summary}: ${clip(l.output_summary.split(':')[0], 40)}`;
  if (l.action === 'explain') return `${who} wrote a plain-English explanation`;
  if (l.action === 'assemble') return `Built your feed: ${l.output_summary}`;
  return `${who}: ${clip(l.output_summary)}`;
}

/** The trace lines that belong to one card: its own line, the explanation just before it, court arguments, and the Fact-Checker's verdicts. */
export function traceForCard(card: FeedCard, lines: TraceLine[]): TraceLine[] {
  const keep = new Set<string>();
  const own = lines.findIndex((l) => l.trace_id === card.traceId);
  if (own >= 0) {
    keep.add(lines[own].trace_id);
    const prev = lines[own - 1];
    if (prev && prev.agent_name === lines[own].agent_name && prev.action === 'explain') keep.add(prev.trace_id);
  }
  const offerId = card.kind === 'discount' ? card.id.replace(/^(?:discount|blocked)-/, '') : null;
  for (const l of lines) {
    if (l.agent_name === 'fact_checker' && l.input_summary.includes(`card ${card.id} `)) keep.add(l.trace_id);
    if (offerId && l.input_summary === `offer ${offerId}`) keep.add(l.trace_id);
  }
  return lines.filter((l) => keep.has(l.trace_id));
}

// ---------- API ----------

async function json<T>(res: Response): Promise<T> {
  const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = new Error((body as { error?: string }).error || `Something went wrong (${res.status}).`) as Error & { status: number };
    err.status = res.status;
    throw err;
  }
  return body as T;
}

/** The answers from onboarding. Q4 and Q5 are left out when the parent chose "prefer not to say". */
export type RunRequest = { familyId: string } | {
  /** A saved family's id: the answers below then replace that family's answers (the check re-runs for the same family). */
  familyId?: string;
  zip: string; birthDate?: string; dueDate?: string; employer?: string;
  household?: Household; parent1Work?: WorkStatus; parent2Work?: WorkStatus; insurance?: InsuranceType;
};

/** localStorage key holding the id of the family saved at the end of onboarding. */
export const FAMILY_ID_KEY = 'bundle_family_id';
export function rememberFamilyId(id: string): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(FAMILY_ID_KEY, id); } catch { /* storage blocked: the run still works */ }
}
/** The saved family's id in this browser, or null. */
export function savedFamilyId(): string | null {
  try { const id = localStorage.getItem(FAMILY_ID_KEY); return id && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}$/.test(id) ? id : null; } catch { return null; }
}

/** The finished run in a server reply, in the shape the screens keep. */
export function runFromStatus(s: RunStatus): SavedRun | null {
  return s.status === 'done' && s.result ? { runId: s.runId, familyId: s.familyId, family: s.family, today: s.today, demoDate: s.demoDate, result: s.result } : null;
}

/** What Bundle remembers about a family, and what it has learned from parents (the Account tab). */
export interface FamilyMemoryItem { id: string; text: string; source: string; savedOn: string }
export interface LearnedMemoryItem { id: string; text: string; reports: number | null }
export interface FamilyMemory { family: FamilyMemoryItem[]; learned: LearnedMemoryItem[] }

/** A server reply read defensively: anything that is not the expected shape counts as "nothing yet". */
export function readFamilyMemory(raw: unknown): FamilyMemory {
  const o = (raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const list = (v: unknown): Record<string, unknown>[] => (Array.isArray(v) ? v.filter((x) => x && typeof x === 'object') as Record<string, unknown>[] : []);
  return {
    family: list(o.family).filter((m) => typeof m.text === 'string').map((m) => ({ id: String(m.id ?? ''), text: String(m.text), source: String(m.source ?? 'setup'), savedOn: String(m.savedOn ?? '') })),
    learned: list(o.learned).filter((m) => typeof m.text === 'string').map((m) => ({ id: String(m.id ?? ''), text: String(m.text), reports: typeof m.reports === 'number' ? m.reports : null })),
  };
}

export const api = {
  startRun: (body: RunRequest) =>
    fetch('/api/run', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) }).then((r) => json<{ runId: string; familyId?: string }>(r)),
  run: (runId: string) => fetch(`/api/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`).then((r) => json<RunStatus>(r)),
  /** Newest saved result for a family (the instant feed). Rejects with the server's message (404) when there is none yet. */
  latestRun: (familyId: string) => fetch(`/api/families/${encodeURIComponent(familyId)}/latest-run`).then((r) => json<RunStatus>(r)),
  memory: (familyId: string) => fetch(`/api/families/${encodeURIComponent(familyId)}/memory`).then((r) => json<unknown>(r)).then(readFamilyMemory),
  /** "Forget everything": the server deletes the family, claims, photos, runs and memory entries. */
  forgetFamily: (familyId: string) =>
    fetch(`/api/families/${encodeURIComponent(familyId)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }).then((r) => json<{ ok: true }>(r)),
  trace: (runId: string) => fetch(`/api/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}/trace`).then((r) => json<TraceLine[]>(r)),
  feedback: (body: { familyId: string; cardId: string; kind: 'got_it' | 'issue' | 'not_relevant'; note?: string }) =>
    fetch('/api/feedback', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) }).then((r) => json<{ ok: true; proposals: unknown[] }>(r)),
  /** Take back an "I got this" or "Not relevant" on the server (the browser has already put the card back). */
  undoClaim: (body: { familyId: string; cardId: string }) =>
    fetch('/api/claims/undo', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) }).then((r) => json<{ ok: true }>(r)),
  caseLaw: () => fetch('/api/case-law').then((r) => json<{ proposals: Proposal[]; approved: Proposal[] }>(r)),
  approve: (id: number, token: string) =>
    fetch(`/api/case-law/${id}/approve`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'x-reviewer-token': token } }).then((r) => json<{ ok: true }>(r)),
  scoreboard: () => fetch('/api/scoreboard').then((r) => json<{ scoreboard: Scoreboard | null }>(r)),
};

export interface Proposal {
  id: number; text: string; confidence: number; sourceFeedbackIds: string[];
  status: 'proposed' | 'approved' | 'rejected'; memoryId: string | null;
}

export interface Scoreboard {
  trapsCaught: number; trapsTotal: number; falseAlarms: number; sourcedPct: number; runs: number; stable: boolean;
  learning?: { run1Approved: boolean; run2Blocked: boolean; citedRuleId: string | null };
  llm?: string;
}

// ---------- remembered runs (this tab only) ----------

const safe = <T,>(fn: () => T, fallback: T): T => { try { return fn(); } catch { return fallback; } };

export interface SavedRun { runId: string; familyId: string; family?: FamilyView; today?: string; demoDate?: boolean; result: BundleResult }

export function saveRun(r: SavedRun): void {
  safe(() => {
    sessionStorage.setItem(`bundle:run:${r.runId}`, JSON.stringify(r));
    sessionStorage.setItem('bundle:last', r.runId);
  }, undefined);
}

export function loadRun(runId?: string | null): SavedRun | null {
  return safe(() => {
    const id = runId || sessionStorage.getItem('bundle:last');
    if (!id) return null;
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(`bundle:run:${id}`);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as SavedRun) : null;
  }, null);
}

export const reviewerToken = {
  get: () => safe(() => sessionStorage.getItem('bundle:reviewerToken') ?? '', ''),
  set: (t: string) => safe(() => (t ? sessionStorage.setItem('bundle:reviewerToken', t) : sessionStorage.removeItem('bundle:reviewerToken')), undefined),
};

/**
 * The parent's "We're checking for you" lines, built from what the family told us. A line shows only when the run really does
 * that check (design/v2 and plans/v2-feedback-response.md, "Checking screen"):
 *  - the recall line only when the family has items to check;
 *  - the daycare line follows the daycare rule (FSA, childcare credit, general rules, or no line at all).
 */
import { daycareRoute } from '@shared/eligibility';
import type { FamilyView } from './bundle';

export interface CheckLine {
  key: string;
  title: string;
  caption: string;
  /** The last line is "double-checked": it only shows once the run has really finished. */
  final?: boolean;
}

/** The first line shows this long after the family is known, then one more line every LINE_GAP_MS. */
export const FIRST_LINE_MS = 600;
export const LINE_GAP_MS = 1300;

export function checkLines(family?: FamilyView): CheckLine[] {
  const lines: CheckLine[] = [
    { key: 'benefits', title: 'State and federal family benefits', caption: 'Based on your ZIP and baby’s age' },
    { key: 'insurance', title: 'Insurance deadline to add your baby', caption: family?.insurance ? 'Based on your insurance' : 'Based on the usual deadlines' },
  ];
  const route = daycareRoute(family ?? {});
  if (route === 'dcfsa') {
    lines.push({ key: 'daycare', title: 'Daycare tax savings and Dependent Care FSA', caption: family?.household === 'one' ? 'Based on how you earn' : 'Based on how each of you earns' });
  } else if (route === 'childcare_credit') {
    lines.push({ key: 'daycare', title: 'Childcare tax credit', caption: 'Based on your self-employment' });
  } else if (route === 'general') {
    lines.push({ key: 'daycare', title: 'Daycare tax savings (general)', caption: 'We checked the general rules' });
  }
  lines.push({ key: 'gifts', title: 'Free registry gifts and welcome boxes', caption: 'Checked for your baby’s exact age' });
  if (family?.hasItems) lines.push({ key: 'recalls', title: 'Your items vs. official recall lists', caption: 'Shown because your family has items' });
  lines.push({ key: 'double_check', title: 'Every result double-checked against its official source', caption: 'A Fact-Checker re-reads each card', final: true });
  return lines;
}

/**
 * Adds the "Childcare tax credit" card for families where everyone who earns is self-employed (the daycare rule in
 * shared/eligibility.ts says `childcare_credit`). The other daycare answers need no card of their own: a paycheck gets the
 * server's "Dependent Care FSA: check with your job" card, and a parent not working gets none.
 * The card carries no dollar amount in the totals: "up to $1,500 for one child" is the credit's own ceiling, not a promise.
 */
import type { FeedCard } from '@shared/bundle';
import { daycareRoute } from '@shared/eligibility';
import type { FamilyView } from './bundle';

export const CHILDCARE_CREDIT_ID = 'benefit-childcare_tax_credit';

export function applyDaycareAnswer(cards: FeedCard[], family?: FamilyView): FeedCard[] {
  if (daycareRoute({ household: family?.household, parent1Work: family?.parent1Work, parent2Work: family?.parent2Work }) !== 'childcare_credit') return cards;
  if (cards.some((c) => c.id === CHILDCARE_CREDIT_ID)) return cards;
  const card: FeedCard = {
    id: CHILDCARE_CREDIT_ID, kind: 'benefit', title: 'Childcare tax credit',
    body: 'You are self-employed, so there is no work childcare account to use. The childcare tax credit can still give back up to $1,500 of daycare costs for one child. Ask your tax preparer to include it.',
    amountCents: null, deadline: null, verdict: 'info', category: 'info', traceId: 'client',
    sources: [{ label: 'IRS: Child and Dependent Care Credit', url: 'https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc602' }],
  };
  // Right after the Dependent Care FSA slot on the Taxes tab: the tax-credit cards first, then this one.
  const at = cards.findIndex((c) => c.id === 'benefit-dcfsa_life_event');
  return at === -1 ? [...cards, card] : [...cards.slice(0, at), card, ...cards.slice(at + 1)];
}

```
import type { FeedCard } from '@shared/bundle';
import { reviewerToken, type Proposal, type RunStatus, type Scoreboard, type TraceLine } from './bundle';

// ---------- owner view split (W1-OWNER) ----------
// The server trims what parents get; these helpers send the reviewer code so the owner gets the full view.

/** One "Checking" step in parent words, as served on GET /api/runs/:id (`progress`). */
export interface ParentStep { key: string; label: string; state: 'waiting' | 'working' | 'done' }
export type OwnerRunStatus = RunStatus & { progress?: ParentStep[]; owner?: boolean };

/** The reviewer code for this tab, or '' for a parent. */
export const ownerToken = (): string => reviewerToken.get();

export async function ownerJson<T>(url: string, token: string): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(url, token ? { headers: { 'x-reviewer-token': token } } : undefined);
  const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = new Error((body as { error?: string }).error || `Something went wrong (${res.status}).`) as Error & { status: number };
    err.status = res.status;
    throw err;
  }
  return body as T;
}

export interface CaseLaw { proposals: Proposal[]; approved: Proposal[]; proposedCount?: number; approvedCount?: number }

/** Run status and trace calls. A parent's trace call never reaches the server (it is owner-only there). */
export function ownerApi(token: string = ownerToken()) {
  return {
    run: (runId: string) => ownerJson<OwnerRunStatus>(`/api/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`, token),
    trace: (runId: string): Promise<TraceLine[]> =>
      token ? ownerJson<TraceLine[]>(`/api/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}/trace`, token) : Promise.reject(new Error('owner only')),
    /** Parents get counts only; the reviewer code adds rule text and proposals. */
    caseLaw: () => ownerJson<CaseLaw>('/api/case-law', token),
    /** Owner-only on the server (403 without the code), so a parent never asks. */
    scoreboard: (): Promise<{ scoreboard: Scoreboard | null }> =>
      token ? ownerJson<{ scoreboard: Scoreboard | null }>('/api/scoreboard', token) : Promise.reject(new Error('owner only')),
  };
}

/** Plain-English names for the tables Zetaris reads. Order = display order. */
const SOURCE_NAMES: { re: RegExp; name: string }[] = [
  { re: /\bv_planner_family\b/i, name: 'Your family profile (private, Neon)' },
  { re: /\bv_purchase_items\b|\bv_recall_orders\b|\bv_clawback_tx\b/i, name: 'Your purchases (private, Neon)' },
  { re: /\bcpsc_recalls\b/i, name: 'CPSC recall list (live government feed)' },
  { re: /\bfda_food_recalls\b/i, name: 'openFDA food recalls' },
  { re: /\bbenefit_rules\b/i, name: 'Program rules' },
  { re: /\bv_judge_offers\b/i, name: 'Offers' },
  { re: /\bfsa_eligible_categories\b/i, name: 'FSA eligibility list' },
  { re: /\bstore_policies\b/i, name: 'Store price-adjustment policies' },
  { re: /\bprice_observations\b/i, name: 'Observed prices' },
];

/** Which plain-English sources a SQL statement reads. Unknown tables are left out (never guessed). */
export function sourceNames(sql: string): string[] {
  return SOURCE_NAMES.filter((s) => s.re.test(sql)).map((s) => s.name);
}

/** SQL safe to show: string literals become '?', and any income column is hidden. */
export function redactSql(sql: string): string {
  return sql
    .replace(/'(?:[^']|'')*'?/g, "'?'")
    .replace(/\b\w*income\w*\b/gi, '[hidden]')
    .replace(/(?<![\w.])\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?![\w.])/g, '?');
}

const esc = (s: string) => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

/** Patterns that tie a Zetaris query to ONE card, from the card's own id. Empty when we cannot tell. */
function cardKeyPatterns(card: FeedCard): RegExp[] {
  const id = card.id;
  let m: RegExpMatchArray | null;
  if ((m = id.match(/^recall-cpsc-(\d+)$/))) return [new RegExp(`cpsc_recalls\\b[^;]*\\bRecallID\\s*=\\s*${m[1]}\\b`, 'i')];
  if ((m = id.match(/^(?:discount|blocked)-(\d+)$/))) return [new RegExp(`v_judge_offers\\s+WHERE\\s+id\\s*=\\s*${m[1]}\\b`, 'i')];
  if ((m = id.match(/^benefit-(.+)$/))) return [new RegExp(`benefit_rules\\s+WHERE\\s+code\\s*=\\s*'${esc(m[1])}'`, 'i')];
  // The Fact-Checker re-reads the purchase row by id: the FSA check reads `v_purchase_items WHERE id = N`, the price-drop
  // check joins the store policy and price tables and reads `WHERE p.id = N` (re-verified against factChecker.ts).
  if ((m = id.match(/^clawback-fsa-(.+)$/))) return [new RegExp(`v_purchase_items\\s+WHERE\\s+id\\s*=\\s*${esc(m[1])}\\b`, 'i')];
  if ((m = id.match(/^clawback-price-(.+)$/))) return [new RegExp(`v_purchase_items\\s+p\\s+JOIN\\b[^;]*\\bWHERE\\s+p\\.id\\s*=\\s*${esc(m[1])}\\b`, 'i')];
  return [];
}

/** Run-wide queries a whole kind of card is built from (looked up by table, never by position). */
function kindOriginPatterns(card: FeedCard): RegExp[] {
  switch (card.kind) {
    case 'recall': return [/\bitem_text\b[^]*\bv_purchase_items\b/i]; // recall queries name item_text; money-back queries name item
    // The run-wide money-back queries (clawback.ts): the FSA list joins the FSA table; the price query is the only one comparing prices.
    case 'clawback':
      if (/^clawback-fsa-/.test(card.id)) return [/\bfsa_eligible_categories\b/i];
      if (/^clawback-price-/.test(card.id)) return [/\bpo\.price_cents\s*<\s*p\.price_cents\b/i];
      return [];
    case 'discount': return [/\bv_judge_offers\s+ORDER\s+BY\b/i];
    case 'benefit': return [/\bbenefit_rules\s+ORDER\s+BY\b/i];
    default: return [];
  }
}

export interface ZetarisView {
  sources: string[];
  queries: number;
  ms: number | null;
  saved: boolean;
  sql: string[];
}

/** What Zetaris did for this card. Null when no query can be tied to it (we show nothing then). */
export function zetarisForCard(card: FeedCard, lines: TraceLine[]): ZetarisView | null {
  const keys = cardKeyPatterns(card);
  const origin = kindOriginPatterns(card);
  if (keys.length + origin.length === 0) return null;
  const hits = lines.filter((l) => l.agent_name === 'zetaris' && l.status !== 'error'
    && /^query/.test(l.action) && [...keys, ...origin].some((re) => re.test(l.input_summary)));
  if (hits.length === 0) return null;
  const sources = [...new Set(hits.flatMap((l) => sourceNames(l.input_summary)))];
  if (sources.length === 0) return null;
  const saved = hits.every((l) => l.action === 'query_cached');
  const live = hits.map((l) => /in (\d+) ms/.exec(l.output_summary)?.[1]).filter((x): x is string => !!x).map(Number);
  const ms = saved || live.length === 0 ? null : live.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const sql = [...new Set(hits.map((l) => redactSql(l.input_summary) + (l.input_summary.length >= 200 ? ' …' : '')))];
  return { sources, queries: hits.length, ms, saved, sql };
}

export interface MemoryRuleView { id: string; text: string; confidence: number; reports: number; cited: boolean }

/** Learned rules recalled for a discount card's offer (from the memory lines the court logs). */
export function memoryForCard(card: FeedCard, lines: TraceLine[]): MemoryRuleView[] {
  const m = card.id.match(/^(?:discount|blocked)-(\d+)$/);
  if (!m) return [];
  const cited = new Set<string>();
  for (const l of lines) {
    if (l.agent_name === 'judge' && l.input_summary === `offer ${m[1]}`) {
      for (const c of l.output_summary.matchAll(/\[cited ([^\]]+)\]/g)) c[1].split(',').forEach((x) => cited.add(x.trim()));
    }
  }
  const out = new Map<string, MemoryRuleView>();
  for (const l of lines) {
    if (l.agent_name !== 'memory' || l.action !== 'rule_recalled' || l.input_summary !== `offer ${m[1]}`) continue;
    const parts = l.output_summary.split('|');
    if (parts.length < 4) continue;
    const confidence = Number(parts[1]);
    const reports = Number(parts[2]);
    if (!parts[0] || !Number.isFinite(confidence) || !Number.isFinite(reports)) continue;
    out.set(parts[0], { id: parts[0], text: parts.slice(3).join('|'), confidence, reports, cited: cited.has(parts[0]) });
  }
  return [...out.values()];
}

/** One plain line saying why the court blocked an offer. */
export function blockedReason(card: FeedCard): string {
  const one = card.body.replace(/^Court was offline;\s*/i, '').replace(/^case law applies:\s*/i, 'A rule parents taught us applies: ');
  const first = one.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s/)[0] ?? one;
  const text = first.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + first.slice(1);
  return text.length > 120 ? `${text.slice(0, 117)}…` : text;
}

/**
 * Makes the "Add your baby to health insurance" card follow the parent's Q5 answer (30 days for a job plan, 60 for the
 * marketplace, a year of automatic cover for Medicaid, 90 for TRICARE). The rules live in shared/eligibility.ts.
 * The server's card is built from one federal rule, so this rewrites its deadline and sentence on the way to the screen.
 */
import type { FeedCard } from '@shared/bundle';
import { insuranceDeadline, insuranceDeadlineDate } from '@shared/eligibility';
import type { FamilyView } from './bundle';

export const isAddBabyCard = (c: FeedCard): boolean => c.kind === 'benefit' && /^benefit-insurance_add_baby$/.test(c.id);

/** The cards with the insurance card's deadline and sentence matched to the insurance answer. No answer leaves the card as the server made it. */
export function applyInsuranceAnswer(cards: FeedCard[], family?: FamilyView): FeedCard[] {
  if (!family?.insurance) return cards;
  const info = insuranceDeadline(family.insurance, family.state);
  const base = family.birthDate ?? family.dueDate;
  return cards.map((c) => {
    if (!isAddBabyCard(c)) return c;
    return { ...c, deadline: insuranceDeadlineDate(family.insurance, base, family.state), body: info.detail };
  });
}

/** The tax year a new baby's credits go on: the baby's birth (or due) year, else the current year. */
export function taxYearFor(family: FamilyView | undefined, today: string): number {
  const iso = family?.birthDate ?? family?.dueDate ?? today;
  const y = Number(iso.slice(0, 4));
  return Number.isFinite(y) && y > 2000 ? y : new Date().getFullYear();
}

// Deals (Story 5): the live offer search, "Audit a deal", the offer report card, and the plain-English lines an offer card shows.
// Pure helpers plus three small server calls. Nothing here is typed-in data: every figure comes from the server's court result.
import type { FeedCard, FinePrintVerdict, OfferFacts } from '@shared/bundle';
import { OFFER_SITES_COUNT, type AuditReply, type AuditRequest, type LiveSearchReply, type ReportCardReply } from '@shared/offers';
import { fmtUsd, fmtUsdShort, type FamilyView } from './bundle';
import { daysUntil } from './bundle';
import { catchWord } from './tabs';

export { OFFER_SITES_COUNT };
/** The live search gives up after this long and quietly keeps the saved offers (R3). */
export const SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

// ---------- status line ----------

export const SEARCHING_LINE = `Searching ${OFFER_SITES_COUNT} trusted baby-offer sites for new offers…`;
export const NO_NEW_OFFERS_LINE = 'No new offers right now. Showing your checked offers.';
/** Shown briefly when Deals opens, then replaced by the real status line. */
export const SCANNING_LINE = 'Scanning verified offers for your ZIP code...';
export const SCAN_MS = 1400;

/** "Day 20" for a born baby, "due in 44 days" for an expecting family, otherwise null. */
export function babyDayLabel(f: FamilyView | undefined, today?: string): string | null {
  if (!f) return null;
  if (f.birthDate) return `Day ${Math.max(0, -daysUntil(f.birthDate, today))}`;
  if (f.dueDate) { const d = daysUntil(f.dueDate, today); return d > 0 ? `due in ${d} days` : 'due now'; }
  return null;
}

/** The practice-mode line: the real number of saved offers and the real day. */
export function checkingLine(offersOnFile: number | undefined, f: FamilyView | undefined, today?: string): string {
  const day = babyDayLabel(f, today);
  const n = typeof offersOnFile === 'number' ? `${offersOnFile} saved offer${offersOnFile === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : 'saved offers';
  return `Checking ${n} against your baby’s age${day ? ` (${day})` : ''}`;
}

export const foundLine = (sites: number, count: number): string =>
  `Searched ${sites} trusted baby-offer sites · ${count === 0 ? 'no new offers today' : `${count} new offer${count === 1 ? '' : 's'} found today`}`;

// ---------- the lines on an offer card (R5) ----------

const plural = (n: number, one: string, many: string) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

export interface FactLine { icon: string; text: string; note?: string; tone: 'good' | 'catch' | 'blocked' | 'plain' }

/** "Fine print: OK (no subscription traps, no hidden fees)", "Fine print: OK, with a catch: …" or "Fine print: Blocked: …". */
export function courtLine(f: OfferFacts): FactLine {
  const note = f.ruleCheckOnly ? 'Quick check only. Read the terms before you sign up.' : undefined;
  if (f.court === 'approve_with_catch') return { icon: '🛡️', text: `Fine print: OK, with a catch: ${f.catches.join('; ') || 'read the fine print'}`, tone: 'catch', note };
  if (f.court === 'reject') return { icon: '🛡️', text: `Fine print: Blocked: ${f.catches.join('; ') || 'a catch in the fine print'}`, tone: 'blocked', note };
  const traps = f.subscriptionTraps === 0 ? 'no subscription traps' : plural(f.subscriptionTraps, 'subscription trap', 'subscription traps');
  const fees = f.hiddenFeeCents === 0 ? 'no hidden fees' : `${fmtUsd(f.hiddenFeeCents)} hidden fees`;
  return { icon: '🛡️', text: `Fine print: OK (${traps}, ${fees})`, tone: 'good', note };
}

/** "About 5 minutes". The server's cautious (upper) estimate, said as a single number. */
export const minutesLine = (f: OfferFacts): FactLine => ({ icon: '⏱️', text: `About ${f.minutes} ${f.minutes === 1 ? 'minute' : 'minutes'}`, tone: 'plain' });

/** "True value $35", or an honest "no dollar amount stated" when neither the fine print nor the offer names one. */
export const valueLine = (f: OfferFacts): FactLine =>
  ({ icon: '💵', text: f.trueValueCents !== null ? `True value ${fmtUsdShort(f.trueValueCents)}` : 'True value not stated (no dollar amount in the offer)', tone: 'plain' });

/** "Matches your baby's exact age (Day 20)" — qualification in days, not a vague "up to 12 months". */
export function ageLine(f: OfferFacts): string | null {
  if (f.ageDays === null) return null;
  if (f.ageDays < 0) return `Matches your baby's exact age (due in ${plural(-f.ageDays, 'day', 'days')})`;
  return `Matches your baby's exact age (Day ${f.ageDays})`;
}

/** Store + "what you get" for a paste-only audit, so the server form is filled without extra boxes. */
export function guessAuditFields(text: string): { store: string; offer: string } {
  const t = text.toLowerCase();
  const store = /\bbabylist\b/.test(t) ? 'Babylist' : /\btarget\b/.test(t) ? 'Target' : /\bamazon\b/.test(t) ? 'Amazon' : 'Pasted offer';
  const first = text.split(/\n/)[0].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 200);
  return { store, offer: first.length >= 8 ? first : 'Pasted registry or store offer' };
}

export const factLines = (f: OfferFacts): FactLine[] => [courtLine(f), minutesLine(f), valueLine(f)];

/** Best first by what the offer is worth to the parent. Never by commission: no commission figure exists anywhere in the app. */
export function orderDeals(cards: FeedCard[]): FeedCard[] {
  const worth = (c: FeedCard) => c.offerFacts?.trueValueCents ?? c.valueScore?.trueValueCents ?? c.amountCents ?? -1;
  return cards.map((c, i) => ({ c, i })).sort((a, b) => worth(b.c) - worth(a.c) || a.i - b.i).map((x) => x.c);
}

const sameLink = (u: string) => u.replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?/i, '').replace(/[?#].*$/, '').replace(/\/+$/, '').toLowerCase();
/** New finds that are not already one of the saved offers (same page address or same title). */
export function onlyNew(found: FeedCard[], saved: FeedCard[]): FeedCard[] {
  const links = new Set(saved.flatMap((c) => c.sources.map((s) => sameLink(s.url))));
  const titles = new Set(saved.map((c) => c.title.trim().toLowerCase()));
  return found.filter((c) => !c.sources.some((s) => links.has(sameLink(s.url))) && !titles.has(c.title.trim().toLowerCase()));
}

// ---------- server calls ----------

export type SearchResult =
  | { kind: 'practice' }
  | { kind: 'live'; cards: FeedCard[]; sitesSearched: number }
  | { kind: 'quiet' };

/** Asks the live search. Every failure (no key, no internet, timeout, odd answer) comes back as 'quiet', never as an error. */
export async function searchOffers(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<SearchResult> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/offer-search', { signal });
    if (res.status === 404) return { kind: 'practice' }; // the server does not know the route: stay in practice mode
    if (!res.ok) return { kind: 'quiet' };
    const body = (await res.json()) as Partial<LiveSearchReply>;
    if (body.mode === 'practice') return { kind: 'practice' };
    if (body.mode === 'live' && Array.isArray(body.cards)) {
      const cards = body.cards.filter((c): c is FeedCard => !!c && typeof c.id === 'string' && typeof c.title === 'string' && Array.isArray(c.sources));
      return { kind: 'live', cards, sitesSearched: typeof body.sitesSearched === 'number' ? body.sitesSearched : OFFER_SITES_COUNT };
    }
    return { kind: 'quiet' };
  } catch { return { kind: 'quiet' }; }
}

export async function sendAudit(body: AuditRequest): Promise<AuditReply> {
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch('/api/offers/audit', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  } catch { throw new Error('We could not reach Bundle. Check your connection and try again.'); }
  const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<AuditReply> & { error?: string };
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error || 'We could not check that deal just now. Please try again.');
  if (!json.verdict || typeof json.summary !== 'string') throw new Error('We could not check that deal just now. Please try again.');
  return json as AuditReply;
}

/** The report card, or null when it is not available (it is simply left out then). */
export async function fetchReportCard(): Promise<ReportCardReply | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/offers/report-card');
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const body = (await res.json()) as Partial<ReportCardReply>;
    return body && body.status === 'found' && Array.isArray(body.brands) && body.brands.length ? (body as ReportCardReply) : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

export const verdictLabel: Record<FinePrintVerdict, string> = { approve: 'OK', approve_with_catch: 'OK, with a catch', reject: 'Blocked' };

/** A saved grading lesson ("… graded approve_with_catch …; catches: required_membership") in plain words, using the same labels as the offer cards. */
export function plainLesson(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(/\bgraded (approve_with_catch|approve|reject)\b/g, (_, v: FinePrintVerdict) => `graded ${verdictLabel[v].toLowerCase()}`)
    .replace(/\bcatches: ([a-z_]+(?:, [a-z_]+)*)/g, (_, list: string) => `catches: ${list.split(', ').map(catchWord).join(', ')}`);
}

export interface ZipState { code: string; name: string; covered: boolean }

export function stateForZip(zip: string): ZipState | null {
  if (!/^\d{5}$/.test(zip)) return null;
  const n = Number(zip.slice(0, 3));
  const hit = RANGES.find(([from, to]) => n >= from && n <= to);
  if (!hit) return null;
  const code = hit[2];
  return { code, name: NAMES[code], covered: (COVERED_STATES as readonly string[]).includes(code) };
}

/** Shown when the server turns down a ZIP this screen accepted (the server knows fewer states than the ZIP table). */
export function zipRejectedMessage(zip: string): string {
  const s = stateForZip(zip);
  return `We can’t check ${s ? s.name : 'your area'} yet. Try a sample family to see how it works.`;
}

/** The confirmation line under the ZIP box, or null until a full ZIP is typed. */
export function zipMessage(zip: string): string | null {
  if (!/^\d{5}$/.test(zip)) return null;
  const s = stateForZip(zip);
  if (s?.covered) return `Found it: showing ${s.name} programs plus federal ones`;
  const where = s ? `${s.name}: showing federal programs` : 'Showing federal programs';
  return `${where}. ${UNCOVERED_STATE_NOTE}.`;
}

/** "20 days old: some 30-day deadlines are still open", shown only while that is true. */
export function babyAgeLine(birthDate: string, today: string): string | null {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(birthDate)) return null;
  const days = Math.round((Date.parse(`${today}T00:00:00Z`) - Date.parse(`${birthDate}T00:00:00Z`)) / 86_400_000);
  if (days < 0 || days >= 30) return null;
  if (days === 0) return 'Born today: every 30-day deadline is still open';
  return `${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'} old: some 30-day deadlines are still open`;
}
