// Phone-side photo preparation. Before a photo leaves the phone it is redrawn onto a blank canvas and re-saved as a
// fresh JPEG: that throws away the hidden details inside every photo (EXIF: GPS location, time, phone model) and
// shrinks it so the upload is small and fast. The server never receives the original file.

export const MAX_SIDE = 1600;
export const JPEG_QUALITY = 0.85;
/** The biggest file we will even try to open on the phone. */
export const MAX_PICK_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024;
const OK_TYPES = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/heic', 'image/heif', 'image/webp'];

export function fitWithin(width: number, height: number, maxSide = MAX_SIDE): { width: number; height: number } {
  const longest = Math.max(width, height);
  if (longest <= maxSide) return { width, height };
  const scale = maxSide / longest;
  return { width: Math.max(1, Math.round(width * scale)), height: Math.max(1, Math.round(height * scale)) };
}

export function checkPickedFile(f: File): string | null {
  if (!OK_TYPES.includes(f.type)) return 'Please choose a photo (JPEG or PNG).';
  if (f.size > MAX_PICK_BYTES) return 'That photo is too big. Please take a new one.';
  return null;
}

/** The browser-only parts, swappable in tests. */
export interface PhotoCodec {
  decode(file: File): Promise<{ width: number; height: number; source?: unknown }>;
  /** Draws onto a new canvas of this size and returns JPEG as base64 (no "data:" prefix). */
  redrawAsJpeg(source: unknown, width: number, height: number, file: File): Promise<string>;
  /** A small picture (about 200 px on the long side) as a "data:image/jpeg;base64,..." address, drawn from the same decoded photo. Optional. */
  thumbnailJpeg?(source: unknown, width: number, height: number): Promise<string>;
}

/** The long side of the picture kept in the gear locker. */
export const THUMB_SIDE = 200;

export const browserCodec: PhotoCodec = {
  async decode(file) {
    const bmp = await createImageBitmap(file, { imageOrientation: 'from-image' });
    return { width: bmp.width, height: bmp.height, source: bmp };
  },
  async thumbnailJpeg(source, width, height) {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) throw new Error('no canvas');
    ctx.drawImage(source as CanvasImageSource, 0, 0, width, height);
    return canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7);
  },
  async redrawAsJpeg(source, width, height) {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) throw new Error('no canvas');
    ctx.drawImage(source as CanvasImageSource, 0, 0, width, height);
    (source as ImageBitmap).close?.();
    const url = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', JPEG_QUALITY);
    return url.slice(url.indexOf(',') + 1);
  },
};

export interface PreparedPhoto { mimeType: 'image/jpeg'; imageBase64: string; /** Small data-address picture for the gear locker (absent if the phone could not make one). */ thumbnail?: string }

export async function preparePhoto(file: File, codec: PhotoCodec = browserCodec): Promise<PreparedPhoto> {
  try {
    const decoded = await codec.decode(file);
    const { width, height } = fitWithin(decoded.width, decoded.height);
    // The small picture first: drawing the full-size one closes the decoded photo.
    let thumbnail: string | undefined;
    if (codec.thumbnailJpeg) {
      try { const t = fitWithin(decoded.width, decoded.height, THUMB_SIDE); thumbnail = await codec.thumbnailJpeg(decoded.source, t.width, t.height); } catch { thumbnail = undefined; }
    }
    const imageBase64 = await codec.redrawAsJpeg(decoded.source, width, height, file);
    return thumbnail ? { mimeType: 'image/jpeg', imageBase64, thumbnail } : { mimeType: 'image/jpeg', imageBase64 };
  } catch {
    throw new Error('We could not open that photo. Please try another one.');
  }
}

import type { RunStatus, TraceLine } from './bundle';

/** Consecutive failed polls allowed before the page says it lost touch (about 5 seconds at 1 poll per second). */
export const MAX_POLL_FAILURES = 5;

export interface PollApi {
  run: (runId: string) => Promise<RunStatus>;
  trace: (runId: string) => Promise<TraceLine[]>;
}

export interface PollHandlers {
  onStatus: (status: RunStatus, trace: TraceLine[] | null) => void;
  onDone: (status: RunStatus) => void;
  onFailed: (message: string) => void;
  /** kind 'expired' = the server no longer knows the run (404); 'lost' = MAX_POLL_FAILURES failures in a row. */
  onGiveUp: (kind: 'expired' | 'lost') => void;
}

/**
 * Poll a run every `intervalMs` until it is done or failed.
 * A 404 stops at once (the run is gone); other errors (network blips, 5xx, rate limits)
 * are retried, and only MAX_POLL_FAILURES failures in a row end the polling.
 * Returns a stop function.
 */
export function pollRun(runId: string, api: PollApi, h: PollHandlers, intervalMs = 1000): () => void {
  let stopped = false;
  let failures = 0;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

  const tick = async () => {
    try {
      const [status, trace] = await Promise.all([api.run(runId), api.trace(runId).catch(() => null)]);
      if (stopped) return;
      failures = 0;
      h.onStatus(status, trace);
      if (status.status === 'done' && status.result) return h.onDone(status);
      if (status.status === 'failed') return h.onFailed(status.error || 'The run did not finish. Please try again.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (stopped) return;
      if ((e as { status?: number }).status === 404) return h.onGiveUp('expired');
      failures++;
      if (failures >= MAX_POLL_FAILURES) return h.onGiveUp('lost');
    }
    if (!stopped) timer = setTimeout(tick, intervalMs);
  };

  void tick();
  return () => { stopped = true; if (timer) clearTimeout(timer); };
}

import { QueryClient, QueryFunction } from "@tanstack/react-query";

async function throwIfResNotOk(res: Response) {
  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = (await res.text()) || res.statusText;
    throw new Error(`${res.status}: ${text}`);
  }
}

export async function apiRequest(
  method: string,
  url: string,
  data?: unknown | FormData | undefined,
): Promise<Response> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    // Don't set Content-Type for FormData - browser will set it with boundary
    ...(data && !(data instanceof FormData) ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : {}),
  };
  
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method,
    headers,
    body: data instanceof FormData ? data : (data ? JSON.stringify(data) : undefined),
    credentials: "include",
  });

  await throwIfResNotOk(res);
  return res;
}

// Convenience methods
export async function apiGet(url: string): Promise<Response> {
  return apiRequest('GET', url);
}

export async function apiPost(url: string, data?: unknown | FormData): Promise<Response> {
  return apiRequest('POST', url, data);
}

export async function apiPut(url: string, data?: unknown): Promise<Response> {
  return apiRequest('PUT', url, data);
}

export async function apiPatch(url: string, data?: unknown): Promise<Response> {
  return apiRequest('PATCH', url, data);
}

export async function apiDelete(url: string): Promise<Response> {
  return apiRequest('DELETE', url);
}

// Helper to get JSON response
export async function apiJson<T>(response: Response): Promise<T> {
  return response.json();
}

// Streaming-compatible fetch function that includes cookies
export async function streamingFetch(input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response> {
  const mergedHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
    ...(init?.headers as Record<string, string> | undefined),
  };
  return fetch(input as any, {
    ...init,
    headers: mergedHeaders,
    credentials: "include",
  });
}

type UnauthorizedBehavior = "returnNull" | "throw";
export const getQueryFn: <T>(options: {
  on401: UnauthorizedBehavior;
}) => QueryFunction<T> =
  ({ on401: unauthorizedBehavior }) =>
  async ({ queryKey }) => {
    const res = await fetch(queryKey[0] as string, {
      credentials: "include",
    });

    if (unauthorizedBehavior === "returnNull" && res.status === 401) {
      return null;
    }

    await throwIfResNotOk(res);
    return await res.json();
  };

export const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      queryFn: getQueryFn({ on401: "throw" }),
      refetchInterval: false,
      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
      staleTime: Infinity,
      retry: false,
    },
    mutations: {
      retry: false,
    },
  },
});

// "Back keeps your place": remembers where you were scrolled on each tab, so coming back (from a card's detail page, from
// another tab, or from a sub-view such as the gear locker) puts you at the same spot. Kept in this browser tab only.
import { useEffect } from 'react';

const key = (runId: string) => `bundle:scroll:${runId}`;
type Spots = Record<string, number>;

function read(runId: string): Spots {
  try {
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(key(runId));
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? (parsed as Spots) : {};
  } catch { return {}; }
}

/** The remembered scroll spot for a tab (undefined when none). */
export const spotFor = (runId: string, tab: string): number | undefined => {
  const y = read(runId)[tab];
  return typeof y === 'number' && Number.isFinite(y) && y >= 0 ? y : undefined;
};

function write(runId: string, tab: string, y: number): void {
  try { sessionStorage.setItem(key(runId), JSON.stringify({ ...read(runId), [tab]: Math.round(y) })); } catch { /* the spot is just not remembered */ }
}

let current: { runId: string; tab: string } | null = null;
/** How many sub-views (gear locker, HR questions, audit a deal) are open. While one is open, the page's scroll is not recorded. */
let frozen = 0;

/** Tell the memory which run and tab are on screen. */
export function setSpotContext(runId: string, tab: string): void { current = { runId, tab }; }
export function clearSpotContext(): void { current = null; }

export const currentScroll = (): number => window.scrollY ?? window.pageYOffset ?? document.documentElement.scrollTop ?? 0;

/** Record the page's scroll position for the tab on screen. */
export function recordSpot(y: number = currentScroll()): void {
  if (!current || frozen > 0 || !Number.isFinite(y)) return;
  write(current.runId, current.tab, y);
}

/** Scroll the page to the tab's remembered spot (to the top when `toTop` and there is none). */
export function restoreSpot(opts: { toTop?: boolean } = {}): void {
  if (!current) return;
  const y = spotFor(current.runId, current.tab);
  if (y === undefined && !opts.toTop) return;
  const go = () => window.scrollTo?.({ top: y ?? 0 });
  go();
  // The page may not have its full height yet on the first pass, so look again on the next frame.
  if (y && typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') requestAnimationFrame(go);
}

/** Use inside a sub-view: while it is open the tab's spot is kept as it was, and when it closes the page goes back there. */
export function useFreezeSpot(): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    frozen++;
    return () => { frozen = Math.max(0, frozen - 1); if (frozen === 0) restoreSpot(); };
  }, []);
}

export function forgetSpots(): void {
  try { for (const k of Object.keys(sessionStorage)) if (k.startsWith('bundle:scroll:')) sessionStorage.removeItem(k); } catch { /* nothing to clear */ }
}

// "Email to myself": the phone's Share sheet on a phone, the computer's email program (a mailto: link) everywhere else.
// Bundle never sends anything itself. It never fails silently: every path ends with a message the screen can show.

export interface SendResult { ok: boolean; message: string | null }

interface Deps {
  nav?: Navigator;
  /** Opens a URL (default: the browser goes to it, which hands a mailto: link to the email program). */
  open?: (url: string) => void;
}

/** "tap" on a touch screen, "click" with a mouse. */
const verb = (nav?: Navigator) => (nav && nav.maxTouchPoints > 0 ? 'tap' : 'click');
export const openingEmail = (nav?: Navigator) => `Opening your email… If nothing opens, ${verb(nav)} Copy and paste it into an email.`;
export const emailFailed = (nav?: Navigator) => `We couldn’t open your email app. ${verb(nav) === 'tap' ? 'Tap' : 'Click'} Copy and paste it into an email instead.`;
export const CHOOSE_WHERE = 'Choose where to send it…';
/** What to say the moment the button is pressed: phones get the Share sheet, computers get their email program. */
export const startNote = (data: { title: string; text: string }, nav: Navigator | undefined = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator : undefined) =>
  (isPhoneShare(nav, data) ? CHOOSE_WHERE : 'Opening your email…');

/** A phone: a touch screen with the Share sheet. A Mac's Safari or Chrome also has navigator.share, so touch is what tells them apart. */
export function isPhoneShare(nav: Navigator | undefined, data: { title: string; text: string }): boolean {
  if (!nav || typeof nav.share !== 'function' || !(nav.maxTouchPoints > 0)) return false;
  try { return typeof nav.canShare === 'function' ? nav.canShare(data) : true; } catch { return false; }
}

export const mailtoUrl = (title: string, text: string) => `mailto:?subject=${encodeURIComponent(title)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;

export async function sendToSelf(
  data: { title: string; text: string },
  { nav = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator : undefined, open = (url) => { window.location.href = url; } }: Deps = {},
): Promise<SendResult> {
  if (isPhoneShare(nav, data)) {
    try {
      await nav!.share(data);
      return { ok: true, message: null };
    } catch (e) {
      if ((e as Error)?.name === 'AbortError') return { ok: true, message: null }; // the parent closed the Share sheet
      // Sharing is blocked here (for example inside an embedded browser): fall through to email.
    }
  }
  try {
    open(mailtoUrl(data.title, data.text));
    return { ok: true, message: openingEmail(nav) };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, message: emailFailed(nav) };
  }
}

import type { FeedCard, CardKind, Source, ValueScore } from '@shared/bundle';
import { pollRun, type PollApi, type PollHandlers } from './poll';

/**
 * Live updates for the "Checking" screen: cards show up as each one is ready, plus short status pills.
 * The server sends them over a one-way connection (server-sent events) at GET /api/runs/:runId/events.
 * If that connection is missing or breaks, we quietly go back to asking once a second (poll.ts).
 *
 * Event shape = RunEvent in server/agents/runEvents.ts. Each message is sent under its type name
 * (card_ready, card_updated, card_removed, agent_status), with the event as JSON in `data`. A plain
 * unnamed message with the type inside the data works too. An `end` message means the run is over.
 */

export type AgentState = 'waiting' | 'working' | 'done' | 'failed';

/** The server's event (cards here may hold owner-only fields; we strip them before keeping anything). */
export type StreamEvent = { runId?: string; seq?: number; at?: string } & (
  | { type: 'card_ready'; card: FeedCard }
  | { type: 'card_updated'; card: FeedCard }
  | { type: 'card_removed'; cardId: string; reason?: string }
  | { type: 'agent_status'; agent: string; state: AgentState; label?: string }
);

export interface StreamState {
  /** Cards that are ready, most urgent first. Parent-safe fields only. */
  cards: FeedCard[];
  /** Ids the server took back; a saved copy of these must not be shown either. */
  removed: string[];
  agents: Record<string, AgentState>;
  /** Order in which agents first reported, so pills stay in a steady order. */
  order: string[];
  lastSeq: number;
}

export const emptyStream = (): StreamState => ({ cards: [], removed: [], agents: {}, order: [], lastSeq: 0 });

// ---------- parent whitelist (same fields as PARENT_CARD_KEYS in bundleRoutes.ts) ----------

const KINDS: CardKind[] = ['recall', 'clawback', 'benefit', 'discount', 'coming_soon'];
const VERDICTS = ['verified', 'likely', 'all_clear', 'info', 'blocked'];

const range = (r: unknown) => (r && typeof r === 'object' && typeof (r as { min: unknown }).min === 'number' && typeof (r as { max: unknown }).max === 'number') ? { min: (r as { min: number }).min, max: (r as { max: number }).max } : null;

/** The deal grade, copied one field at a time (same list as ValueScore in shared/bundle.ts). Nothing extra gets through. */
export function sanitizeValueScore(v: unknown): ValueScore | undefined {
  if (!v || typeof v !== 'object') return undefined;
  const x = v as Record<string, unknown>;
  const minutes = range(x.effortMinutesEstimate);
  if (!minutes || !['low', 'medium', 'high'].includes(x.effortLevel as string)) return undefined;
  const strs = (a: unknown) => (Array.isArray(a) ? a.filter((t): t is string => typeof t === 'string') : []);
  return {
    trueValueCents: typeof x.trueValueCents === 'number' ? x.trueValueCents : null,
    effortLevel: x.effortLevel as ValueScore['effortLevel'],
    effortMinutesEstimate: minutes,
    stepsCount: typeof x.stepsCount === 'number' ? x.stepsCount : 0,
    payoutWaitDays: range(x.payoutWaitDays),
    timeLabel: typeof x.timeLabel === 'string' ? x.timeLabel : '',
    catchTypes: strs(x.catchTypes),
    worthYourTime: typeof x.worthYourTime === 'boolean' ? x.worthYourTime : null,
    reasons: strs(x.reasons),
  };
}

/** Copy a card field by field. Anything not listed (trace ids, debate, SQL, rule text) never gets in. Returns null for junk. */
export function sanitizeCard(c: unknown): FeedCard | null {
  if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return null;
  const x = c as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (typeof x.id !== 'string' || typeof x.title !== 'string' || !KINDS.includes(x.kind as CardKind) || !VERDICTS.includes(x.verdict as string)) return null;
  const sources: Source[] = Array.isArray(x.sources)
    ? x.sources.filter((s): s is Source => !!s && typeof (s as Source).url === 'string').map((s) => ({ label: String((s as Source).label ?? ''), url: (s as Source).url }))
    : [];
  const valueScore = sanitizeValueScore(x.valueScore);
  return {
    ...(valueScore ? { valueScore } : {}),
    id: x.id, kind: x.kind as CardKind, title: x.title, body: typeof x.body === 'string' ? x.body : '',
    amountCents: typeof x.amountCents === 'number' ? x.amountCents : null,
    deadline: typeof x.deadline === 'string' ? x.deadline : null,
    verdict: x.verdict as FeedCard['verdict'], sources,
  } as FeedCard;
}

/** Recalls first (safety), then money back, benefits, deals, coming soon; nearest deadline first inside a kind. */
export function sortCards(cards: FeedCard[]): FeedCard[] {
  return cards
    .map((c, i) => ({ c, i }))
    .sort((a, b) =>
      KINDS.indexOf(a.c.kind) - KINDS.indexOf(b.c.kind)
      || (a.c.deadline ?? '9999').localeCompare(b.c.deadline ?? '9999')
      || a.i - b.i)
    .map((x) => x.c);
}

// ---------- applying events ----------

export function applyEvent(s: StreamState, e: StreamEvent): StreamState {
  if (!e || typeof e !== 'object') return s;
  if (typeof e.seq === 'number') {
    if (e.seq <= s.lastSeq) return s; // already seen (a replay after reconnecting)
  }
  const lastSeq = typeof e.seq === 'number' ? e.seq : s.lastSeq;
  switch (e.type) {
    case 'card_ready':
    case 'card_updated': {
      const card = sanitizeCard(e.card);
      if (!card) return s;
      // A blocked offer is never shown as a ready card; if it replaces a card we showed, the card goes away.
      const rest = s.cards.filter((c) => c.id !== card.id);
      const cards = card.verdict === 'blocked' ? rest : sortCards([...rest, card]);
      return { ...s, cards, removed: s.removed.filter((id) => id !== card.id), lastSeq };
    }
    case 'card_removed': {
      if (typeof e.cardId !== 'string') return s;
      return { ...s, cards: s.cards.filter((c) => c.id !== e.cardId), removed: s.removed.includes(e.cardId) ? s.removed : [...s.removed, e.cardId], lastSeq };
    }
    case 'agent_status': {
      if (typeof e.agent !== 'string' || !['waiting', 'working', 'done', 'failed'].includes(e.state)) return s;
      const key = agentKey(e.agent);
      return { ...s, agents: { ...s.agents, [key]: e.state }, order: s.order.includes(key) ? s.order : [...s.order, key], lastSeq };
    }
    default:
      return s;
  }
}

// ---------- status pills (parent words only: no agent names) ----------

const ALIASES: Record<string, string> = { fine_print_court: 'court', factchecker: 'fact_checker' };
const agentKey = (agent: string) => ALIASES[agent.toLowerCase()] ?? agent.toLowerCase();

const PILL_WORDS: Record<string, Record<AgentState, string>> = {
  clawback: { waiting: 'Money check coming up', working: 'Looking for money you can get back…', done: 'Money check finished', failed: 'Couldn’t finish the money check' },
  recall: { waiting: 'Recall check coming up', working: 'Checking recalls…', done: 'Recall check finished', failed: 'Couldn’t finish the recall check' },
  benefits: { waiting: 'Program check coming up', working: 'Checking programs and deadlines…', done: 'Programs and deadlines checked', failed: 'Couldn’t finish the program check' },
  court: { waiting: 'Deal check coming up', working: 'Reading the fine print on deals…', done: 'Deal fine print checked', failed: 'Couldn’t finish the deal check' },
  fact_checker: { waiting: 'Final check coming up', working: 'Double-checking each card against its source…', done: 'Every card double-checked', failed: 'Couldn’t finish the final check' },
};
const GENERIC: Record<AgentState, string> = { waiting: 'Getting ready…', working: 'Working on your results…', done: 'Step finished', failed: 'One step didn’t finish' };
const PILL_ORDER = Object.keys(PILL_WORDS);

export interface Pill { key: string; state: AgentState; text: string }

export function pillLines(s: StreamState): Pill[] {
  const known = PILL_ORDER.filter((k) => s.agents[k]);
  const other = s.order.filter((k) => !PILL_WORDS[k]);
  return [...known, ...other].map((key) => {
    const state = s.agents[key];
    return { key, state, text: (PILL_WORDS[key] ?? GENERIC)[state] };
  });
}

/** The parent's checking steps, advanced from stream events (same keys and wording the server sends). */
export function stepsFromStream(s: StreamState): { key: string; label: string; state: 'waiting' | 'working' | 'done' }[] {
  const defs = [
    ['money', 'clawback', 'Money you can get back'],
    ['recalls', 'recall', 'Your items vs. official recall lists'],
    ['benefits', 'benefits', 'Programs and deadlines for your family'],
    ['deals', 'court', 'Deals, read for hidden catches'],
    ['double_check', 'fact_checker', 'Every card double-checked against its source'],
  ] as const;
  return defs.map(([key, agent, label]) => {
    const a = s.agents[agent];
    return { key, label, state: a === 'done' || a === 'failed' ? 'done' : a === 'working' ? 'working' : 'waiting' };
  });
}

// ---------- the connection ----------

/** If nothing at all arrives for this long, we stop trusting the stream and ask the server directly. */
export const STREAM_STALL_MS = 45_000;
const EVENT_TYPES = ['card_ready', 'card_updated', 'card_removed', 'agent_status'] as const;

export interface FollowHandlers extends PollHandlers {
  /** Called with the newest stream state each time something arrives. */
  onStream: (s: StreamState) => void;
}
export interface FollowOptions {
  /** Pass null to force polling only. Defaults to the browser's EventSource when there is one. */
  EventSourceCtor?: typeof EventSource | null;
  intervalMs?: number;
}

/**
 * Watch a run: stream cards and pills if the browser and server allow it, and always finish through
 * pollRun, so the final screen is exactly the saved result. Returns a stop function.
 */
export function followRun(runId: string, api: PollApi, h: FollowHandlers, opts: FollowOptions = {}): () => void {
  const Ctor = opts.EventSourceCtor === undefined ? (typeof EventSource !== 'undefined' ? EventSource : null) : opts.EventSourceCtor;
  let stopped = false;
  let stopPoll: (() => void) | null = null;
  let es: EventSource | null = null;
  let stall: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  let state = emptyStream();

  const startPolling = () => {
    if (stopped || stopPoll) return;
    if (stall) clearTimeout(stall);
    try { es?.close(); } catch { /* already closed */ }
    stopPoll = pollRun(runId, api, h, opts.intervalMs ?? 1000);
  };

  const feed = (raw: unknown) => {
    if (stopped) return;
    try {
      const e = (typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw) as StreamEvent;
      armStall();
      const next = applyEvent(state, e);
      if (next !== state) { state = next; h.onStream(state); }
    } catch { /* one bad message must not break the stream */ }
  };

  const armStall = () => {
    if (stall) clearTimeout(stall);
    stall = setTimeout(startPolling, STREAM_STALL_MS);
  };

  if (!Ctor) {
    startPolling();
  } else {
    try {
      es = new Ctor(`/api/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}/events`);
      for (const t of EVENT_TYPES) es.addEventListener(t, (m) => feed((m as MessageEvent).data));
      es.addEventListener('end', () => startPolling());
      es.onmessage = (m) => feed(m.data);
      es.onerror = () => startPolling();
      armStall();
    } catch {
      startPolling();
    }
  }

  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    if (stall) clearTimeout(stall);
    try { es?.close(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    stopPoll?.();
  };
}

// Version B (bottom tabs) logic: which card goes on which tab, the totals, the "Do these first" list, the "I got this" ticks.
// Pure functions, no screens. Every number is added up from the run's own cards and receipt, never typed in here.

import type { BundleResult, FeedCard, ValueScore } from '@shared/bundle';
import { URGENT_DAYS, daysUntil, deadlineText, fmtUsd, isCheckWithJob, type FamilyView, type SavedRun } from './bundle';
import { COVERED_STATES, UNCOVERED_STATE_NOTE } from './onboarding';
import { minutesOf } from '@shared/cardMeta';

export type TabId = 'home' | 'taxes' | 'savings' | 'insurance' | 'deals' | 'account';
export const TABS: { id: TabId; label: string }[] = [
  { id: 'home', label: 'Home' },
  { id: 'taxes', label: 'Taxes' },
  { id: 'savings', label: 'Savings' },
  { id: 'insurance', label: 'Insurance' },
  { id: 'deals', label: 'Deals' },
];
/** The five money tabs, then Account (the family's answers, memory and privacy). The bottom bar shows only the five; Account opens from the family chip in the header. */
export const ALL_TABS: { id: TabId; label: string }[] = [...TABS, { id: 'account', label: 'Account' }];
export const isTabId = (x: unknown): x is TabId => ALL_TABS.some((t) => t.id === x);

export type Stage = 'expecting' | 'born';
/** Expecting = a due date and no birth date. Anything else (including no information) is treated as "baby's here". */
export const stageOf = (f?: FamilyView): Stage => (f && f.dueDate && !f.birthDate ? 'expecting' : 'born');

/** Which tab a card lives on. Coming-soon tiles belong to no tab (they show in their own small section). */
export function tabForCard(c: FeedCard): TabId | null {
  if (c.kind === 'coming_soon') return null;
  if (c.kind === 'discount') return 'deals';
  if (c.kind === 'clawback' || c.kind === 'recall') return 'savings';
  if (/insurance|_pfml?$|_pfl$/.test(c.id)) return 'insurance';
  if (/tax_credit|dcfsa/.test(c.id)) return 'taxes';
  return 'savings'; // e.g. the baby's starter account
}

// ---------- what counts toward the big number (mirrors the server's receipt rule) ----------

const isChecked = (c: FeedCard) => c.verdict === 'verified' || c.verdict === 'likely';
const isMoneyBack = (c: FeedCard) => c.kind === 'clawback' && /^clawback-(fsa|price)-/.test(c.id) && isChecked(c);
const isCountedBenefit = (c: FeedCard) => c.kind === 'benefit' && isChecked(c) && !/^benefit-dcfsa/.test(c.id);

/** The value of a free gift: what is left after the strings attached when the fine print says, otherwise the offer's own figure. */
export const giftValue = (c: FeedCard): number => c.valueScore?.trueValueCents ?? c.amountCents ?? 0;
const isGift = (c: FeedCard) => c.kind === 'discount' && c.verdict !== 'info' && c.verdict !== 'blocked';

export interface HomeTotals {
  /** Savings and tax credits: the run's own receipt (money back + benefits you likely qualify for). */
  totalCents: number;
  /** Free gifts that passed the Fine Print Court. */
  giftsCents: number;
  /** The cards that add up to totalCents, for "How we got this number". */
  parts: FeedCard[];
  /** Benefit cards shown but deliberately left out of the total (check-with-your-job, not yet verified). */
  notCounted: FeedCard[];
}

export function homeTotals(result: BundleResult): HomeTotals {
  const parts = result.cards.filter((c) => (isMoneyBack(c) || isCountedBenefit(c)) && (c.amountCents ?? 0) > 0);
  return {
    totalCents: result.receipt.moneyBackCents + result.receipt.likelyBenefitsCents,
    giftsCents: result.cards.filter(isGift).reduce((a, c) => a + giftValue(c), 0),
    parts,
    notCounted: result.cards.filter((c) => c.kind === 'benefit' && !isCountedBenefit(c)),
  };
}

export interface CategorySummary { cents: number; count: number }
/** Money and number of items on one tab (gifts use their true value on the Deals tab). */
export function categorySummary(cards: FeedCard[], tab: TabId): CategorySummary {
  const mine = cards.filter((c) => tabForCard(c) === tab);
  const cents = mine.reduce((a, c) => a + (isGift(c) ? giftValue(c) : isMoneyBack(c) || isCountedBenefit(c) ? c.amountCents ?? 0 : 0), 0);
  const count = mine.filter((c) => (c.kind === 'discount' ? isGift(c) : c.kind === 'benefit' || isMoneyBack(c))).length;
  return { cents, count };
}

// ---------- Do these first ----------

export interface Urgent { card: FeedCard; label: string; tab: TabId }

const SHORT_WINDOW_DAYS = 60;

/**
 * Deadlines that need attention now, soonest first. For a baby who is here that is anything due within a month.
 * For an expecting family a deadline cannot start yet, so it says "Starts at birth" (only the short windows that
 * count from the birth, never the year-long ones).
 */
export function urgentDeadlines(cards: FeedCard[], today: string, stage: Stage, family?: FamilyView): Urgent[] {
  const withDeadline = cards.filter((c) => c.kind === 'benefit' && isChecked(c) && c.deadline);
  if (stage === 'expecting') {
    const due = family?.dueDate;
    return withDeadline
      .filter((c) => !due || daysBetween(due, c.deadline as string) <= SHORT_WINDOW_DAYS)
      .sort((a, b) => (a.deadline as string).localeCompare(b.deadline as string))
      .map((card) => ({ card, tab: tabForCard(card) ?? 'home', label: due ? `Starts at birth · ${daysBetween(due, card.deadline as string)} days to act` : 'Starts at birth' }));
  }
  return withDeadline
    .filter((c) => { const d = daysUntil(c.deadline as string, today); return d >= 0 && d <= URGENT_DAYS; })
    .sort((a, b) => (a.deadline as string).localeCompare(b.deadline as string))
    .map((card) => ({ card, tab: tabForCard(card) ?? 'home', label: deadlineText(card.deadline as string, today) }));
}

const daysBetween = (fromIso: string, toIso: string) => Math.round((Date.parse(`${toIso}T00:00:00Z`) - Date.parse(`${fromIso}T00:00:00Z`)) / 86_400_000);

/** How many urgent deadlines the Insurance tab badge shows (a baby who is here only). */
export const badgeCount = (cards: FeedCard[], today: string, stage: Stage, family?: FamilyView): number =>
  stage === 'expecting' ? 0 : urgentDeadlines(cards, today, stage, family).filter((u) => u.tab === 'insurance').length;

// ---------- uncovered state ----------

/** The "coming soon" sentence for a family whose state we do not cover yet, or null. Reads, in order: the run's `stateNote`, a `coming-soon-state` card, the family's state. */
export function comingSoonNote(run: Pick<SavedRun, 'result' | 'family'>): string | null {
  const note = run.result.stateNote;
  if (note && note.trim()) return note.trim();
  const cardNote = run.result.cards.find((c) => c.kind === 'coming_soon' && c.id.startsWith('coming-soon-state'));
  if (cardNote) return cardNote.body.replace(/^coming soon:\s*/i, '').trim() || UNCOVERED_STATE_NOTE;
  const state = run.family?.state;
  if (state && /^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(state) && !(COVERED_STATES as readonly string[]).includes(state)) return UNCOVERED_STATE_NOTE;
  return null;
}

// ---------- "I got this" ticks (this browser only) ----------

/** Money and deal cards a parent can tick off. Check-with-your-job items and safety checks have no tick. */
export function claimableCards(cards: FeedCard[]): FeedCard[] {
  return cards.filter((c) => (isMoneyBack(c) || isCountedBenefit(c)) && !isCheckWithJob(c) ? true : isGift(c));
}

const claimKey = (familyId: string) => `bundle:claimed:${familyId}`;

export function loadClaims(familyId: string): Record<string, boolean> {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(claimKey(familyId));
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? (parsed as Record<string, boolean>) : {};
  } catch { return {}; }
}

export function saveClaims(familyId: string, claims: Record<string, boolean>): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(claimKey(familyId), JSON.stringify(claims)); } catch { /* storage blocked: ticks last until the page closes */ }
}

const dismissKey = (familyId: string) => `bundle:dismissed:${familyId}`;

/** The cards this family marked "Not relevant" (this browser; the server keeps a copy in the claims table). */
export function loadDismissed(familyId: string): Record<string, boolean> {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(dismissKey(familyId));
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? (parsed as Record<string, boolean>) : {};
  } catch { return {}; }
}

export function saveDismissed(familyId: string, dismissed: Record<string, boolean>): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(dismissKey(familyId), JSON.stringify(dismissed)); } catch { /* storage blocked: lasts until the page closes */ }
}

/**
 * The three money numbers on Home, all worked out from the run's counted cards:
 *   found   = the headline: everything counted, minus what the parent said does not apply to them;
 *   claimed = the counted money on cards marked "I got this";
 *   still   = found minus claimed.
 * "Not relevant" comes off found and still and never goes into claimed.
 */
export interface MoneyNumbers { found: number; claimed: number; still: number; dismissed: number }
export function moneyNumbers(result: BundleResult, claims: Record<string, boolean>, dismissed: Record<string, boolean>): MoneyNumbers {
  const t = homeTotals(result);
  const sum = (f: (c: FeedCard) => boolean) => t.parts.filter(f).reduce((a, c) => a + (c.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
  const gone = sum((c) => !!dismissed[c.id]);
  const claimed = sum((c) => !dismissed[c.id] && !!claims[c.id]);
  const found = t.totalCents - gone;
  return { found, claimed, still: found - claimed, dismissed: gone };
}

/** Where a card is right now: still to do, in the Claimed drawer, or in the Dismissed drawer. */
export type CardState = 'open' | 'claimed' | 'dismissed';
export const cardState = (id: string, claims: Record<string, boolean>, dismissed: Record<string, boolean>): CardState =>
  dismissed[id] ? 'dismissed' : claims[id] ? 'claimed' : 'open';

/** Task cards for the Home "Do these next" list: things a parent can act on that are not free gifts (gifts live on Deals). */
export const taskCards = (cards: FeedCard[]): FeedCard[] => claimableCards(cards).filter((c) => c.kind !== 'discount');
/** "Quick wins": under 5 minutes. A card with no estimate is never called a quick win. */
export const isQuickWin = (c: FeedCard): boolean => { const m = minutesOf(c); return m !== undefined && m < 5; };

/** "$ claimed": the money on ticked cards only. */
export function claimedCents(cards: FeedCard[], claims: Record<string, boolean>): number {
  return claimableCards(cards).filter((c) => claims[c.id]).reduce((a, c) => a + (isGift(c) ? giftValue(c) : c.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
}

// ---------- share ----------

/** The pre-written share message. A link only: never the list, the baby's date, the ZIP or any amount. */
export const shareMessage = (link: string): string => `Bundle found money and deadlines for our baby that I had no idea about. Takes 30 seconds: ${link}`;

// ---------- Value Score in plain words ----------

const CATCH_WORDS: Record<string, string> = {
  shipping_fee: 'shipping fee', fee_unknown: 'a fee may apply', required_membership: 'paid membership required', negative_value: 'costs more than it is worth',
  fee_over_limit: 'fee over our limit', minimum_purchase: 'minimum purchase', auto_renew: 'renews automatically', expired: 'offer ended',
  expiring_soon: 'ends soon', regions_excluded: 'not in every region',
  ai_found_catch: 'our checker found a catch in the fine print',
};
export const catchWord = (t: string): string => CATCH_WORDS[t] ?? t.replace(/_/g, ' ');

/** The saved offline court line reads as a contradiction ("no flagged terms" yet "couldn't fully check"); say it as one idea. */
export function plainCardBody(body: string): string {
  return body.replace(/No flagged terms found\.\s*We couldn['’]t fully check this offer['’]s fine print\./, "We couldn’t read this offer’s fine print in full, so we haven’t confirmed it is free of catches. Read the terms before you sign up.");
}

/** True when the card body says the fine print could not be read in full (the saved offline court line). */
export const finePrintUnread = (body: string): boolean => /couldn['’]t (fully check|read) this offer['’]s fine print/.test(body);

/** The "How we checked" line for a normal card; says only what was actually checked. */
export function howWeChecked(body: string): string {
  return finePrintUnread(body)
    ? 'We checked this offer against its official source page. We couldn’t read its fine print in full, so read the terms before you sign up.'
    : 'We checked this against its official source before showing it to you.';
}

/** The wait part of the effort line, in a natural phrase ("right away" alone read oddly after a minutes count). */
export function waitPhrase(label: string): string {
  if (label === 'right away') return 'no payout wait stated';
  if (label === 'instant') return 'paid instantly';
  if (label === 'wait unknown') return 'payout wait unknown';
  if (label.startsWith('money in')) return label.replace(/^money in/, 'money arrives in');
  return label;
}

/** Plain lines for a deal's Value Score: true value, time (effort and wait), catches, and "probably not worth your time". */
export function valueScoreLines(v: ValueScore): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  if (v.trueValueCents !== null) out.push(`True value ${fmtUsd(v.trueValueCents)}`);
  const { min, max } = v.effortMinutesEstimate;
  out.push(`About ${min === max ? min : `${min}–${max}`} minutes of effort, ${waitPhrase(v.timeLabel)}`);
  if (v.catchTypes.filter((t) => t !== 'prompt_injection').length) out.push(`Catch: ${v.catchTypes.filter((t) => t !== 'prompt_injection').map(catchWord).join(', ')}`);
  if (v.worthYourTime === false) out.push('Probably not worth your time');
  return out;
}

};
const ACTION_LABEL: Record<AgentLogLine['action'], string> = {
  query_zetaris: 'looked up data', vision_extract: 'read a photo', evaluate_offer: 'checked an offer', court_debate: 'court debate',
  fact_check: 'fact-check', retry_request: 'asked for a redo', recall_hmem: 'used memory', approve_card: 'approved', reject_card: 'rejected',
};

export interface Group {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  lines: AgentLogLine[];
  notes: AgentLogNote[];
  loops: Record<LoopKind, number>;
}
export interface Grouped { groups: Group[]; counts: Record<LoopKind, number> }

const emptyLoops = (): Record<LoopKind, number> => Object.fromEntries(LOOP_KINDS.map((k) => [k, 0])) as Record<LoopKind, number>;
export const RUN_KEY = '__run';

/** The card (or offer, purchase or rule) a line is about, from the words the agents write in input_summary. */
function subjectIn(text: string, cards: CardRef[]): { key: string; label: string } | null {
  const byId = (id: string) => cards.find((c) => c.id === id);
  const named = (key: string, plain: string, ...ids: string[]) => {
    const c = ids.map(byId).find(Boolean) ?? cards.find((x) => ids.includes(x.id));
    return c ? { key: c.id, label: c.title } : { key, label: plain };
  };
  let m = /\bcard ([\w-]+)/.exec(text);
  if (m) return byId(m[1]) ? { key: m[1], label: byId(m[1])!.title } : { key: m[1], label: m[1] };
  // The orchestrator writes send-backs as "<cardId> to <agent>", with no word "card": match a known card id.
  const known = cards.filter((c) => text.startsWith(`${c.id} `) || text.includes(` ${c.id} `)).sort((a, b) => b.id.length - a.id.length)[0];
  if (known) return { key: known.id, label: known.title };
  m = /\boffer[ -]?(\d+)\b/i.exec(text);
  if (m) return named(`offer ${m[1]}`, `Offer ${m[1]}`, `discount-${m[1]}`, `blocked-${m[1]}`);
  m = /\bitem (\d+)\b/i.exec(text);
  if (m) {
    const c = cards.find((x) => x.id.startsWith('clawback-') && x.id.endsWith(`-${m![1]}`));
    return c ? { key: c.id, label: c.title } : { key: `item ${m[1]}`, label: `Purchase ${m[1]}` };
  }
  m = /\brule ([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+)\b/.exec(text);
  if (m) return named(`rule ${m[1]}`, `Rule ${m[1]}`, `benefit-${m[1].toLowerCase()}`);
  return null;
}

/** Group a run's log lines and workspace notes per card, count each loop, and put run-wide lines last. */
export function groupAgentLog(data: Pick<AgentLogData, 'lines' | 'notes'>, cards: CardRef[] = []): Grouped {
  const map = new Map<string, Group>();
  const get = (key: string, label: string): Group => {
    let g = map.get(key);
    if (!g) { g = { key, label, lines: [], notes: [], loops: emptyLoops() }; map.set(key, g); }
    return g;
  };
  const counts = emptyLoops();
  for (const l of data.lines) {
    const s = subjectIn(l.input_summary, cards);
    const g = s ? get(s.key, s.label) : get(RUN_KEY, 'Whole run (not about one card)');
    g.lines.push(l);
    for (const k of loopsOf(l)) { g.loops[k]++; counts[k]++; }
  }
  for (const n of [...data.notes].sort((a, b) => a.round - b.round)) {
    const s = subjectIn(`card ${n.about}`, cards) ?? { key: n.about, label: n.about };
    const asOffer = /^offer[ -]?\d+$/i.test(n.about) ? subjectIn(n.about, cards) : null;
    const target = asOffer ?? s;
    get(target.key, target.label).notes.push(n);
  }
  const rank = (g: Group) => (g.key === RUN_KEY ? 2 : LOOP_KINDS.some((k) => g.loops[k]) || g.notes.length ? 0 : 1);
  const groups = [...map.values()].map((g, i) => ({ g, i })).sort((a, b) => rank(a.g) - rank(b.g) || a.i - b.i).map((x) => x.g);
  return { groups, counts };
}

type State = { kind: 'idle' } | { kind: 'loading' } | { kind: 'ready'; data: AgentLogData } | { kind: 'none' } | { kind: 'error' };

export default function AgentWorkspace({ runId, cards = [], token }: { runId: string; cards?: CardRef[]; token?: string }) {
  const code = token ?? reviewerToken.get();
  const [state, setState] = useState<State>({ kind: code ? 'loading' : 'idle' });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!code) { setState({ kind: 'idle' }); return; }
    let live = true;
    setState({ kind: 'loading' });
    fetch(`/api/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}/agent-log`, { headers: { 'x-reviewer-token': code } })
      .then(async (res) => {
        if (!live) return;
        if (res.status === 403) return setState({ kind: 'idle' }); // wrong code: show nothing, like a parent
        if (res.status === 404) return setState({ kind: 'none' });
        if (!res.ok) return setState({ kind: 'error' });
        setState({ kind: 'ready', data: (await res.json()) as AgentLogData });
      })
      .catch(() => { if (live) setState({ kind: 'error' }); });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [runId, code]);

  if (state.kind === 'idle') return null; // parents never see this panel
  return (
    <section className="mt-8" aria-labelledby="agent-workspace-title" data-testid="agent-workspace">
      <h2 id="agent-workspace-title" className="eyebrow text-ink-2">How the agents worked together</h2>
      {state.kind === 'loading' && <p className="mt-2 text-[15px] text-ink-2">Loading the agents’ log…</p>}
      {state.kind === 'none' && <p className="mt-2 rounded-2xl bg-paper px-4 py-3 text-[15px] text-ink-2">No agent log for this run yet.</p>}
      {state.kind === 'error' && <p className="mt-2 rounded-2xl bg-paper px-4 py-3 text-[15px] text-ink-2">Could not load the agent log.</p>}
      {state.kind === 'ready' && <Ready data={state.data} cards={cards} />}
    </section>
  );
}

function Ready({ data, cards }: { data: AgentLogData; cards: CardRef[] }) {
  const { groups, counts } = groupAgentLog(data, cards);
  const anyLoop = LOOP_KINDS.some((k) => counts[k] > 0);
  return (
    <>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[15px] text-ink-2">
        Every step the agents took for this run, grouped by the card it was about. A loop is when agents checked each other’s work. A rebuttal round is when the Fine Print Court argued back and forth about a deal before ruling.
      </p>
      <ul className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4" data-testid="loop-counts" aria-label="Loops in this run">
        {LOOP_KINDS.map((k) => (
          <li key={k} className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper px-3 py-2 text-center">
            <span className="tabular block text-[22px] font-extrabold leading-none text-ink">{counts[k]}</span>
            <span className="mt-1 block text-[12px] font-semibold leading-snug text-ink-2">{LOOP_LABEL[k]}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {!anyLoop && <p className="mt-2 text-[14px] text-ink-2">No loops this run: nothing was sent back, argued again or retried.</p>}
      {data.backend && (
        <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-ink-2" data-testid="workspace-backend">
          {data.backend === 'hmem-local'
            ? 'Notes between agents were stored in Meterless H-MEM (the shared memory the agents use to leave each other notes and remember lessons).'
            : 'Notes between agents were kept in a backup list because Meterless H-MEM (the shared agent memory) could not be reached.'}
        </p>
      )}
      {data.skipped > 0 && <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-ink-2">{data.skipped} damaged log line(s) were left out.</p>}
      <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
        {groups.map((g) => {
          const loopy = LOOP_KINDS.filter((k) => g.loops[k] > 0);
          return (
            <details key={g.key} open={loopy.length > 0 || g.notes.length > 0} className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper px-4 py-3">
              <summary className="cursor-pointer text-[15px] font-bold text-ink">
                {g.label}
                <span className="ml-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-2">{g.lines.length} {g.lines.length === 1 ? 'step' : 'steps'}</span>
                {loopy.map((k) => (
                  <span key={k} className="ml-2 inline-block rounded-full bg-coral-tint px-2 py-0.5 text-[12px] font-bold text-coral-deep">{LOOP_BADGE[k]}{g.loops[k] > 1 ? ` x${g.loops[k]}` : ''}</span>
                ))}
              </summary>
              {g.notes.length > 0 && (
                <ol className="mt-2 space-y-1.5" aria-label="Notes the agents left each other">
                  {g.notes.map((n, i) => (
                    <li key={i} className="rounded-xl bg-coral-tint px-3 py-2 text-[14px] text-ink">
                      <span className="block text-[12px] font-bold text-ink-2">Round {n.round} · {n.from_agent} to {n.to_agent} ({n.type})</span>
                      <span className="block">{n.body}</span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ol>
              )}
              <ol className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
                {g.lines.map((l, i) => (
                  <li key={i} className={cn('text-[14px] leading-snug text-ink', loopsOf(l).length > 0 && 'font-semibold')}>
                    <span className="text-ink-2">{l.agent_name} to {l.target_agent} · {ACTION_LABEL[l.action]} · {l.status.replace('_', ' ')}{l.retry_count > 0 ? ` · try ${l.retry_count + 1}` : ''}</span>
                    <span className="block break-words">{l.output_summary}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ol>
            </details>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {data.lessons.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-3 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper px-4 py-3">
          <p className="text-[15px] font-bold text-ink">Lessons from earlier runs</p>
          <ul className="mt-1 space-y-1 text-[14px] text-ink">
            {data.lessons.map((l, i) => <li key={i} className="break-words">{l.output}</li>)}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

  fallback: { label: 'Backup used', cls: 'bg-[#F1ECE4] text-ink-2' },
  error: { label: 'Error', cls: 'bg-[#FBE3E0] text-[#9E2A21]' },
};

/** Plain-English headline for one step of the audit trail. */
function stepTitle(l: TraceLine): string {
  const who = agentLabel(l.agent_name);
  if (l.agent_name === 'fact_checker') return l.status === 'ok' ? 'Fact-Checker re-checked the source' : 'Fact-Checker sent it back';
  if (l.action === 'explain') return `${who} wrote the explanation`;
  if (l.action === 'argue') return `${who} made its case`;
  if (l.agent_name === 'judge') return 'The Judge ruled';
  return `${who} found it`;
}

const sentence = (s: string) => (s ? s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) : s);

function stepDetail(l: TraceLine): string {
  if (l.status === 'fallback' && /model unavailable|no model answer/i.test(l.output_summary)) {
    return 'The AI was offline, so this step used the rule-based backup check instead.';
  }
  if (l.agent_name === 'fact_checker') return l.status === 'ok' ? 'Amount, dates and source all match the official data.' : l.output_summary;
  if (l.action === 'explain') return l.status === 'fallback' ? 'Written from a fixed template (the AI writer was not used).' : 'Written by the AI, from the checked facts only.';
  return sentence(l.output_summary.replace(/^(approve|reject):\s*/i, (_m, v: string) => `${v === 'approve' ? 'Approved' : 'Rejected'}. `));
}

import { Link, useParams } from 'wouter';
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell';
import VersionB from '@/pages/tabs/VersionB';
import AgentWorkspace from '@/pages/AgentWorkspace';
import FeedCardView from '@/components/FeedCardView';
import { api, describeLine, familyChip, fmtUsdShort, loadRun, saveRun, type SavedRun, type TraceLine } from '@/lib/bundle';
import { FIRST_LINE_MS, LINE_GAP_MS, checkLines, type CheckLine } from '@/lib/checking';
import { followRun, emptyStream, pillLines, sanitizeCard, sortCards, type StreamState } from '@/lib/stream';
import type { FeedCard } from '@shared/bundle';
import { ownerApi, ownerToken } from '@/lib/howWeChecked';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const POLL_MS = 1000;

/** The five steps a run goes through, and the trace line that marks each one finished. */
const STEPS: { agent: string; label: string; doneWhen: (lines: TraceLine[]) => boolean; startedWhen: (lines: TraceLine[]) => boolean }[] = [
  { agent: 'clawback', label: 'Clawback Finder: money you can get back', startedWhen: (l) => l.some((x) => x.agent_name === 'clawback'), doneWhen: (l) => l.some((x) => x.action === 'find_clawbacks') },
  { agent: 'recall', label: 'Recall Checker: your items vs. official recalls', startedWhen: (l) => l.some((x) => x.agent_name === 'recall'), doneWhen: (l) => l.some((x) => x.action === 'check_recalls') },
  { agent: 'benefits', label: 'Benefits Planner: programs and deadlines', startedWhen: (l) => l.some((x) => x.agent_name === 'benefits'), doneWhen: (l) => l.some((x) => x.action === 'plan_benefits') },
  { agent: 'court', label: 'Fine Print Court: deals with hidden catches', startedWhen: (l) => l.some((x) => x.agent_name === 'fine_print_court'), doneWhen: (l) => l.some((x) => x.agent_name === 'fact_checker') },
  { agent: 'fact_checker', label: 'Fact-Checker: every card checked against its source', startedWhen: (l) => l.some((x) => x.agent_name === 'fact_checker'), doneWhen: (l) => l.some((x) => x.action === 'assemble') },
];

function Spinner({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return <span aria-hidden="true" className={cn('inline-block h-4 w-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-coral border-t-transparent', className)} />;
}

const STATE_TEXT = { waiting: 'Waiting', working: 'Working', done: 'Done' } as const;

function StepIcon({ state }: { state: 'waiting' | 'working' | 'done' }) {
  return <><span className="sr-only">{STATE_TEXT[state]}: </span><StepGlyph state={state} /></>;
}

function StepGlyph({ state }: { state: 'waiting' | 'working' | 'done' }) {
  if (state === 'done') {
    return (
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-kind-clawback text-white">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d="m5 12 5 5L20 7" /></svg>
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (state === 'working') return <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center"><Spinner /></span>;
  return <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-full border-2 border-line" />;
}

/** Collapse repeats ("Fact-Checker confirmed a benefit card" ×4) so the live list stays short. */
function collapse(lines: TraceLine[]): { text: string; count: number; status: TraceLine['status']; key: string }[] {
  const out: { text: string; count: number; status: TraceLine['status']; key: string }[] = [];
  for (const l of lines) {
    const text = describeLine(l);
    const last = out[out.length - 1];
    if (last && last.text === text) last.count++;
    else out.push({ text, count: 1, status: l.status, key: l.trace_id });
  }
  return out;
}

/** Short status pills from the live stream, in parent words. */
function StatusPills({ stream }: { stream: StreamState }) {
  const pills = pillLines(stream);
  if (pills.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <ul className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2" data-testid="status-pills" aria-live="polite">
      {pills.map((p) => (
        <li key={p.key} className={cn('rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-[13px] font-semibold', p.state === 'done' ? 'border-line bg-paper text-ink-2' : p.state === 'failed' ? 'border-kind-recall text-kind-recall' : 'border-coral text-ink')}>{p.text}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

/** Cards to show the owner while the check runs: the last saved results, with each fresh card replacing its saved copy. */
export function liveCards(saved: FeedCard[], stream: StreamState): FeedCard[] {
  const fresh = new Set(stream.cards.map((c) => c.id));
  const gone = new Set(stream.removed);
  return sortCards([...saved.filter((c) => !fresh.has(c.id) && !gone.has(c.id)), ...stream.cards]);
}

function LiveCards({ cards, today, fromSaved }: { cards: FeedCard[]; today?: string; fromSaved: boolean }) {
  if (cards.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section className="mt-6" data-testid="live-cards">
      {fromSaved && <p data-testid="saved-feed-note" className="text-[14px] text-ink-2">From your last check. We’re updating these now, and new cards will appear as they’re ready.</p>}
      <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
        {cards.map((c) => <FeedCardView key={c.id} card={c} today={today} />)}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * The parent's "Checking" screen. The lines come from the family's own answers and appear one at a time, about 1.3 seconds apart,
 * and stay. Only after the last line (and only once the run has really finished) does the "We found $X" card appear.
 * Nothing moves on by itself: the results open when the parent taps "View my results".
 */
function ParentProgress({ lines, shown, ready, waiting, elapsed, stream, totalCents, onReveal }: {
  lines: CheckLine[]; shown: number; ready: boolean; waiting: boolean; elapsed: number; stream: StreamState; totalCents: number | null; onReveal: () => void;
}) {
  const allShown = ready && shown >= lines.length;
  const revealed = allShown && totalCents !== null;
  return (
    <section aria-live="polite">
      <h1 className="mt-6 text-[30px] font-extrabold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-0.03em]">
        {revealed ? <>All <span className="text-coral">checked.</span></> : <>We’re checking <span className="text-coral">for you.</span></>}
      </h1>
      {!revealed && (
        <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] text-ink-2">
          We are checking government, recall and store information for your family. This is often quick, and can sometimes take a minute or two.
        </p>
      )}
      <ol className="bundle-card mt-5 space-y-3.5 p-5" data-testid="parent-steps">
        {!ready || shown === 0 ? <li className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[15px] text-ink-2"><Spinner /> Getting started…</li> : null}
        {lines.slice(0, shown).map((l) => (
          <li key={l.key} className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <StepGlyph state="done" />
            <span className="sr-only">Done: </span>
            <span className="flex flex-col">
              <span className="text-[15px] font-semibold leading-snug text-ink">{l.title}</span>
              <span className="text-[13px] leading-snug text-ink-2">{l.caption}</span>
            </span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      {waiting && <p className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-2"><Spinner /> Still finishing the last check…</p>}
      {!ready && <StatusPills stream={stream} />}
      {revealed ? (
        <div className="mt-5 rounded-3xl bg-ink p-5 text-cream" data-testid="checking-reveal">
          <p className="sr-only">We found {fmtUsdShort(totalCents)} for your family.</p>
          <div aria-hidden="true">
            <p className="text-[20px] font-extrabold">We found</p>
            <p className="tabular text-[52px] font-extrabold leading-none tracking-[-0.03em]">{fmtUsdShort(totalCents)}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[20px] font-extrabold">for your family.</p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={onReveal} className="mt-4 flex min-h-[56px] w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-coral px-4 text-[17px] font-bold text-white transition active:scale-[.99]">
            View my results <span aria-hidden="true" className="ml-1">→</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className="tabular mt-4 text-right text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-2">{elapsed}s</p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/** The owner's "Checking" screen: agent steps and live activity from the trace (reviewer code only). */
function Progress({ lines, elapsed, stream }: { lines: TraceLine[]; elapsed: number; stream: StreamState }) {
  const recent = collapse(lines).slice(-6).reverse(); // newest first, so it shows above the fold
  return (
    <section aria-live="polite">
      <h1 className="mt-6 text-[30px] font-extrabold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-0.03em]">
        Your agents are <span className="text-coral">on it.</span>
      </h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] text-ink-2">
        They are checking government, recall and store data for your family. This is often quick, and can sometimes take a minute or two.
      </p>

      <ol className="bundle-card mt-5 space-y-3 p-5">
        {STEPS.map((s) => {
          const state = s.doneWhen(lines) ? 'done' : s.startedWhen(lines) ? 'working' : 'waiting';
          return (
            <li key={s.agent} className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <StepIcon state={state} />
              <span className={cn('text-[15px] leading-snug', state === 'waiting' ? 'text-ink-2' : 'font-semibold text-ink')}>{s.label}</span>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>

      <StatusPills stream={stream} />
      <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="eyebrow text-ink-2">Live activity</h2>
        <span className="tabular text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-2">{elapsed}s</span>
      </div>
      <ul className="mt-2 space-y-2" data-testid="progress-lines">
        {recent.length === 0 && (
          <li className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-paper px-4 py-3 text-[14px] text-ink-2"><Spinner /> Waking up the agents…</li>
        )}
        {recent.map((r) => (
          <li key={r.key} className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper px-4 py-3 text-[14px] leading-snug text-ink">
            <span aria-hidden="true" className={cn('mt-1.5 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full', r.status === 'ok' ? 'bg-kind-clawback' : r.status === 'blocked' || r.status === 'error' ? 'bg-kind-recall' : 'bg-coral')} />
            <span>{r.text}{r.count > 1 && <span className="font-bold text-ink-2"> ×{r.count}</span>}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

export default function Feed() {
  const { runId = '' } = useParams<{ runId: string }>();
  const [run, setRun] = useState<SavedRun | null>(() => loadRun(runId)?.runId === runId ? loadRun(runId) : null);
  const [traceLines, setLines] = useState<TraceLine[]>([]);
  const owner = !!ownerToken();
  const [chipInfo, setChipInfo] = useState<{ family?: SavedRun['family']; today?: string; demoDate?: boolean }>({});
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const started = useRef(Date.now());
  const [stream, setStream] = useState<StreamState>(emptyStream);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<FeedCard[]>([]);
  /** The finished run, held back until the parent taps "View my results" (the owner view opens it straight away). */
  const [finished, setFinished] = useState<SavedRun | null>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(0);
  const askedSaved = useRef(false);

  // Keep the "Ns" counter moving while the stream is quiet.
  const startedAtMs = useRef<number | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (run) return;
    const t = setInterval(() => setElapsed(Math.max(0, Math.round((Date.now() - (startedAtMs.current ?? started.current)) / 1000))), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [run]);

  // Instant feed: one quick look at the run tells us the family, so its saved results show before any stream message arrives.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (run) return;
    let live = true;
    ownerApi().run(runId).then((status) => {
      const t = Date.parse(status.startedAt || '');
      if (live && Number.isFinite(t)) startedAtMs.current = t;
      if (!live || askedSaved.current || !status.familyId) return;
      askedSaved.current = true;
      setChipInfo((c) => c.family ? c : { family: status.family, today: status.today, demoDate: status.demoDate });
      // The last saved results are shown to the owner only. A parent sees just the checklist, then "We found $X" (no flicker of old cards).
      if (!ownerToken()) return;
      api.latestRun(status.familyId).then((s) => {
        if (live && s.status === 'done' && s.result && s.result.runId !== runId) {
          setSaved(s.result.cards.map((c) => sanitizeCard(c)).filter((c): c is FeedCard => !!c && c.verdict !== 'blocked'));
        }
      }).catch(() => { /* no saved run (or the server restarted): the normal checking screen is fine */ });
    }).catch(() => { /* the follower below reports real problems */ });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [runId, run]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (run || finished) return; // already finished (or restored from this tab)
    return followRun(runId, ownerApi(), {
      onStream: setStream,
      onStatus: (status, trace) => {
        if (trace) setLines(trace);
        setChipInfo({ family: status.family, today: status.today, demoDate: status.demoDate });
        const t = Date.parse(status.startedAt || '');
        if (Number.isFinite(t)) startedAtMs.current = t;
        setElapsed(Math.round((Date.now() - (startedAtMs.current ?? started.current)) / 1000));
      },
      onDone: (status) => {
        const saved: SavedRun = { runId, familyId: status.familyId, family: status.family, today: status.today, demoDate: status.demoDate, result: status.result! };
        if (ownerToken()) { saveRun(saved); setRun(saved); } else setFinished(saved);
      },
      onFailed: setError,
      onGiveUp: (kind) => setError(kind === 'expired'
        ? 'This run has expired. Start a new one; it only takes a minute.'
        : 'We lost touch with Bundle. Check your connection and try again.'),
    }, { intervalMs: POLL_MS });
  }, [runId, run, finished]);

  const family = run?.family ?? finished?.family ?? chipInfo.family;
  const today = run?.today ?? chipInfo.today;
  const chip = familyChip(family, today, run?.familyId ?? finished?.familyId);

  // The checking lines: built from the family's answers, shown one at a time.
  const familyKey = JSON.stringify(family ?? null);
  const lines = useMemo(() => checkLines(family), [familyKey]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const ready = !!family || !!finished;
  // All the line timers are set up front (not chained through re-renders), so the pace is steady whatever else is happening.
  const lineCount = lines.length;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (run || owner || !ready) return;
    const timers = Array.from({ length: lineCount }, (_, k) => setTimeout(() => setShown((n) => Math.max(n, k + 1)), FIRST_LINE_MS + k * LINE_GAP_MS));
    return () => timers.forEach(clearTimeout);
  }, [run, owner, ready, lineCount]);
  // "Double-checked" is a promise the run has really kept, so it waits for the run to finish.
  const visible = finished ? shown : Math.min(shown, lineCount - 1);
  const waiting = ready && !finished && !run && shown >= lineCount - 1;
  const total = finished ? finished.result.receipt.moneyBackCents + finished.result.receipt.likelyBenefitsCents : null;
  const reveal = () => { if (finished) { saveRun(finished); setRun(finished); } };

  // The finished run's full audit log (owner only); only needed for the "We caught these" detail.
  const [doneLines, setDoneLines] = useState<TraceLine[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (owner && run?.result.blocked?.length) ownerApi().trace(run.runId).then((l) => setDoneLines(Array.isArray(l) ? l : [])).catch(() => {});
  }, [run?.runId, owner]);

  if (error) {
    return (
      <AppShell chip={chip}>
        <h1 className="mt-6 text-[28px] font-extrabold leading-tight tracking-[-0.02em]">That didn’t work.</h1>
        <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-[16px] text-ink-2">{error}</p>
        <Link href="/" className="mt-6 flex min-h-[56px] items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-ink text-[17px] font-bold text-cream">Start again</Link>
      </AppShell>
    );
  }

  if (!run) {
    const cards = liveCards(saved, stream);
    return (
      <AppShell chip={chip}>
        {owner
          ? <Progress lines={traceLines} elapsed={elapsed} stream={stream} />
          : <ParentProgress lines={lines} shown={visible} ready={ready} waiting={waiting} elapsed={elapsed} stream={stream} totalCents={total} onReveal={reveal} />}
        {owner && <LiveCards cards={cards} today={today} fromSaved={saved.length > 0 && stream.cards.length === 0} />}
      </AppShell>
    );
  }

  // The finished run opens as Version B: five tabs, starting on Home. The tabs read everything from the run's own result.
  return (
    <VersionB
      run={run}
      owner={owner}
      lines={doneLines}
      ownerPanel={<AgentWorkspace runId={runId} cards={[...run.result.cards, ...(run.result.blocked ?? [])].map((c) => ({ id: c.id, title: c.title }))} />}
    />
  );
}
