      className="mt-3 flex min-h-[64px] w-full flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-[#F5C4B0] bg-coral-tint px-4 py-2 transition active:scale-[.99] disabled:opacity-60"
    >
      <span className="text-[17px] font-bold text-coral-deep">{busy ? 'Starting…' : 'Try a sample family'}</span>
      <span className="text-[14px] font-medium text-coral-deep">Made-up data. See a finished list in one tap.</span>
    </button>
  );
}

function Choice({ title, sub, icon, onClick }: { title: string; sub: string; icon: ReactNode; onClick: () => void }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button" onClick={onClick}
      className="flex min-h-[172px] flex-col gap-2.5 rounded-3xl border border-line bg-paper p-[18px] text-left shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(27,23,20,.04),0_12px_32px_rgba(27,23,20,.06)] transition active:scale-[.99]"
    >
      <span className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-[14px] bg-coral-tint text-coral-deep">{icon}</span>
      <span className="text-[19px] font-extrabold tracking-[-0.01em]">{title}</span>
      <span className="text-[14px] leading-[1.35] text-ink-2">{sub}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

export default function Onboarding() {
  const [, navigate] = useLocation();
  const today = localToday();
  const limits = dateLimits(today);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>(1);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>('born');
  const [date, setDate] = useState('');
  const [zip, setZip] = useState('');
  // Q4 and Q5 live here too, so Back keeps every answer.
  const [household, setHousehold] = useState<Household | null>(null);
  const [work1, setWork1] = useState<WorkStatus | null>(null);
  const [work2, setWork2] = useState<WorkStatus | null>(null);
  const [workSkipped, setWorkSkipped] = useState(false);
  const [insurance, setInsurance] = useState<InsuranceType | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  /** True when the server turned down a ZIP this screen accepted (server knows fewer states; any-state support is W2-STATE). */
  const [zipRejected, setZipRejected] = useState(false);

  const go = (s: Step) => { setError(null); setZipRejected(false); setStep(s); };

  async function start(body: RunRequest) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    setZipRejected(false);
    try {
      const { runId, familyId } = await api.startRun(body);
      // The server saved the family; keep its id so this browser can find the family again.
      if (familyId && !('familyId' in body)) rememberFamilyId(familyId);
      navigate(`/feed/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`);
    } catch (e) {
      const err = e as Error & { status?: number };
      if ('zip' in body && err.status === 400 && /ZIP/i.test(err.message)) {
        // The ZIP is on screen 3, so take the parent back there (their other answers are kept).
        setStep(3);
        setError(zipRejectedMessage(body.zip));
        setZipRejected(true);
      } else {
        setError(err.message);
      }
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function onDate(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!date) return setError(stage === 'expecting' ? 'Enter your due date. Your doctor’s estimate is fine.' : 'Enter your baby’s birth date.');
    const rangeError = dateRangeError(stage === 'expecting' ? 'due' : 'birth', date, today);
    if (rangeError) return setError(rangeError);
    go(3);
  }

  function onZip(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!/^\d{5}$/.test(zip) || !stateForZip(zip)) return setError('Enter a valid 5-digit US ZIP code.');
    go(4);
  }

  /** The finished answers go to the server in one request. Anything the parent skipped is simply left out. */
  function finish(ins: InsuranceType) {
    const answered = !workSkipped && household && work1 && (household === 'one' || work2);
    void start({
      zip, ...(stage === 'expecting' ? { dueDate: date } : { birthDate: date }),
      ...(answered ? { household, parent1Work: work1, ...(household === 'two' ? { parent2Work: work2! } : {}) } : {}),
      insurance: ins,
    } as RunRequest);
  }

  const rows: { who: 'you' | 'partner'; label: string; value: WorkStatus | null; set: (w: WorkStatus) => void }[] =
    household === 'two'
      ? [{ who: 'you', label: 'You', value: work1, set: setWork1 }, { who: 'partner', label: 'Your partner', value: work2, set: setWork2 }]
      : household === 'one' ? [{ who: 'you', label: 'You', value: work1, set: setWork1 }] : [];
  const workDone = rows.length > 0 && rows.every((r) => r.value);
  const route: DaycareRoute = workSkipped ? 'general' : daycareRoute({ household, parent1Work: work1, parent2Work: work2 });
  const state = stateForZip(zip)?.code;

  if (step === 1) {
    return (
      <Frame step={1}>
        <h1 className="mt-9 text-[36px] font-extrabold leading-[1.06] tracking-[-0.03em]">
          Let’s find what your family is <span className="text-coral">owed.</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-3 text-[16px] leading-[1.45] text-ink-2">Cash, credits and free stuff, checked for you. About 30 seconds. No sign-up.</p>
        <p className="mb-3 mt-9 text-[20px] font-extrabold tracking-[-0.01em]">Where are you right now?</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <Choice title="We’re expecting" sub="Free registry boxes now, money once baby arrives" icon={<ClockIcon />} onClick={() => { setStage('expecting'); setDate(''); go(2); }} />
          <Choice title="Baby’s here" sub="Deadlines to catch, money to claim, savings on what you buy" icon={<HeartIcon />} onClick={() => { setStage('born'); setDate(''); go(2); }} />
        </div>
        <div className="min-h-8 flex-grow" />
        <Alert text={error} />
        <SampleButton busy={busy} onClick={() => start({ familyId: 'maya' })} />
        <p className="mt-4 text-center text-[13px] leading-[1.4] text-ink-2">We never ask for bank details to get started. Bundle finds and prepares. You decide.</p>
      </Frame>
    );
  }

  if (step === 2) {
    const expecting = stage === 'expecting';
    const age = expecting ? null : babyAgeLine(date, today);
    return (
      <Frame step={2} onBack={() => go(1)}>
        <form className="flex flex-grow flex-col" onSubmit={onDate} noValidate>
          <span className="mt-10 inline-flex w-fit rounded-full bg-coral-tint px-3 py-1 text-[13px] font-bold text-coral-deep">{expecting ? 'We’re expecting' : 'Baby’s here'}</span>
          <h1 className="mt-3 text-[30px] font-extrabold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-0.03em]">
            {expecting ? 'When’s your baby due?' : 'Congrats! What’s your baby’s birthday?'}
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-2.5 text-[16px] leading-[1.45] text-ink-2">
            {expecting
              ? 'The due date from your doctor is fine, and we update it when baby arrives.'
              : 'Some deadlines count from the day baby was born, so we need the exact date.'}
          </p>
          <label className={fieldBox}>
            <span className={fieldLabel}>{expecting ? 'Due date' : 'Birth date'}</span>
            <input
              className={fieldInput} type="date" value={date}
              min={expecting ? limits.dueMin : limits.birthMin} max={expecting ? limits.dueMax : today}
              onChange={(e) => { setDate(e.target.value); setError(null); }}
            />
          </label>
          {age && (
            <p className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 text-[15px] font-bold text-[#1E6B47]">
              <CheckIcon />
              <span>{age}</span>
            </p>
          )}
          <Alert text={error} />
          <div className="min-h-8 flex-grow" />
          <button type="submit" className={primary}>Next</button>
        </form>
      </Frame>
    );
  }

  if (step === 3) {
    const msg = zipMessage(zip);
    const covered = stateForZip(zip)?.covered;
    return (
      <Frame step={3} onBack={() => go(2)}>
        <form className="flex flex-grow flex-col" onSubmit={onZip} noValidate>
          <h1 className="mt-10 text-[30px] font-extrabold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-0.03em]">Where do you live?</h1>
          <p className="mt-2.5 text-[16px] leading-[1.45] text-ink-2">Every state has its own programs. Your ZIP code tells us which ones are yours.</p>
          <label className={fieldBox}>
            <span className={fieldLabel}>ZIP code</span>
            <input
              className={fieldInput} type="text" inputMode="numeric" autoComplete="postal-code" maxLength={5} placeholder="02139"
              value={zip} aria-describedby="zip-state"
              onChange={(e) => { setZip(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 5)); setError(null); setZipRejected(false); }}
            />
          </label>
          <p id="zip-state" aria-live="polite" className={`mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 text-[15px] font-bold ${covered ? 'text-[#1E6B47]' : 'text-ink-2'}`}>
            {msg && covered && <CheckIcon />}
            {msg && <span>{msg}</span>}
          </p>
          <Alert text={error} />
          {zipRejected && <SampleButton busy={busy} onClick={() => start({ familyId: 'maya' })} />}
          <div className="min-h-8 flex-grow" />
          <button type="submit" disabled={busy} className={primary}>Looks right</button>
        </form>
      </Frame>
    );
  }

  if (step === 4) {
    return (
      <Frame step={4} onBack={() => go(3)}>
        <h1 className="mt-10 text-[30px] font-extrabold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-0.03em]">Who’s raising this baby?</h1>
        <div role="group" aria-label="Household" className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {HOUSEHOLDS.map((h) => (
            <button
              key={h.id} type="button" aria-pressed={household === h.id}
              onClick={() => { setHousehold(h.id); setWorkSkipped(false); }}
              className={`min-h-[56px] rounded-2xl border-2 px-4 text-center text-[17px] font-bold transition active:scale-[.99] ${household === h.id ? 'border-coral bg-coral-tint' : 'border-line bg-paper'}`}
            >{h.label}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {rows.length > 0 && (
          <div data-testid="work-rows">
            <p className="mt-6 text-[19px] font-extrabold leading-snug tracking-[-0.01em]">{household === 'two' ? 'How does each of you earn money?' : 'How do you earn money?'}</p>
            {rows.map((r) => (
              <div key={r.who} role="group" aria-label={r.label} className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                {household === 'two' && <p aria-hidden="true" className="eyebrow text-ink-2">{r.label}</p>}
                {WORK.map((w) => (
                  <button key={w.id} type="button" aria-pressed={r.value === w.id} onClick={() => { r.set(w.id); setWorkSkipped(false); }} className={optionBox(r.value === w.id)}>
                    <span className="block text-[16px] font-extrabold leading-tight">{w.label}</span>
                    <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">{w.hint}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        {workDone && <Payoff text={WORK_LINE[route]} />}
        <QuietLinks
          skipLabel="Something else / prefer not to say"
          onSkip={() => { setWorkSkipped(true); go(5); }}
          why="So we can check daycare tax savings. Work benefits like these depend on how each parent earns."
        />
        <div className="min-h-8 flex-grow" />
        <button type="button" disabled={!workDone} onClick={() => { setWorkSkipped(false); go(5); }} className={primary}>Continue</button>
      </Frame>
    );
  }

  const choices = insuranceChoices(state);
  const options = choices.filter((c) => c.id !== 'none_or_not_sure');
  const none = choices.find((c) => c.id === 'none_or_not_sure')!;
  return (
    <Frame step={5} onBack={() => go(4)}>
      <Payoff text={PAYOFF_LINE[route]} />
      <h1 className="mt-5 text-[30px] font-extrabold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-0.03em]">Where do you get your health insurance?</h1>
      <div className="mt-5 space-y-2.5">
        {options.map((o) => (
          <button
            key={o.id} type="button" disabled={busy} aria-pressed={insurance === o.id}
            onClick={() => { setInsurance(o.id); finish(o.id); }}
            className={`flex min-h-[60px] items-center gap-3 ${optionBox(insurance === o.id)}`}
          >
            <span aria-hidden="true" className={`h-5 w-5 shrink-0 rounded-full border-2 ${insurance === o.id ? 'border-coral bg-coral' : 'border-line'}`} />
            <span className="text-[16px] font-extrabold leading-snug">{o.label}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <Alert text={error} />
      <QuietLinks
        skipLabel={none.label} disabled={busy}
        onSkip={() => { setInsurance('none_or_not_sure'); finish('none_or_not_sure'); }}
        why="So we can give you the right deadline. Each kind of insurance has its own."
      />
      {busy && <p role="status" className="mt-4 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-2">Starting…</p>}
    </Frame>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell';
import { api, loadRun, reviewerToken, type Proposal, type Scoreboard } from '@/lib/bundle';

function Confidence({ value, dark = false }: { value: number; dark?: boolean }) {
  const pct = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value)) * 100);
  return (
    <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
      <div className={cn('h-2 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full', dark ? 'bg-[#3A322C]' : 'bg-[#F1ECE4]')} role="meter" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={pct} aria-label="Confidence">
        <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-coral" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
      </div>
      <span className={cn('tabular shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-[13px] font-bold', dark ? 'text-[#D9CFC4]' : 'text-ink-2')}>{pct}% confident</span>
    </div>
  );
}

const ruleId = (p: Proposal) => `CL-${String(p.id).padStart(2, '0')}`;
const reports = (p: Proposal) => `${p.sourceFeedbackIds.length} parent ${p.sourceFeedbackIds.length === 1 ? 'report' : 'reports'}`;

function Stat({ value, label, accent }: { value: string; label: string; accent?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper p-4">
      <p className={cn('tabular text-[28px] font-extrabold leading-none tracking-[-0.03em]', accent ? 'text-coral-deep' : 'text-ink')}>{value}</p>
      <p className="mt-1.5 text-[13px] font-semibold leading-snug text-ink-2">{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Reviewer controls are hidden from parents; a reviewer opens this page with ?reviewer=1 to type the code. */
function reviewerLinkOn(): boolean {
  try { return new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).has('reviewer'); } catch { return false; }
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'wouter';
import Onboarding from '@/pages/Onboarding';
import { api, FAMILY_ID_KEY, runFromStatus, savedFamilyId, saveRun } from '@/lib/bundle';
import { clearStartOver, peekStartOver } from '@/lib/account';

type Mode = 'opening' | 'questions' | 'trouble';

/**
 * The front door. If this browser already has a saved family (localStorage `bundle_family_id`), open that family's last results
 * straight away. If not, or after "Start over", start the five questions.
 */
export default function Start() {
  const [, navigate] = useLocation();
  const [id] = useState(() => (peekStartOver() ? null : savedFamilyId()));
  useEffect(() => { clearStartOver(); }, []); // "Start over" counts once
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>(id ? 'opening' : 'questions');
  const [tries, setTries] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    let live = true;
    const open = (r: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof runFromStatus>>) => {
      saveRun(r);
      navigate(`/feed/${encodeURIComponent(r.runId)}`, { replace: true });
    };
    const forgetId = () => { try { localStorage.removeItem(FAMILY_ID_KEY); } catch { /* ignore */ } setMode('questions'); };
    // Every step first checks `live`: this effect can be cancelled while a request is out (and run again), and a cancelled
    // run must never change anything, least of all forget the saved profile.
    (async () => {
      try {
        const r = runFromStatus(await api.latestRun(id));
        if (!live) return;
        if (r) open(r); else setMode('trouble'); // a saved result is always a finished one; anything else is a hiccup, not "no profile"
      } catch (e) {
        if (!live) return;
        if ((e as { status?: number }).status !== 404) return setMode('trouble');
        // The family is saved but has no finished run on the server right now: check them again.
        try {
          const { runId } = await api.startRun({ familyId: id });
          if (live) navigate(`/feed/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`, { replace: true });
        } catch (e2) {
          if (!live) return;
          if ((e2 as { status?: number }).status === 404) forgetId(); else setMode('trouble');
        }
      }
    })();
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [id, tries, navigate]);

  if (mode === 'questions') return <Onboarding />;
  return (
    <div className="min-h-[100dvh] bg-cream text-ink">
      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[480px] px-5 pt-5">
        <span className="text-[26px] font-extrabold tracking-[-0.03em]">bundle<span className="text-coral">.</span></span>
        {mode === 'opening' ? (
          <p role="status" className="mt-10 text-[18px] font-bold text-ink-2">Opening your saved plan…</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <h1 className="mt-10 text-[28px] font-extrabold leading-tight tracking-[-0.02em]">We couldn’t reach Bundle.</h1>
            <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-[16px] text-ink-2">Your plan is still saved on this device. Check your connection and try again.</p>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => { setMode('opening'); setTries((n) => n + 1); }} className="mt-6 flex min-h-[56px] w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-ink text-[17px] font-bold text-cream">Try again</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setMode('questions')} className="mt-2 flex min-h-[48px] w-full items-center justify-center text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-2 underline decoration-line decoration-2 underline-offset-4">Answer the questions again</button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import os from 'os';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { render, screen, cleanup, waitFor, within, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import AgentWorkspace, { groupAgentLog, loopsOf, type AgentLogData } from '../AgentWorkspace';
import { TraceLogger } from '../../../../server/agents/trace';

afterEach(() => { cleanup(); sessionStorage.clear(); });

/**
 * Lines come from the real trace writer (TraceLogger), the same code every run uses, and are read back
 * from the file it wrote. Nothing here is a hand-written log file.
 */
function realLog(): AgentLogData {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'aw-'));
  jest.spyOn(process.stdout, 'write').mockImplementation(() => true);
  const t = new TraceLogger('maya-r1', dir);
  const ev = (agent_name: string, action: string, input_summary: string, output_summary: string, status: 'ok' | 'retry' | 'blocked' | 'fallback' | 'error' = 'ok', retry_count = 0, agentLog?: any) =>
    t.log({ agent_name, action, input_summary, output_summary, target_agent: null, confidence: null, retry_count, status, agentLog });
  // The raw events below use the exact words the agents write today. server/__tests__/loopsEndToEnd.test.ts drives the real
  // agents into the same loopsOf and checks every loop against the lines they really produce.
  ev('benefits', 'evaluate', 'rule MA_PFML', '$0.00');
  // Eligibility loop: the Planner's answer to the Fine Print Lawyer's one counter-question
  ev('benefits', 'eligibility_check', 'rule MA_PFML (window)', 'confirmed: state program table agrees: 365-day window', 'ok', 1);
  // Fact-Checker sends a card back once (a targeted correction), then passes it
  ev('fact_checker', 'correction', 'clawback card clawback-price-5 from clawback', 'round 1: Fix only these lines: amount said $90.00, source says $20.00', 'retry', 1);
  ev('fact_checker', 'verify', 'clawback card clawback-price-5 from clawback: claim {"type":"price_adjustment"}', 'verified');
  // Court: an ordinary case (no rebuttal needed), then one rebuttal round on offer 1302
  ev('fine_print_court', 'court_debate', 'offer 1301 outcome', 'approve, agreed, no rebuttal needed');
  ev('deal_hunter', 'argue', 'offer 1302', 'looks fine');
  ev('fine_print_court', 'court_debate', 'offer 1302 rebuttal round 1 of 1', 'code screen says reject; Judge said approve. Both sides answer once, then the Judge rules again', 'retry', 1);
  ev('fine_print_lawyer', 'rebut', 'offer 1302', 'answered the hunter', 'ok', 1);
  ev('judge', 'rule', 'offer 1302', 'approve');
  // a recall alert checked against the recall record
  ev('fact_checker', 'verify', 'recall card recall-cpsc-10560 from recall: claim {"type":"recall","recallId":10560,"evidence":"lot code ABC123 appears in the recall notice"}', 'verified');
  // a photo retry, then the second read
  ev('photo_reader', 'retry_request', 'receipt photo 1, round 1 had problems', 'asking the vision model once more, told what was wrong', 'retry', 1);
  ev('photo_reader', 'vision_extract', 'receipt photo 1 round 2', 'read 3 items', 'ok', 1);
  // saved grades: "none yet" (not counted) and one reused (counted)
  ev('fine_print_court', 'saved_verdicts', '5 offer(s) in play', 'no saved grades yet');
  ev('judge', 'reuse_saved_grade', 'offer 1303', 'approve: same wording as when it was graded, so the saved grade is reused (no AI)');
  // a money-back deal stopped before the Judge because the item is under a recall
  ev('clawback', 'safety_kill', 'clawback-price-9: KEAWIS Crib Mattress', 'killed before the Judge: recall cpsc-10560; do not encourage buying or claiming a rebate on this item', 'blocked', 0,
    { agent: 'ClawbackHunter', action: 'reject_card', status: 'rejected', target: 'RecallChecker' });
  // something that belongs to the whole run
  ev('zetaris', 'query', 'SELECT 1', '1 rows (sample cache)');
  const file = path.join(dir, fs.readdirSync(dir).find((f) => f.startsWith('run_bundle_'))!);
  const lines = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l));
  return {
    runId: 'maya-r1', traceId: t.agentTraceId, lines, skipped: 0, backend: 'hmem-local', lessons: [],
    notes: [
      { from_agent: 'ClawbackHunter', to_agent: 'RecallChecker', type: 'question', about: 'clawback-price-5', round: 0, body: 'Is the playard on a recall list?' },
      { from_agent: 'RecallChecker', to_agent: 'ClawbackHunter', type: 'answer', about: 'clawback-price-5', round: 1, body: 'No recall found.' },
    ],
  };
}

const cards = [
  { id: 'clawback-price-5', title: 'Price drop on your Graco playard' },
  { id: 'discount-1302', title: 'Newborn diaper offer' },
  { id: 'recall-cpsc-10560', title: 'Recall alert: KEAWIS Crib Mattress' },
];

describe('loopsOf: which loop a log line belongs to', () => {
  const data = realLog();
  const find = (re: RegExp) => data.lines.find((l) => re.test(l.input_summary))!;
  it('recognises every loop from the words the agents really write', () => {
    expect(loopsOf(data.lines.find((l) => /Fix only these lines/.test(l.output_summary))!)).toEqual(['send_back']);
    expect(loopsOf(find(/rebuttal round 1 of 1/))).toEqual(['rebuttal']);
    expect(loopsOf(find(/round 1 had problems/))).toEqual(['photo_retry']);
    expect(loopsOf(find(/^recall card recall-cpsc-10560/))).toEqual(['recall_check']);
    expect(loopsOf(data.lines.find((l) => /saved grade is reused/.test(l.output_summary))!)).toEqual(['saved_verdict']);
    expect(loopsOf(find(/^rule MA_PFML \(window\)/))).toEqual(['eligibility']);
    expect(loopsOf(find(/^clawback-price-9/))).toEqual(['safety_kill']);
  });
  it('plain lines are in no loop, including words that only look like one', () => {
    expect(loopsOf(find(/^rule MA_PFML$/))).toEqual([]);
    expect(loopsOf(find(/offer 1301 outcome/))).toEqual([]); // "no rebuttal needed" is not a rebuttal
    expect(loopsOf(find(/5 offer\(s\) in play/))).toEqual([]); // "no saved grades yet" is not a reuse
    expect(loopsOf(find(/^receipt photo 1 round 2/))).toEqual([]); // the second read is the same retry, not another
    expect(loopsOf(data.lines.find((l) => l.input_summary.startsWith('clawback card clawback-price-5 from clawback: claim'))!)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('groupAgentLog: per card and per loop', () => {
  const data = realLog();
  const g = groupAgentLog(data, cards);
  const byKey = (k: string) => g.groups.find((x) => x.key === k)!;

  it('counts every loop', () => {
    expect(g.counts).toEqual({ send_back: 1, rebuttal: 1, eligibility: 1, photo_retry: 1, recall_check: 1, saved_verdict: 1, safety_kill: 1 });
  });
  it('puts a card\'s lines together under the card\'s title, offers matched to their cards', () => {
    expect(byKey('clawback-price-5').label).toBe('Price drop on your Graco playard');
    expect(byKey('clawback-price-5').lines).toHaveLength(2); // the send-back is found by its bare card id
    expect(byKey('discount-1302').label).toBe('Newborn diaper offer');
    expect(byKey('discount-1302').lines).toHaveLength(4); // hunter, the rebuttal round opener, lawyer's answer, judge
    expect(byKey('recall-cpsc-10560').lines).toHaveLength(1);
  });
  it('hangs workspace notes on their card, in round order', () => {
    expect(byKey('clawback-price-5').notes.map((n) => n.round)).toEqual([0, 1]);
  });
  it('keeps run-wide lines in one "Whole run" group at the end', () => {
    const last = g.groups[g.groups.length - 1];
    expect(last.key).toBe('__run');
    expect(last.lines.some((l) => l.input_summary === 'SELECT 1')).toBe(true);
  });
  it('without card titles it still groups, using plain labels', () => {
    const plain = groupAgentLog(data, []);
    expect(plain.groups.find((x) => x.key === 'offer 1302')!.label).toBe('Offer 1302');
    expect(plain.groups.find((x) => x.key === 'clawback-price-5')).toBeTruthy();
  });
  it('a note about a card with no log lines still gets a group', () => {
    const extra = groupAgentLog({ ...data, lines: [], notes: [data.notes[0]] }, cards);
    expect(extra.groups.map((x) => x.key)).toEqual(['clawback-price-5']);
  });
});

function mount(opts: { token?: string; data?: AgentLogData; status?: number } = {}) {
  const fetchMock = jest.fn(async (_url: string, _init?: RequestInit) => ({

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, cleanup, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { Router } from 'wouter';
import { memoryLocation } from 'wouter/memory-location';
import Smarter from '../Smarter';

afterEach(() => { cleanup(); sessionStorage.clear(); });

const rule = { id: 1, text: 'Reject offers that turn into paid memberships', confidence: 0.7, sourceFeedbackIds: ['1', '2'], status: 'proposed', memoryId: null };

function mount(owner: boolean) {
  if (owner) sessionStorage.setItem('bundle:reviewerToken', 'sekret');
  const fetchMock = jest.fn(async (url: string, init?: RequestInit) => {
    const isOwner = (init?.headers as Record<string, string> | undefined)?.['x-reviewer-token'] === 'sekret';
    const body = String(url).includes('case-law')
      ? isOwner ? { proposals: [rule], approved: [], proposedCount: 1, approvedCount: 0 } : { proposals: [], approved: [], proposedCount: 1, approvedCount: 2 }
      : { scoreboard: null };
    return { ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => body };
  });
  (global as any).fetch = fetchMock;
  const { hook } = memoryLocation({ path: '/smarter' });
  render(<Router hook={hook}><Smarter /></Router>);
  return fetchMock;
}

describe('Smarter owner view split (W1-OWNER)', () => {
  it('a parent sees a plain count, never rule text, proposals, Approve or the scoreboard', async () => {
    const f = mount(false);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('parent-rules').textContent).toMatch(/2 lessons/));
    expect(screen.queryByText(/Approve/)).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/Reviewer mode|Reviewer code/)).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText(/the helper that turns parent reports into a new rule/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/the helper that decides whether a deal is safe to show/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/Scoreboard/)).toBeNull();
    expect(f.mock.calls.some(([u]) => String(u).includes('scoreboard'))).toBe(false);
  });
  it('the owner sees the proposed rule with its Approve button', async () => {
    mount(true);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(rule.text)).toBeTruthy());
    expect(screen.getByText('Approve rule')).toBeTruthy();
  });
  it('the owner asks for the scoreboard with the reviewer code (the server refuses it without one)', async () => {
    const f = mount(true);
    await waitFor(() => expect(f.mock.calls.some(([u]) => String(u).includes('scoreboard'))).toBe(true));
    for (const [u, init] of f.mock.calls) {
      if (/scoreboard|case-law/.test(String(u))) expect((init?.headers as Record<string, string>)['x-reviewer-token']).toBe('sekret');
    }
  });
});

function NurseryGearGallery({ familyId }: { familyId: string }) {
  const load = useLocker(familyId);
  if (load.s === 'loading') return <p role="status" className="mt-2 text-[15px] text-ink-2">Loading saved nursery gear…</p>;
  if (load.s === 'error') return <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-[15px] text-ink-2">Could not load your saved purchase items right now.</p>;

  const scans = [
    ...load.locker.items.map((item) => ({
      key: `gear-${item.id ?? item.photoId ?? item.productName}`,
      name: item.productName,
      detail: [item.brand, item.modelNumber ? `Model ${item.modelNumber}` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
      thumbnail: item.thumbnail,
      source: 'Gear scan',
    })),
    ...load.locker.receipts.flatMap((receipt) => (receipt.items ?? []).map((item, index) => ({
      key: `receipt-${receipt.photoId}-${index}`,
      name: item.productName,
      detail: [receipt.store, receipt.purchasedOn].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
      thumbnail: receipt.thumbnail,
      source: 'Receipt scan',
    }))),
  ];

  return (
    <section aria-label="Nursery Gear Locker" className="bundle-card mt-3 p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">Nursery Gear Locker</p>
          <p className="text-[16px] font-extrabold">Saved purchase items</p>
        </div>
        <span className="rounded-full bg-cream px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] font-bold text-ink-2">{scans.length} saved</span>
      </div>
      {scans.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-2 text-[15px] leading-snug text-ink-2">No scanned items yet. Gear labels and receipt lines you save will appear here.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2" data-testid="purchase-items-gallery">
          {scans.map((item) => (
            <li key={item.key} className="min-w-0 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper p-3">
              {item.thumbnail ? <img src={item.thumbnail} alt="" className="mb-2 h-20 w-full rounded-xl object-cover" /> : <div aria-hidden="true" className="mb-2 flex h-20 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-cream text-[24px]">🧾</div>}
              <p className="text-[14px] font-extrabold leading-snug">{item.name}</p>
              {item.detail && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12px] leading-snug text-ink-2">{item.detail}</p>}
              <span className="mt-2 inline-block rounded-full bg-[#E3F3EA] px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-[#17643F]">{item.source}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

export default function AccountTab(props: AccountProps) {
  const { run } = props;
  const owner = !!props.owner;
  const family = run.family;
  const guest = !isSampleId(run.familyId);
  const rows = profileRows({ ...family, state: family?.state });
  // A sample family is shown as of its demo date (like the rest of the app), so its memory entries carry that date too.
  const memoryDate = (savedOn: string) => shortDate(!guest && run.demoDate && run.today ? run.today : savedOn);

  // ----- progress ring: how many answers that shape the numbers are in -----
  const filing = useFiling(run.familyId);
  const pump = family?.insurance === 'job' || family?.insurance === 'marketplace';
  const carrier = pump ? loadCarrier(run.familyId) : 'n/a';
  const steps: { key: string; done: boolean; open: () => void }[] = [
    ...rows.map((r) => ({ key: r.key, done: r.answered, open: () => beginEdit(r.key) })),
    { key: 'filing', done: !!filing.filing, open: () => props.go('taxes') },
    ...(pump ? [{ key: 'carrier', done: !!carrier, open: () => props.go('insurance') }] : []),
  ];
  const left = steps.filter((s) => !s.done);
  const pct = Math.round((100 * (steps.length - left.length)) / steps.length);

  // ----- editing the answers -----
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<EditKey | null>(() => peekEdit());
  useEffect(() => { clearEdit(); }, []);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(() => draftFrom());
  function draftFrom() {
    const expecting = !!family?.dueDate && !family?.birthDate;
    return {
      stage: (expecting ? 'expecting' : 'born') as 'expecting' | 'born', date: family?.birthDate ?? family?.dueDate ?? '', zip: family?.zip ?? '',
      household: (family?.household ?? null) as Household | null, work1: (family?.parent1Work ?? null) as WorkStatus | null, work2: (family?.parent2Work ?? null) as WorkStatus | null,
      insurance: (family?.insurance ?? null) as InsuranceType | null,
    };
  }
  function beginEdit(k: EditKey) { setDraft(draftFrom()); setFormError(null); setEditing(k); }
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const today = localToday();
  const limits = dateLimits(today);

  async function save() {
    const d = draft;
    if (!/^\d{5}$/.test(d.zip) || !stateForZip(d.zip)) return setFormError('Enter a valid 5-digit US ZIP code.');
    if (!d.date) return setFormError(d.stage === 'expecting' ? 'Enter your due date. Your doctor’s estimate is fine.' : 'Enter your baby’s birth date.');
    const rangeError = dateRangeError(d.stage === 'expecting' ? 'due' : 'birth', d.date, today);
    if (rangeError) return setFormError(rangeError);
    const answered = d.household && d.work1 && (d.household === 'one' || d.work2);
    const body = {
      ...(guest ? { familyId: run.familyId } : {}),
      zip: d.zip, ...(d.stage === 'expecting' ? { dueDate: d.date } : { birthDate: d.date }),
      ...(answered ? { household: d.household, parent1Work: d.work1, ...(d.household === 'two' ? { parent2Work: d.work2 } : {}) } : {}),
      ...(d.insurance ? { insurance: d.insurance } : {}),
    } as RunRequest;
    setSaving(true);
    setFormError(null);
    try {
      const { runId, familyId } = await api.startRun(body);
      if (familyId) rememberFamilyId(familyId);
      props.onRerun(runId);
    } catch (e) {
      setFormError((e as Error).message || 'Could not save that. Please try again.');
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  // ----- switch family (shared with the header's family chip menu) -----
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false);
  const { current, switching, switchError, hasSaved, pick: pickFamily } = useFamilySwitch(run.familyId, props.onSwitch);
  const pick = (t: SwitchTarget) => { setMenu(false); void pickFamily(t); };

  // ----- what Bundle remembers -----
  const [memory, setMemory] = useState<FamilyMemory | null>(null);
  const [memoryError, setMemoryError] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    setMemory(null);
    setMemoryError(false);
    Promise.resolve().then(() => api.memory(run.familyId)).then((m) => { if (live) setMemory(m); }).catch(() => { if (live) setMemoryError(true); });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [run.familyId]);
  // Lessons written automatically while grading an offer (no parent reports) are for the reviewer only.
  const learned = (memory?.learned ?? []).filter((m) => owner || m.reports !== null);
  const [techFamily, setTechFamily] = useState(false);
  const [techLearned, setTechLearned] = useState(false);

  // ----- forget everything -----
  const [forgetting, setForgetting] = useState(false);
  const [forgetBusy, setForgetBusy] = useState(false);
  const [forgetError, setForgetError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const cancelRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => { if (forgetting) cancelRef.current?.focus(); }, [forgetting]);
  async function forgetAll() {
    setForgetBusy(true);
    setForgetError(null);
    try {
      await api.forgetFamily(run.familyId);
      clearBrowserData();
      props.onForgot();
    } catch (e) {
      setForgetError((e as Error).message || 'Could not forget everything. Please try again.');
      setForgetBusy(false);
    }
  }

  // ----- the plan's optional name (it saves itself; a name is just a label on this device) -----
  const [planName, setPlanName] = useState(() => loadPlan(run.familyId).name);
  useEffect(() => { setPlanName(loadPlan(run.familyId).name); }, [run.familyId]);
  const [naming, setNaming] = useState(false);
  const [nameDraft, setNameDraft] = useState('');
  function saveName() {
    const n = nameDraft.trim().slice(0, 40) || null;
    savePlan(run.familyId, { name: n, hidden: false });
    setPlanName(n);
    setNaming(false);
  }
  const name = isSampleId(run.familyId) ? (family?.name ?? 'Sample').replace(/\s*\(.*\)\s*$/, '').trim() : planName ?? 'My saved profile';
  const choices = insuranceChoices(stateForZip(draft.zip)?.code ?? family?.state);
  const workRows = draft.household === 'two' ? [['You', 'work1'], ['Your partner', 'work2']] as const : draft.household === 'one' ? [['You', 'work1']] as const : [];

  const editor = (k: EditKey) => (
    <div className="mt-3 rounded-2xl bg-cream p-3" data-testid={`editor-${k}`}>
      {!guest && <p className="mb-2 text-[13px] leading-snug text-ink-2">This is a sample family, so saving makes a copy as your own saved profile. The sample stays as it is.</p>}
      {k === 'stage' && (
        <div role="group" aria-label="Stage" className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <button type="button" aria-pressed={draft.stage === 'expecting'} onClick={() => setDraft({ ...draft, stage: 'expecting', date: draft.stage === 'expecting' ? draft.date : '' })} className={pill(draft.stage === 'expecting')}>We’re expecting</button>
          <button type="button" aria-pressed={draft.stage === 'born'} onClick={() => setDraft({ ...draft, stage: 'born', date: draft.stage === 'born' ? draft.date : '' })} className={pill(draft.stage === 'born')}>Baby’s here</button>
        </div>
      )}
      {(k === 'stage' || k === 'date') && (
        <label className="mt-2 block">
          <span className="eyebrow text-ink-2">{draft.stage === 'expecting' ? 'Due date' : 'Birth date'}</span>
          <input
            type="date" className={fieldInput} value={draft.date}
            min={draft.stage === 'expecting' ? limits.dueMin : limits.birthMin} max={draft.stage === 'expecting' ? limits.dueMax : today}
            onChange={(e) => { setDraft({ ...draft, date: e.target.value }); setFormError(null); }}
          />
        </label>
      )}
      {k === 'zip' && (
        <label className="block">
          <span className="eyebrow text-ink-2">ZIP code</span>
          <input
            type="text" inputMode="numeric" autoComplete="postal-code" maxLength={5} className={fieldInput} value={draft.zip}
            onChange={(e) => { setDraft({ ...draft, zip: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 5) }); setFormError(null); }}
          />
        </label>
      )}
      {k === 'work' && (
        <div>
          <div role="group" aria-label="Household" className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {(['one', 'two'] as Household[]).map((h) => (
              <button key={h} type="button" aria-pressed={draft.household === h} onClick={() => setDraft({ ...draft, household: h, work2: h === 'one' ? null : draft.work2 })} className={pill(draft.household === h)}>{HOUSEHOLD_LABEL[h]}</button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {workRows.map(([label, field]) => (
            <div key={field} role="group" aria-label={label} className="mt-3 space-y-2">
              {draft.household === 'two' && <p aria-hidden="true" className="eyebrow text-ink-2">{label}</p>}
              {WORK_ORDER.map((w) => (
                <button key={w} type="button" aria-pressed={draft[field] === w} onClick={() => setDraft({ ...draft, [field]: w })} className={cn(pill(draft[field] === w), 'block w-full')}>{WORK_LABEL[w]}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
          ))}
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setDraft({ ...draft, household: null, work1: null, work2: null })} className="mt-2 min-h-[44px] text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-2 underline decoration-line decoration-2 underline-offset-4">Skip this question</button>
        </div>
      )}
      {k === 'insurance' && (
        <div role="group" aria-label="Health insurance" className="space-y-2">
          {choices.map((c) => (
            <button key={c.id} type="button" aria-pressed={draft.insurance === c.id} onClick={() => setDraft({ ...draft, insurance: c.id })} className={cn(pill(draft.insurance === c.id), 'block w-full')}>{c.label}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {formError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-[#FBE3E0] px-3 py-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-[#9E2A21]">{formError}</p>}
      <button type="button" onClick={save} disabled={saving} className="mt-3 flex min-h-[52px] w-full items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-ink px-3 text-[16px] font-bold text-cream disabled:opacity-60">{saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save'}</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => { setEditing(null); setFormError(null); }} disabled={saving} className="mx-auto mt-1 flex min-h-[44px] items-center px-3 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-2 underline decoration-line decoration-2 underline-offset-4">Cancel</button>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[12.5px] text-ink-2">We’ll update your results with this answer.</p>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={props.onBack} className="-ml-1 mt-3 flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-1 px-1 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink"><span aria-hidden="true">‹</span> Back</button>
      <h1 className="mt-2 text-[30px] font-extrabold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-0.03em]">Account</h1>

      <section aria-label="Family" data-testid="family-switcher" className="bundle-card mt-3 p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">Family</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-[18px] font-extrabold leading-tight">
              <span className="truncate" data-testid="family-name">{name}</span>
              {!guest && <span className="rounded-full bg-[#FBEFC9] px-2 py-0.5 text-[11.5px] font-bold text-[#7A5A00]">Sample</span>}
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={menu} onClick={() => setMenu((m) => !m)}
            className="flex min-h-[44px] shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-line bg-paper px-3 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink"
          >Switch family / demo family <Chevron up={menu} /></button>
        </div>
        {menu && (
          <div role="menu" aria-label="Families" className="mt-3 space-y-2">
            <FamilyChoices current={current} hasSaved={hasSaved} disabled={switching !== null} onPick={pick} />
          </div>
        )}
        {switching && <p role="status" className="mt-3 text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-2">Opening {openingLabel(switching)}…</p>}
        {switchError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-[#FBE3E0] px-3 py-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-[#9E2A21]">{switchError}</p>}
        {guest && !naming && (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => { setNameDraft(planName ?? ''); setNaming(true); }} className="mt-2 min-h-[44px] text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-2 underline decoration-line decoration-2 underline-offset-4">{planName ? 'Change name' : 'Name this plan'}</button>
        )}
        {guest && naming && (
          <form className="mt-2" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); saveName(); }}>
            <label htmlFor={`plan-name-${run.familyId}`} className="block text-[14px] font-bold">Plan name <span className="font-semibold text-ink-2">(optional)</span></label>
            <input
              id={`plan-name-${run.familyId}`} type="text" maxLength={40} autoComplete="off" placeholder="e.g. Our baby plan"
              value={nameDraft} onChange={(e) => setNameDraft(e.target.value)} className={fieldInput}
            />
            <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setNaming(false)} className="min-h-[48px] rounded-xl border-2 border-line bg-paper px-3 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink">Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="min-h-[48px] rounded-xl bg-ink px-3 text-[15px] font-bold text-cream">Save name</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
        <p className="mt-3 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-ink-2" data-testid="trust-line">Saved on this device. No account needed.</p>
      </section>

      <section aria-label="Plan progress" data-testid="plan-ring" className="bundle-card mt-3 flex items-center gap-4 p-4">
        <div className="relative h-[64px] w-[64px] shrink-0" role="img" aria-label={`${pct} percent complete`}>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="64" height="64" aria-hidden="true">
            <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="26" fill="none" stroke="var(--line)" strokeWidth="8" />
            <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="26" fill="none" stroke="var(--coral)" strokeWidth="8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray={`${(pct / 100) * 163.4} 163.4`} transform="rotate(-90 32 32)" />
          </svg>
          <span aria-hidden="true" className="tabular absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-[14px] font-extrabold">{pct}%</span>
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-[18px] font-extrabold leading-snug">Your numbers are {pct}% complete.</p>
          {left.length > 0 ? (
            <>
              <p className="text-[14px] leading-snug text-ink-2">Answer {left.length} more {left.length === 1 ? 'question' : 'questions'} to firm them up.</p>
              <button type="button" onClick={left[0].open} className="mt-1 min-h-[44px] text-[15px] font-bold text-coral-deep">Answer the next one →</button>
            </>
          ) : <p className="text-[14px] leading-snug text-ink-2">Every answer is in.</p>}
        </div>
      </section>

      <p className="eyebrow mt-6 text-coral-deep">Your family profile</p>
      <section aria-label="Your family profile" data-testid="profile" className="bundle-card mt-2 px-4">
        <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <li key={r.key} className="py-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-2">{r.label}</p>
                  <p className={cn('text-[16px] font-extrabold leading-snug', !r.answered && 'text-ink-2')}>{r.value}</p>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button" aria-label={`Edit ${r.label}`} aria-expanded={editing === r.key}
                  onClick={() => (editing === r.key ? setEditing(null) : beginEdit(r.key))}
                  className="min-h-[44px] shrink-0 rounded-xl border-2 border-line bg-paper px-4 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink"
                >{editing === r.key ? 'Close' : 'Edit'}</button>
              </div>
              {editing === r.key && editor(r.key)}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </section>

      <GearLockerCard familyId={run.familyId} list />
      <NurseryGearGallery familyId={run.familyId} />

      <p className="eyebrow mt-6 text-coral-deep">AI Memory Ledger (Meterless H-MEM)</p>
      <section aria-label="What we know about your family" data-testid="memory-family" className="bundle-card mt-2 px-4 py-2">
        {memory === null && !memoryError && <p role="status" className="py-3 text-[15px] text-ink-2">Looking at what we know…</p>}
        {memoryError && <p role="alert" className="py-3 text-[15px] text-ink-2">Could not read this right now. Please try again in a minute.</p>}
        {memory && memory.family.length === 0 && <p className="py-3 text-[15px] leading-snug text-ink-2">Nothing yet. Your answers and gear show up here so we can keep checking them for you.</p>}
        {memory && memory.family.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
            {memory.family.map((m, i) => (
              <li key={`${m.id}-${i}`} className="py-3">
                <p className="text-[15.5px] leading-snug">{m.text}</p>
                <p className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 text-[12px] font-bold">
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-[#EEE9FF] px-2.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[#5541A1]">[{m.id || 'memory'}]</span>
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-[#E3F3EA] px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[#17643F]">{SOURCE_LABEL[m.source] ?? 'Saved for you'}{memoryDate(m.savedOn) ? ` · ${memoryDate(m.savedOn)}` : ''}</span>
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-[#F1ECE4] px-2.5 py-0.5 text-ink-2">Meterless H-MEM</span>
                </p>
                {techFamily && <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[12px] text-ink-2">{m.id} · source: {m.source}</p>}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {owner && (
          <button type="button" aria-expanded={techFamily} onClick={() => setTechFamily((t) => !t)} className="flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-1 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-ink-2">
            Technical details <Chevron up={techFamily} />
          </button>
        )}
      </section>

      <p className="eyebrow mt-6 text-coral-deep">Tips from other parents</p>
      <section aria-label="Lessons from parents" data-testid="memory-learned" className="bundle-card mt-2 px-4 py-2">
        {memory && learned.length === 0 && <p className="py-3 text-[15px] leading-snug text-ink-2">Nothing yet. When parents flag a bad offer, we warn everyone else.</p>}
        {memory && learned.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
            {learned.map((m, i) => (
              <li key={`${m.id}-${i}`} className="py-3">
                <p className="text-[15.5px] leading-snug">{plainLesson(m.text)}</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-ink-2">{m.reports === null ? 'Automatic grading note (reviewer only)' : `From ${m.reports} parent ${m.reports === 1 ? 'report' : 'reports'}`}</p>
                {techLearned && <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[12px] text-ink-2">{m.id}</p>}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        <p className="border-t border-line py-3 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">When you report an offer, it helps protect every family checking it.</p>
        {owner && (
          <button type="button" aria-expanded={techLearned} onClick={() => setTechLearned((t) => !t)} className="flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-1 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-ink-2">
            Technical details <Chevron up={techLearned} />
          </button>
        )}
      </section>

      <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => { markStartOver(); props.onStartOver(); }} className="min-h-[52px] rounded-2xl border-2 border-line bg-paper px-3 text-[16px] font-bold text-ink">Start over</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => { setForgetError(null); setForgetting(true); }} className="min-h-[52px] rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#E8B4AE] bg-paper px-3 text-[16px] font-bold text-[#B3261E]">Forget everything</button>
      </div>

      {forgetting && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-[rgba(27,23,20,.55)] px-4" data-testid="forget-modal">
          <div role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="forget-title" aria-describedby="forget-body" className="w-full max-w-[420px] rounded-3xl bg-paper p-5 shadow-xl">
            <h2 id="forget-title" className="text-[20px] font-extrabold">Forget everything?</h2>
            <p id="forget-body" className="mt-2 text-[15px] leading-snug text-ink-2">This deletes your saved answers, gear and receipt photos, and everything we know about your family, and clears your plan from this device. It can’t be undone.</p>
            {forgetError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-[#FBE3E0] px-3 py-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-[#9E2A21]">{forgetError}</p>}
            <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
              <button ref={cancelRef} type="button" onClick={() => setForgetting(false)} disabled={forgetBusy} className="min-h-[52px] rounded-2xl border-2 border-line bg-paper px-3 text-[16px] font-bold text-ink">Keep my data</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={forgetAll} disabled={forgetBusy} className="min-h-[52px] rounded-2xl bg-[#C9352B] px-3 text-[16px] font-bold text-white disabled:opacity-60">{forgetBusy ? 'Deleting…' : 'Forget'}</button>

          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );

import type { FeedCard } from '@shared/bundle';
import { MA_LEAVE, OTHER_LEAVE_SUB, bucketOf, categoryOf, type HomeBucket } from '@shared/cardMeta';
import { fmtUsdShort } from '@/lib/bundle';
import { taxYearFor } from '@/lib/insurance';
import { claimableCards } from '@/lib/tabs';
import type { TabProps } from './shared';
import { useScan } from '@/components/scan/ScanContext';

/** "(after birth)" is added to cards while a family is expecting; the bucket already says when, so drop it here. */
const plainTitle = (t: string) => t.replace(/\s*\(after birth\)$/, '');

/** The short names the buckets use. Anything else keeps the card's own title. */
function shortTitle(c: FeedCard): string {
  if (c.id === 'benefit-trump_account') return 'Trump Account';
  if (c.id === 'benefit-federal_child_tax_credit') return 'Child Tax Credit';
  if (c.id === 'benefit-ma_child_tax_credit') return 'MA child credit';
  return plainTitle(c.title);
}

/** Plain notes under a line. The Child Tax Credit's two numbers answer different questions (IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32: $2,200 maximum, $1,700 refundable for 2026). */
const NOTE: Record<string, string> = {
  'benefit-federal_child_tax_credit': 'Lowers your taxes by up to $2,200; up to $1,700 of that can come back as a refund even if you owe nothing.',
};

function Row({ card }: { card: FeedCard }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 border-t border-line py-2.5 first:border-t-0">
      <span className="min-w-0 text-[16px] leading-snug">
        <span>{shortTitle(card)}</span>
        {NOTE[card.id] && <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[13px] leading-snug text-ink-2">{NOTE[card.id]}</span>}
      </span>
      <b className="tabular shrink-0 text-[16px]">{fmtUsdShort(card.amountCents ?? 0)}</b>
    </div>
  );
}

function Total({ cents }: { cents: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-line pt-2.5">
      <span className="text-[16px] font-extrabold">Total</span>
      <b className="tabular text-[16px]">{fmtUsdShort(cents)}</b>
    </div>
  );
}

const box = (accent: string) => `bundle-card relative mt-3 overflow-hidden p-4 pl-5 before:absolute before:inset-y-0 before:left-0 before:w-1 ${accent}`;

/**
 * Home's buckets: when the money arrives. Money back now (weeks), At tax time (spring after the baby's year), the baby's savings account
 * (the Trump Account deposit, once the baby has a Social Security number), Paid family leave (weekly).
 * Every amount is a card of the run; a card marked "Not relevant" is not in any bucket. Free gifts stay separate.
 */
export default function Buckets(props: TabProps) {
  const { run, stage } = props;
  const { openScan } = useScan();
  const live = props.cards.filter((c) => !props.dismissed[c.id]);
  const inBucket = (cat: HomeBucket) => live.filter((c) => bucketOf(c) === cat && (cat === 'leave' || (c.amountCents ?? 0) > 0));
  const moneyBack = inBucket('money_back');
  const taxTime = inBucket('tax_time');
  const leave = inBucket('leave')[0];
  const babySavings = inBucket('baby_savings');
  const year = taxYearFor(run.family, run.today ?? '');
  const gifts = live.filter((c) => categoryOf(c) === 'gift' && claimableCards(props.cards).some((g) => g.id === c.id));
  const sum = (cs: FeedCard[]) => cs.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
  const isMaLeave = leave && /^benefit-ma_pfml$/.test(leave.id);

  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="eyebrow mt-7 text-coral-deep">Your money, by when it arrives</h2>

      <section aria-label="Money back now" data-testid="bucket-money-back" className={box('before:bg-coral')}>
        <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">Money back now</p>
        <h3 className="mt-1 text-[19px] font-extrabold leading-snug tracking-[-0.01em]">Within weeks of filing a claim</h3>
        {moneyBack.length === 0 ? (
          <button type="button" onClick={openScan} aria-haspopup="dialog" className="mt-3 flex min-h-[48px] w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-ink-3 px-3 text-left text-[15px] font-bold text-ink">
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-[20px] leading-none">+</span> Add a receipt to find money back
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="mt-2">
            {moneyBack.map((c) => <Row key={c.id} card={c} />)}
            {moneyBack.length > 1 && <Total cents={sum(moneyBack)} />}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      {taxTime.length > 0 && (
        <section aria-label="At tax time" data-testid="bucket-tax-time" className={box('before:bg-ink')}>
          <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">At tax time</p>
          <h3 className="mt-1 text-[19px] font-extrabold leading-snug tracking-[-0.01em]">
            {stage === 'expecting' ? `When you file your ${year} taxes (spring ${year + 1}), once baby arrives` : `When you file your ${year} taxes (spring ${year + 1})`}
          </h3>
          <div className="mt-2">
            {taxTime.map((c) => <Row key={c.id} card={c} />)}
            {taxTime.length > 1 && <Total cents={sum(taxTime)} />}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {babySavings.length > 0 && (
        <section aria-label="Your baby's savings account" data-testid="bucket-baby-savings" className={box('before:bg-[#1E8A5A]')}>
          <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">Your baby’s savings account</p>
          <h3 className="mt-1 text-[19px] font-extrabold leading-snug tracking-[-0.01em]">
            {stage === 'expecting' ? 'Deposited after your baby is born and has a Social Security number' : 'Deposited once your baby has a Social Security number'}
          </h3>
          <div className="mt-2">
            {babySavings.map((c) => <Row key={c.id} card={c} />)}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[14px] text-ink-2">Money from the government into an account in your baby’s name, not paid to you.</p>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => props.go('savings')} className="mt-1 flex min-h-[44px] items-center text-[15px] font-bold text-coral-deep">See the steps in Savings →</button>
        </section>
      )}

      {leave && (
        <section aria-label="Paid family leave" data-testid="bucket-leave" className={box('before:bg-kind-clawback')}>
          <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">Paid family leave</p>
          <h3 className="mt-1 text-[19px] font-extrabold leading-snug tracking-[-0.01em]">{isMaLeave ? MA_LEAVE.headline : plainTitle(leave.title)}</h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">{isMaLeave ? MA_LEAVE.sub : OTHER_LEAVE_SUB}</p>
        </section>
      )}

      {gifts.length > 0 && stage !== 'expecting' && (
        <section aria-label="Free gifts" data-testid="bucket-gifts" className={box('before:bg-[#B7791F]')}>
          <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">Free gifts</p>
          <h3 className="mt-1 text-[19px] font-extrabold leading-snug tracking-[-0.01em]">Registry and welcome boxes</h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[14px] text-ink-2">Shipped to you. Fine print checked.</p>

      )}

import { useEffect, useId, useState } from 'react';

  reject: 'bg-[#FBE3E0] text-[#9E2A21]',
};

/** The status line under the header. It says what is really happening, and never shows a spinner that could get stuck. */
function StatusLine({ live, saved, scanning }: { live: LiveOffers; saved: string; scanning: boolean }) {
  const searching = live.phase === 'searching';
  const real = live.phase === 'found' ? foundLine(live.sitesSearched, live.cards.length) : live.phase === 'quiet' ? NO_NEW_OFFERS_LINE : live.phase === 'practice' ? saved : SEARCHING_LINE;
  const text = scanning ? SCANNING_LINE : real;
  const dot = scanning || searching ? 'bg-coral animate-pulse' : live.phase === 'quiet' ? 'bg-ink-3' : 'bg-[#1E8E5A]';
  return (
    <div role="status" aria-live="polite" data-testid="deals-status" className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper px-4 py-3">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className={`mt-[7px] inline-block h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${dot}`} />
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="text-[14.5px] font-semibold leading-snug text-ink">{text}</p>
        {scanning && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] leading-snug text-ink-2">{real}</p>}
        {!scanning && searching && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] leading-snug text-ink-2">{saved}</p>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type QuickPhase =
  | { kind: 'idle' }
  | { kind: 'sending' }
  | { kind: 'done'; reply: AuditReply; store: string; offer: string }
  | { kind: 'problem'; message: string };

/** Paste-only auditor at the top of Deals. Store and “what you get” are guessed from the pasted text. */
function QuickAuditCard({ onSaved }: { onSaved?: () => void }) {
  const id = useId();
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<QuickPhase>({ kind: 'idle' });
  const ready = text.trim().length > 0 && phase.kind !== 'sending';

  const submit = async () => {
    const pasted = text.trim();
    if (!pasted) return;
    setPhase({ kind: 'sending' });
    const guessed = guessAuditFields(pasted);
    try {
      const reply = await sendAudit({ store: guessed.store, offer: guessed.offer, text: pasted });
      setPhase({ kind: 'done', reply, store: guessed.store, offer: guessed.offer });
      if (reply.saved && !reply.repeat) onSaved?.();
    } catch (e) {
      setPhase({ kind: 'problem', message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'We could not check that deal just now. Please try again.' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper p-4" data-testid="quick-audit" aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`}>
      <h2 id={`${id}-title`} className="text-[18px] font-extrabold leading-snug text-ink">Check Any Offer or Registry Deal</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[14.5px] leading-snug text-ink-2">Paste the fine print or offer text from Babylist, Target, or Amazon to test for hidden subscription traps.</p>
      <form className="mt-3" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (ready) void submit(); }}>
        <label htmlFor={`${id}-text`} className="sr-only">Offer or fine print to check</label>
        <textarea
          id={`${id}-text`}
          rows={5}
          maxLength={8000}
          value={text}
          onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Paste the offer or the fine print here."
          className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-line bg-cream px-4 py-3 text-[16px] leading-snug text-ink placeholder:text-ink-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ink/30"
        />
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={!ready}
          className="mt-3 inline-flex min-h-[52px] w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-ink px-4 text-[16px] font-extrabold text-cream disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          {phase.kind === 'sending' ? 'Reading the fine print…' : 'Audit Deal'}
        </button>
      </form>
      {phase.kind === 'problem' && (
        <p className="mt-3 rounded-2xl border border-[#F2B9B3] bg-[#FDF1EF] px-4 py-3 text-[15px] font-semibold text-[#9E2A21]">{phase.message}</p>
      )}
      {phase.kind === 'done' && (
        <div role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Verdict" className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-cream p-4" data-testid="quick-audit-verdict">
          <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">Verdict</p>
          <p className="mt-2">
            <span className={cn('inline-flex rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-[15px] font-extrabold', verdictPill[phase.reply.verdict])}>
              {liveVerdictLabel[phase.reply.verdict]}
            </span>
            {phase.reply.verdict === 'approve_with_catch' && <span className="ml-2 text-[14px] font-bold text-[#7A5410]">with a catch</span>}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-3 text-[17px] font-extrabold leading-snug text-ink">{phase.store}’s “{phase.offer}”</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">{phase.reply.summary}</p>
          {phase.reply.valueScore && (
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-paper p-3" data-testid="quick-audit-value-score">
              <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">Value Score</p>
              <ul className="mt-1 space-y-0.5 text-[14.5px] font-semibold leading-snug text-ink">
                {valueScoreLines(phase.reply.valueScore).map((l) => <li key={l}>{l}</li>)}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
          {phase.reply.hunter && (
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-paper p-3">
              <p className="eyebrow text-[#17643F]">Deal Hunter</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[14.5px] leading-snug text-ink">{phase.reply.hunter}</p>
            </div>
          )}
          {phase.reply.lawyer && (
            <div className="mt-2 rounded-xl bg-paper p-3">
              <p className="eyebrow text-coral-deep">Fine-Print Lawyer</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[14.5px] leading-snug text-ink">{phase.reply.lawyer}</p>
            </div>
          )}
          {phase.reply.saved && (
            <p className="mt-3 text-[14.5px] font-semibold leading-snug text-[#17643F]">✓ Added to the shared list</p>
          )}
          {phase.reply.mode === 'quick' && !phase.reply.injection && (
            <p className="mt-3 text-[13.5px] leading-snug text-ink-2">Quick check. The full AI review runs in live mode.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/** Deals: offers whose fine print checks out (with what it found), new finds from the live search, offers not yet checked, and the ones we blocked. */
export default function DealsTab(props: TabProps) {
  const [auditing, setAuditing] = useState(false);
  const [report, setReport] = useState<ReportCardReply | null>(null);
  const [reportVersion, setReportVersion] = useState(0);
  const [scanning, setScanning] = useState(true);
  const live = useLiveOffers();

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setScanning(false), SCAN_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let off = false;
    void fetchReportCard().then((r) => { if (!off) setReport(r); });
    return () => { off = true; };
  }, [reportVersion]);

  const deals = props.cards.filter((c) => c.kind === 'discount');
  const checked = orderDeals(deals.filter((c) => c.verdict !== 'info' && c.verdict !== 'blocked'));
  const unchecked = deals.filter((c) => c.verdict === 'info');
  const blocked = props.run.result.blocked ?? [];
  const { cents } = categorySummary(props.cards.filter((c) => !props.dismissed[c.id]), 'deals');
  const fresh = live.phase === 'found' ? orderDeals(onlyNew(live.cards, deals)) : [];

  if (auditing) {
    return <AuditDeal onBack={() => setAuditing(false)} onSaved={() => setReportVersion((v) => v + 1)} />;
  }
  return (
    <>
      <CategoryHeader
        eyebrow="Discounts & offers" dot="#C9352B"
        title={cents > 0 ? `${fmtUsdShort(cents)} in free gifts` : 'Deals checked for you'}
        sub="Every offer read for fine print. Anything with a catch gets blocked."
      />
      <QuickAuditCard onSaved={() => setReportVersion((v) => v + 1)} />
      <button
        type="button" onClick={() => setAuditing(true)}
        className="mt-4 block w-full rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-coral px-4 py-3.5 text-left"
      >
        <span className="eyebrow block text-coral-deep">Audit a deal</span>
        <span className="mt-1 block text-[18px] font-extrabold leading-snug text-ink">Tell us about any offer. We’ll read the fine print. <span aria-hidden="true">›</span></span>
      </button>
      <StatusLine live={live} saved={checkingLine(props.run.result.offersOnFile, props.run.family, props.run.today)} scanning={scanning} />
      {report && <OfferReportCard report={report} />}
      {fresh.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <SectionTitle tone="urgent">New today</SectionTitle>
          <div className="mt-4 space-y-3 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-500" data-testid="new-offers">
            {fresh.map((c) => <FeedCardView key={c.id} card={c} today={props.run.today} />)}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {checked.length > 0 && (
        <>
          {fresh.length > 0 && <SectionTitle>Your checked offers</SectionTitle>}
          <CardStack cards={checked} props={props} />
        </>
      )}
      {unchecked.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <SectionTitle>{UNCHECKED_DEALS_SECTION}</SectionTitle>
          <CardStack cards={unchecked} props={props} />
        </>
      )}
      <ClaimDrawers cards={deals} props={props} />
      {blocked.length > 0 && (
        <section className="mt-7" aria-label="We caught these for you" data-testid="blocked-section">
          <h2 className="eyebrow text-[#9E2A21]">We caught these for you</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[14px] text-ink-2">Blocked by Bundle. They are not counted in your totals.</p>
          <ul className="mt-2 space-y-3">
            {blocked.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.id} className="rounded-2xl border border-[#F2B9B3] bg-[#FDF1EF] p-4">
                <p className="text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[.12em] text-[#9E2A21]">Blocked by Bundle</p>
                <h3 className="mt-1 text-[17px] font-extrabold leading-snug text-ink">{c.title}</h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2"><span aria-hidden="true">🛡️ </span><strong className="font-bold text-[#9E2A21]">Fine print: Blocked:</strong> {blockedReason(c)}</p>

                <MemorySection card={c} lines={props.lines} />
              </li>

          </ul>

      {deals.length === 0 && blocked.length === 0 && (

import { useState } from 'react';
import { fmtUsd, safeSources } from '@/lib/bundle';
import type { HomeTotals } from '@/lib/tabs';
import { shareMessage } from '@/lib/tabs';
import { Link } from 'wouter';
import { forgetMyItems } from '@/lib/photoPrep';

/** Small "Share this with a friend" bar. It appears after the first money tick and shares only a link to Bundle. */
export function ShareBar({ claimedCents }: { claimedCents: number }) {
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);
  async function share() {
    // Only the site's own address: no run id, no names, dates, ZIP or amounts.
    const link = window.location.origin;
    const text = shareMessage(link);
    try {
      if (typeof navigator.share === 'function') { await navigator.share({ title: 'Bundle', text, url: link }); return; }
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setNote('Copied. Paste it into a message.');
    } catch (e) {
      if ((e as Error)?.name !== 'AbortError') setNote('Could not share from here. Copy this link instead: ' + link);
    }
  }
  return (
    <section aria-label="Share" data-testid="share-bar" className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper p-4">
      <p className="text-[15px] font-bold leading-snug">Nice, {fmtUsd(claimedCents)} claimed! Know someone who would want this?</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">We only share a link, never your list or details.</p>
      <button type="button" onClick={share} className="mt-3 flex min-h-[48px] w-full items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-ink px-4 text-[15px] font-bold text-cream">Share this with a friend</button>
      {note && <p role="status" className="mt-2 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-ink-2">{note}</p>}
    </section>
  );
}

/** The plan saves itself (results on the server, the family id in this browser), so Home just says so. Naming it lives on the Account page. */
export function PlanSavedLine() {
  return <p data-testid="plan-saved" className="mt-3 text-[14.5px] font-semibold text-[#17643F]">✓ Your plan is saved.</p>;
}

/** "Forget my items": deletes the products saved from photos for this family, after a plain-English confirm step. */
export function ForgetItemsCard({ familyId, forget = forgetMyItems }: { familyId: string; forget?: (familyId: string) => Promise<number> }) {
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ ok: true; message: string } | { ok: false; message: string } | null>(null);
  async function run() {
    setBusy(true);
    setResult(null);
    try {
      const n = await forget(familyId);
      setResult({ ok: true, message: n === 0 ? 'We did not have any saved items for you, so there was nothing to remove.' : `Done. We removed ${n === 1 ? '1 item' : `${n} items`} and your saved photos from our records.` });
    } catch (e) {
      setResult({ ok: false, message: (e as Error)?.message || 'Could not remove your items. Please try again.' });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      setConfirming(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <section aria-label="Forget my items" data-testid="forget-card" className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper p-4">
      <h3 className="text-[17px] font-extrabold leading-snug">Your items, your choice</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">Photos are saved with your family’s profile only. We strip location data. Delete anytime.</p>
      {!confirming && (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => { setResult(null); setConfirming(true); }} className="mt-3 flex min-h-[48px] w-full items-center justify-center rounded-xl border-2 border-ink px-4 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink">Forget my items</button>
      )}
      {confirming && (
        <div role="alertdialog" aria-label="Delete your saved items?" className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-cream p-3">
          <p className="text-[15px] font-semibold leading-snug">Delete every item and photo we saved? We will stop checking them for recalls and money back. This cannot be undone.</p>
          <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirming(false)} disabled={busy} className="min-h-[48px] rounded-xl border-2 border-line bg-paper px-3 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink">Keep my items</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={run} disabled={busy} className="min-h-[48px] rounded-xl bg-ink px-3 text-[15px] font-bold text-cream disabled:opacity-60">{busy ? 'Deleting…' : 'Yes, delete them'}</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {result?.ok === true && <p role="status" className="mt-2 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-ink-2">{result.message}</p>}
      {result?.ok === false && <p role="alert" className="mt-2 rounded-xl bg-[#FBE3E0] px-3 py-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-[#9E2A21]">{result.message}</p>}
    </section>
  );
}

/** "How we got this number": the cards that add up to the big number, and what is left out of it. Every line comes from the run. */
export function HowWeGotThisNumber({ totals, href }: { totals: HomeTotals; href: (id: string) => string }) {
  const hasTaxCredit = totals.parts.some((c) => /tax_credit/.test(c.id));
  const hasAccount = totals.parts.some((c) => /trump_account/.test(c.id));
  return (
    <details className="mt-3 text-[14px]" data-testid="how-number">
      <summary className="inline-flex min-h-[44px] cursor-pointer items-center font-bold text-coral-deep underline decoration-2 underline-offset-4">How we got this number</summary>
      <div className="mt-1 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-cream p-3">
        {totals.parts.length > 0 ? (
          <ul className="space-y-2">
            {totals.parts.map((c) => {
              const src = safeSources(c.sources)[0];
              return (
                <li key={c.id} className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="min-w-0">
                    <Link href={href(c.id)} className="font-semibold text-ink underline-offset-2 hover:underline">{c.title}</Link>
                    {src && src.label !== c.title && <> <a href={src.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-2 underline-offset-2 hover:underline">{src.label}</a></>}
                  </span>
                  <span className="tabular shrink-0 font-extrabold">{fmtUsd(c.amountCents ?? 0)}</span>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        ) : <p className="text-ink-2">Nothing checked yet.</p>}
        <div className="my-2 border-t border-dashed border-line" />
        <p className="font-semibold text-ink">Total: {fmtUsd(totals.totalCents)}</p>
        <ul className="mt-2 list-disc space-y-1 pl-5 text-ink-2">
          {hasTaxCredit && <li>Tax credits lower your tax bill. You get them when you file your taxes.</li>}
          {hasAccount && <li>The baby’s starter account is a deposit into an account for your baby, not money paid to you.</li>}
          <li>Amounts marked “likely” depend on your own situation, so confirm each one with the program.</li>
          {totals.notCounted.length > 0 && <li>Left out of the total: {totals.notCounted.map((c) => c.title).join('; ')}.</li>}
          <li>Blocked offers and free gifts are never part of this number.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </details>
  );
}
