import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { FamilyChoices, openingLabel, useFamilySwitch, type SwitchTarget } from './FamilySwitch';

interface Props {
  /** The chip's words: `full` ("Baby Maya · day 20", "Your family · day 20") from 640px up, `short` ("Maya", "Your family") on a phone. */
  label: { short: string; full: string };
  familyId: string;
  /** Opens another family's saved results. Resolves with a plain-English problem, or null once it has switched. */
  onSwitch: (target: SwitchTarget) => Promise<string | null>;
  /** Opens the Account screen (the family's answers, memory and privacy). */
  onOpenAccount: () => void;
}

/**
 * The family chip in the header, as a button. Tapping it opens a small menu: "Switch family" (the same list as on the
 * Account screen) and "Your plan and saved answers", which opens the Account screen. Closes on a tap outside, Escape, or a choice.
 */
export default function FamilyChipMenu({ label, familyId, onSwitch, onOpenAccount }: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const button = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const menu = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const { current, switching, switchError, hasSaved, pick } = useFamilySwitch(familyId, onSwitch);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    menu.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role^="menuitem"]:not([disabled])')?.focus();
    const onDown = (e: Event) => { if (wrap.current && !wrap.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false); };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') { setOpen(false); button.current?.focus(); } };
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown);
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => { document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onDown); document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDown); document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); };
  }, [open]);

  const choose = (t: SwitchTarget) => { setOpen(false); void pick(t); };

  return (
    // Not `relative`: the menu is placed against the whole header (AppShell), so it never runs off a phone screen.
    <div ref={wrap} className="min-w-0">
      <button
        ref={button} type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)} data-testid="family-chip"
        className="flex min-h-[44px] max-w-full items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full border border-line bg-paper pl-3 pr-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-2 hover:border-coral"
      >
        <span className="sr-only">Family menu: {label.full}</span>
        {/* A phone header is too narrow for the stage text next to the wordmark and Scan, so it shows only who it is. */}
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="truncate sm:hidden" data-testid="chip-short">{label.short}</span>
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="hidden truncate sm:inline" data-testid="chip-full">{label.full}</span>
        <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="12" height="12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" className={open ? 'shrink-0 rotate-180' : 'shrink-0'}><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg>
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div ref={menu} role="menu" aria-label="Family menu" className="absolute right-0 top-full z-50 mt-1 w-full max-w-[340px] space-y-2 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper p-3 shadow-lg">
          <p className="eyebrow px-1 text-ink-2">Switch family</p>
          <FamilyChoices current={current} hasSaved={hasSaved} disabled={switching !== null} onPick={choose} />
          <div className="border-t border-line pt-2">
            <button
              type="button" role="menuitem" onClick={() => { setOpen(false); onOpenAccount(); }}
              className="flex min-h-[44px] w-full items-center justify-between rounded-xl px-2 text-left text-[15px] font-bold text-coral-deep hover:bg-coral-tint"
            >Your plan and saved answers <span aria-hidden="true">›</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {switching && <p role="status" className="absolute right-0 top-full z-50 mt-1 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl bg-paper px-3 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-2 shadow">Opening {openingLabel(switching)}…</p>}
      {switchError && !open && <p role="alert" className="absolute right-0 top-full z-50 mt-1 w-full max-w-[340px] rounded-xl bg-[#FBE3E0] px-3 py-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-[#9E2A21]">{switchError}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

// "Switch family": the list of sample families plus "My saved profile", and the logic behind a pick.
// Shared by the Account screen and the family chip menu in the header, so both behave the same way.
import { useState } from 'react';
import { savedFamilyId } from '@/lib/bundle';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

/** A choice in the "Switch family" menu: one of the three sample families, or the parent's own saved profile. */
export type SwitchTarget = 'maya' | 'leo' | 'ava' | 'saved';

// Descriptions of the made-up sample families (data/sample/families.json). Fictional data only.
export const SAMPLES: { id: Exclude<SwitchTarget, 'saved'>; name: string; line: string }[] = [
  { id: 'maya', name: 'Maya', line: 'Baby born Oct 3, 2026 · ZIP 02139' },
  { id: 'leo', name: 'Leo', line: 'Expecting, due Dec 7, 2026 · ZIP 02446' },
  { id: 'ava', name: 'Ava', line: 'Baby born Aug 24, 2026 · ZIP 43215 (Ohio)' },
];

export const isSampleId = (id: string) => SAMPLES.some((s) => s.id === id);

/** The state of a "Switch family" pick: which family is on screen, which one is opening, and any problem to show. */
export function useFamilySwitch(familyId: string, onSwitch: (t: SwitchTarget) => Promise<string | null>) {
  const [switching, setSwitching] = useState<SwitchTarget | null>(null);
  const [switchError, setSwitchError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const current: SwitchTarget = isSampleId(familyId) ? (familyId as SwitchTarget) : 'saved';
  const hasSaved = !isSampleId(familyId) || !!savedFamilyId();
  async function pick(t: SwitchTarget) {
    setSwitchError(null);
    if (t === current) return;
    setSwitching(t);
    const problem = await onSwitch(t);
    // On success the screen shows the other family. On a problem, say so.
    if (problem) setSwitchError(problem);
    setSwitching(null);
  }
  return { current, switching, switchError, hasSaved, pick };
}

/** The family choices, as menu items (role="menuitemradio"). Each is at least 44px tall. */
export function FamilyChoices({ current, hasSaved, disabled, onPick }: { current: SwitchTarget; hasSaved: boolean; disabled: boolean; onPick: (t: SwitchTarget) => void }) {
  const item = (on: boolean) => cn('flex min-h-[44px] w-full items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border-2 p-3 text-left disabled:opacity-60', on ? 'border-coral bg-coral-tint' : 'border-line bg-paper');
  const dot = (on: boolean) => cn('mt-1 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 rounded-full border-2', on ? 'border-coral bg-coral' : 'border-line');
  return (
    <>
      {SAMPLES.map((s) => (
        <button key={s.id} type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked={current === s.id} disabled={disabled} onClick={() => onPick(s.id)} className={item(current === s.id)}>
          <span aria-hidden="true" className={dot(current === s.id)} />
          <span className="min-w-0">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[16px] font-extrabold">{s.name} <span className="rounded-full bg-[#FBEFC9] px-2 py-0.5 text-[11.5px] font-bold text-[#7A5A00]">Sample</span></span>
            <span className="block text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">{s.line}</span>
          </span>
        </button>
      ))}
      <button type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked={current === 'saved'} disabled={disabled} onClick={() => onPick('saved')} className={item(current === 'saved')}>
        <span aria-hidden="true" className={dot(current === 'saved')} />
        <span className="min-w-0">
          <span className="block text-[16px] font-extrabold">My saved profile</span>
          <span className="block text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">{hasSaved ? 'Your own answers, kept on this device' : 'Not set up yet: answer the 5 questions'}</span>
        </span>
      </button>
    </>
  );
}

/** "Opening Leo…" while a switch is under way. */
export const openingLabel = (t: SwitchTarget) => (t === 'saved' ? 'your saved profile' : SAMPLES.find((s) => s.id === t)?.name);

  const shownTasks = quick ? openTasks.filter(isQuickWin) : openTasks;
  const gifts = live.filter((c) => c.kind === 'discount' && c.verdict !== 'info' && c.verdict !== 'blocked' && giftValue(c) > 0);

  const giftsLine = totals.giftsCents > 0 ? `${fmtUsdShort(totals.giftsCents)} in free gifts${expecting ? ' you can get now' : ''}` : null;

import { useState } from 'react';
import { questionsToAsk } from '@shared/eligibility';
import { taxYearFor } from '@/lib/insurance';
import type { SavedRun } from '@/lib/bundle';
import { useFreezeSpot } from '@/lib/scrollSpot';
import { sendToSelf, startNote } from '@/lib/sendToSelf';

const button = 'flex min-h-[52px] flex-1 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl px-4 text-[16px] font-bold transition active:scale-[.99]';

/** "Questions to ask HR" (or "for your tax preparer"): built from the work and insurance answers, with Copy and Email to myself. Bundle sends nothing. */
export default function HrQuestions({ run, onBack }: { run: SavedRun; onBack: () => void }) {
  useFreezeSpot();
  const f = run.family;
  const list = questionsToAsk({ household: f?.household, parent1Work: f?.parent1Work, parent2Work: f?.parent2Work, insurance: f?.insurance }, taxYearFor(f, run.today ?? ''));
  const [done, setDone] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const text = list.items.map((q, i) => `${i + 1}. ${q}`).join('\n');

  async function copy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setNote(`Copied ${list.items.length} questions.`);
    } catch {
      setNote('Couldn’t copy. Press and hold the questions to copy them.');
    }
  }

  async function email() {
    // The phone's own Share sheet (or the computer's email program) does the sending, so Bundle never sees the questions go anywhere.
    setNote(startNote({ title: list.title, text }));
    const r = await sendToSelf({ title: list.title, text });
    setNote(r.message);
  }

  return (
    <section data-testid="hr-questions" aria-label={list.title}>
      <button type="button" onClick={onBack} className="-ml-1 mt-4 inline-flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-1 text-[16px] font-bold text-ink">
        <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15 6l-6 6 6 6" /></svg>
        Back
      </button>
      <h1 className="mt-1 text-[30px] font-extrabold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-0.03em]">{list.title}</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">Built from your answers. Tick them off as you ask.</p>
      <ul className="bundle-card mt-4 divide-y divide-line p-2">
        {list.items.map((q, i) => (
          <li key={q}>
            <label className="flex min-h-[48px] cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 px-2 py-3 text-[16px] leading-snug">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={!!done[i]} onChange={() => setDone((d) => ({ ...d, [i]: !d[i] }))} className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 accent-[#E4572E]" />
              <span className={done[i] ? 'text-ink-2 line-through' : ''}>{q}</span>
            </label>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <div className="mt-4 flex gap-3">
        <button type="button" onClick={copy} className={`${button} bg-ink text-cream`}>Copy</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={email} className={`${button} border border-line bg-paper text-ink`}>Email to myself</button>
      </div>
      <p role="status" className="mt-3 min-h-[24px] text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-2">{note}</p>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { FeedCard } from '@shared/bundle';
import { earners } from '@shared/eligibility';
import { fmtUsdShort } from '@/lib/bundle';
import { taxYearFor } from '@/lib/insurance';
import { sendToSelf, startNote } from '@/lib/sendToSelf';
import type { TabProps } from './shared';

export type Filing = 'joint' | 'single' | 'hoh' | 'unsure';
const CHOICES: { id: Filing; label: string }[] = [
  { id: 'joint', label: 'Married filing together' },
  { id: 'single', label: 'Single' },
  { id: 'hoh', label: 'Head of household' },
  { id: 'unsure', label: 'Not sure' },
];
const filingLabel = (f: Filing) => CHOICES.find((c) => c.id === f)!.label;

const filingKey = (familyId: string) => `bundle:filing:${familyId}`;
const skipKey = (familyId: string) => `bundle:filing-skipped:${familyId}`;
function load(familyId: string): { filing: Filing | null; skipped: boolean } {
  try {
    const f = localStorage.getItem(filingKey(familyId));
    return { filing: CHOICES.some((c) => c.id === f) ? (f as Filing) : null, skipped: localStorage.getItem(skipKey(familyId)) === '1' };
  } catch { return { filing: null, skipped: false }; }
}
function save(familyId: string, filing: Filing | null, skipped: boolean) {
  try {
    if (filing) localStorage.setItem(filingKey(familyId), filing); else localStorage.removeItem(filingKey(familyId));
    if (skipped) localStorage.setItem(skipKey(familyId), '1'); else localStorage.removeItem(skipKey(familyId));
  } catch { /* the answer lasts until the page closes */ }
}

/** The number counts up to its new value (a short count-up); with "reduce motion" on, it just shows the number. */
function useCountUp(target: number, from: number, run: boolean): number {
  const [v, setV] = useState(run ? from : target);
  useEffect(() => {
    const reduce = typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.matchMedia === 'function' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    if (!run || reduce || typeof requestAnimationFrame !== 'function') { setV(target); return; }
    let raf = 0;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const step = (now: number) => {
      const k = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / 700);
      setV(Math.round(from + (target - from) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3))));
      if (k < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [target, from, run]);
  return v;
}

const isMa = (props: TabProps) => props.run.family?.state === 'MA' || props.cards.some((c) => /^benefit-ma_/.test(c.id));

/** What the 529 line says for each filing answer. Massachusetts lets you deduct up to $1,000 (single) or $2,000 (together). */
export const five29Line = (filing: Filing | null): string =>
  filing === 'joint' ? '$2,000 (filing together)' : filing === 'single' || filing === 'hoh' ? '$1,000 (filing single)' : '$1,000 single / $2,000 together';

/** The filing-status answer for this family, kept in this browser. One place, so the booster and the 529 line always agree. */
export function useFiling(familyId: string) {
  const [state, setState] = useState(() => load(familyId));
  const set = (f: Filing | null, s: boolean) => { setState({ filing: f, skipped: s }); save(familyId, f, s); };
  return { ...state, set };
}
export type FilingState = ReturnType<typeof useFiling>;

/** The filing-status booster at the top of Taxes: the money first (as a range), one tap to make it exact. */
export function FilingBooster({ props, credits, status }: { props: TabProps; credits: FeedCard[]; status: FilingState }) {
  const { filing, skipped, set } = status;

  const federal = credits.filter((c) => /^benefit-federal_/.test(c.id)).reduce((a, c) => a + (c.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
  const all = credits.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
  const exact = filing && filing !== 'unsure';
  const [animate, setAnimate] = useState(false);
  const shown = useCountUp(exact ? all : federal, federal, !!exact && animate);
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const lines = credits.map((c) => `${c.title.replace(/\s*\(after birth\)$/, '')} ${fmtUsdShort(c.amountCents ?? 0)}`);
  const year = taxYearFor(props.run.family, props.run.today ?? '');

  // Nothing to narrow: with no range there is no reason to ask.
  if (credits.length === 0 || federal === all) return null;

  const shareText = `Our baby’s tax credits for the ${year} tax year: ${lines.join(' + ')} = ${fmtUsdShort(all)}. Worth confirming with our tax preparer.`;
  async function share() {
    setNote(startNote({ title: 'Baby tax credits', text: shareText }));
    const r = await sendToSelf({ title: 'Baby tax credits', text: shareText });
    setNote(r.message);
  }
  async function copy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareText);
      setNote('Copied. Paste it into a message or email.');
    } catch {
      setNote('Couldn’t copy. Press and hold the numbers above to copy them.');
    }
  }

  if (skipped && !filing) {
    return (
      <button type="button" data-testid="booster-taxes-chip" onClick={() => set(null, false)} className="mt-4 inline-flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-line bg-paper px-4 text-[14px] font-bold text-ink">
        <span aria-hidden="true">+</span> Make my tax number exact
      </button>
    );
  }

  if (filing) {
    return (
      <section aria-label="Your tax credits" data-testid="booster-taxes-result" className="bundle-card mt-4 border-[1.5px] border-[#F5C4B0] bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FFF4EC] to-white p-4">
        <p className="eyebrow text-coral-deep">Your tax credits</p>
        <p data-testid="booster-amount" className="tabular mt-1.5 text-[44px] font-extrabold leading-none tracking-[-0.03em]">{exact ? fmtUsdShort(shown) : `${fmtUsdShort(federal)}–${fmtUsdShort(all)}`}</p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[14.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">
          {exact
            ? <>Now exact for “{filingLabel(filing)}”: {lines.join(' + ')}. Your income can lower these, so your tax preparer has the final say.</>
            : 'No problem. We’ll keep the range; your tax preparer can confirm.'}
        </p>
        <button type="button" onClick={share} className="mt-3 flex min-h-[48px] w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper px-4 text-center text-[15px] font-bold text-ink">Send these to your partner or tax preparer</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={copy} className="mt-2 flex min-h-[44px] w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper px-4 text-center text-[15px] font-bold text-ink">Copy</button>
        <p role="status" className="min-h-[20px] text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-2">{note}</p>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => { setAnimate(false); set(null, false); }} className="min-h-[44px] text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-2 underline decoration-line decoration-2 underline-offset-4">Change my answer</button>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section aria-label="Make your tax number exact" data-testid="booster-taxes" className="bundle-card mt-4 border-[1.5px] border-[#F5C4B0] bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FFF4EC] to-white p-4">
      <p className="eyebrow text-coral-deep">Your tax credits</p>
      <p className="tabular mt-1.5 text-[36px] font-extrabold leading-none tracking-[-0.03em]">{fmtUsdShort(federal)}–{fmtUsdShort(all)}</p>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] font-extrabold">One tap makes it exact →</p>
      <p className="mt-2.5 text-[14px] text-ink-2">How will you file taxes this year?</p>
      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2" role="group" aria-label="How will you file taxes this year?">
        {CHOICES.map((c) => (
          <button key={c.id} type="button" aria-pressed="false" onClick={() => { setAnimate(true); set(c.id, false); }} className="min-h-[44px] rounded-full border border-line bg-paper px-4 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink transition active:scale-[.98]">{c.label}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-ink-2">Head of household = single parent who pays most home costs.</p>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => set(null, true)} className="mt-1 min-h-[44px] text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-2 underline decoration-line decoration-2 underline-offset-4">Not now</button>
    </section>
  );
}

/** The Massachusetts 529 deduction line (MA families only). It sits on Savings; the filing answer comes from useFiling, so it always agrees with the Taxes booster. */
export function Five29Card({ props }: { props: TabProps }) {
  const { filing } = useFiling(props.run.familyId);
  if (!isMa(props)) return null;
  return (
    <article aria-label="529 college savings (MA)" data-testid="card-529" className="bundle-card mt-3 p-4">
      <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">529 college savings (MA)</p>
      <h3 className="mt-1.5 text-[17px] font-extrabold leading-snug tracking-[-0.01em]">State tax deduction: {five29Line(filing)}</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">A 529 is a savings account for school with tax breaks. Massachusetts lets you deduct what you put in, up to this amount.</p>
      <a href="https://www.savingforcollege.com/article/tax-benefits-of-massachusetts-529-plans" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="mt-2 inline-flex min-h-[32px] items-center rounded-full border border-line bg-cream px-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-2 underline-offset-2 hover:underline">Savingforcollege.com: MA 529 tax benefits</a>
    </article>
  );
}

/** The paycheck-form (W-4) tip, at the bottom of Taxes. */
export function TaxExtras({ props }: { props: TabProps }) {
  const f = props.run.family;
  const someonePaid = (() => { const e = earners({ household: f?.household, parent1Work: f?.parent1Work, parent2Work: f?.parent2Work }); return !e || e.includes('paycheck'); })();
  if (!someonePaid) return null;
  return (
    <article aria-label="Update your paycheck tax form (W-4)" data-testid="card-w4" className="bundle-card mt-3 p-4">
      <p className="eyebrow text-ink-2">For your tax preparer</p>
      <h3 className="mt-1.5 text-[17px] font-extrabold leading-snug tracking-[-0.01em]">Update your paycheck tax form (W-4)</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">The W-4 tells your employer how much tax to take from each paycheck.</p>
      <p className="mt-2 rounded-xl bg-cream px-3 py-2 text-[14px] text-ink-2">Add your baby in Step 3 (dependents) so less tax is taken from each paycheck.</p>
    </article>
  );
}

import { bucketOf } from '@shared/cardMeta';
import { fmtUsdShort } from '@/lib/bundle';
import { categorySummary, tabForCard } from '@/lib/tabs';
import { CardStack, CategoryHeader, ClaimDrawers, ComingSoonState, type TabProps } from './shared';
import { FilingBooster, TaxExtras, useFiling } from './TaxBooster';

/** Taxes: the filing-status booster, federal and state tax credits, the Dependent Care FSA (or childcare credit) and the paycheck-form tip. (The MA 529 line is on Savings.) */
export default function TaxesTab(props: TabProps) {
  const filing = useFiling(props.run.familyId);
  const mine = props.cards.filter((c) => tabForCard(c) === 'taxes');
  const { cents } = categorySummary(props.cards.filter((c) => !props.dismissed[c.id]), 'taxes');
  // The credits a tax return carries (the Trump Account is a deposit into the baby's account, not a credit: it lives on Savings).
  const credits = props.cards.filter((c) => !props.dismissed[c.id] && bucketOf(c) === 'tax_time' && (c.amountCents ?? 0) > 0);
  return (
    <>
      <CategoryHeader
        eyebrow="Tax benefits" dot="#6B4EE6"
        title={cents > 0 ? `${fmtUsdShort(cents)} off your taxes` : 'Tax benefits'}
        sub={props.stage === 'expecting' ? 'These start once your baby is born. You claim them when you file your taxes.' : 'You claim these when you file your taxes. Each one links to its official source.'}
      />
      <FilingBooster props={props} credits={credits} status={filing} />
      <ComingSoonState note={props.stateNote} />
      <CardStack cards={mine} props={props} />
      <ClaimDrawers cards={mine} props={props} />
      <TaxExtras props={props} />
    </>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell';
import { ScanProvider, useScan } from '@/components/scan/ScanContext';
import { ScanHeaderButton } from '@/components/scan/ScanButtons';
import ScanSheet from '@/components/scan/ScanSheet';
import { GearLockerView } from '@/components/scan/GearLocker';
import { api, demoDateLabel, familyChipParts, FAMILY_ID_KEY, runFromStatus, savedFamilyId, saveRun, type SavedRun, type TraceLine } from '@/lib/bundle';
import { markStartOver } from '@/lib/account';
import { clearSpotContext, currentScroll, recordSpot, restoreSpot, setSpotContext } from '@/lib/scrollSpot';
import { applyInsuranceAnswer } from '@/lib/insurance';
import { applyDaycareAnswer } from '@/lib/daycare';
import { useClaims } from '@/hooks/useClaims';
import { badgeCount, comingSoonNote, isTabId, moneyNumbers, stageOf, type TabId } from '@/lib/tabs';
import type { FeedCard } from '@shared/bundle';
import { fmtUsdShort } from '@/lib/bundle';
import { useLocation } from 'wouter';
import HomeTab from './HomeTab';
import TaxesTab from './TaxesTab';
import SavingsTab from './SavingsTab';
import InsuranceTab from './InsuranceTab';
import DealsTab from './DealsTab';
import AccountTab, { type SwitchTarget } from './AccountTab';
import TabBar from './TabBar';
import FamilyChipMenu from './FamilyChipMenu';
import type { TabProps } from './shared';

const tabKey = (runId: string) => `bundle:tab:${runId}`;
const loadTab = (runId: string): TabId => { try { const t = sessionStorage.getItem(tabKey(runId)); return isTabId(t) ? t : 'home'; } catch { return 'home'; } };
const saveTab = (runId: string, t: TabId) => { try { sessionStorage.setItem(tabKey(runId), t); } catch { /* ignore */ } };
// Opening Account adds a step to the browser's history (same web address), marked with the tab it was opened from,
// so the phone's or browser's Back returns to that tab instead of leaving the app. The mark survives a reload.
const ACCOUNT_MARK = 'bundleAccountFrom';
const accountMark = (): TabId | null => { try { const t = (window.history.state as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.[ACCOUNT_MARK]; return isTabId(t) && t !== 'account' ? t : null; } catch { return null; } };

interface Props {
  run: SavedRun;
  /** true when the reviewer code is set in this tab. Parents never see owner-only things. */
  owner: boolean;
  /** The finished run's audit lines, for the owner only (empty for a parent). */
  lines?: TraceLine[];
  /**
   * OWNER-ONLY SLOT for W3-PANEL's "How the agents worked together" panel. Feed.tsx passes the panel here;
   * it is shown at the bottom of Home, only when `owner` is true, and never to a parent.
   */
  ownerPanel?: ReactNode;
}

/** Version B: the five-tab app a parent lands on after the Checking screen. Every number comes from `run.result`. */
export default function VersionB(props: Props) {
  return <ScanProvider><VersionBInner {...props} /></ScanProvider>;
}

function VersionBInner({ run: runProp, owner, lines = [], ownerPanel }: Props) {
  const scan = useScan();
  const [, navigate] = useLocation();
  // The run on screen. "Switch family" swaps it for another family's saved run without leaving the app.
  const [run, setRun] = useState<SavedRun>(runProp);
  useEffect(() => { setRun(runProp); }, [runProp]);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabId>(() => loadTab(run.runId));
  const { claims, dismissed, bar, claim, dismiss, undo, closeBar } = useClaims(run.familyId);
  const stage = stageOf(run.family);
  const cards = useMemo(() => applyDaycareAnswer(applyInsuranceAnswer(run.result.cards, run.family), run.family), [run.result.cards, run.family]);
  const today = run.today ?? '';

  const { closeLocker } = scan;
  const change = useCallback((t: TabId) => { closeLocker(); setTab(t); saveTab(run.runId, t); }, [run.runId, closeLocker]);

  // ----- Account and Back (phone/browser Back and the "‹ Back" button both return to the tab Account was opened from) -----
  const accountFrom = useRef<TabId>(accountMark() ?? 'home');
  const openAccount = useCallback(() => {
    if (tab === 'account') return;
    accountFrom.current = tab;
    try { window.history.pushState({ ...((window.history.state as object | null) ?? {}), [ACCOUNT_MARK]: tab }, ''); } catch { /* Back still works from the button */ }
    change('account');
  }, [tab, change]);
  const leaveAccount = useCallback(() => {
    if (accountMark()) window.history.back(); // the popstate listener below changes the tab
    else change(accountFrom.current);
  }, [change]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== 'account') return;
    const onPop = () => change(accountFrom.current); // any Back (or Forward) step while on Account leaves it
    window.addEventListener('popstate', onPop);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('popstate', onPop);
  }, [tab, change]);
  // Leaving Account by a bottom tab also takes its history step back off, so a later Back does not land on a dead step.
  const changeTab = useCallback((t: TabId) => {
    if (tab === 'account' && t !== 'account' && accountMark()) { accountFrom.current = t; window.history.back(); }
    change(t);
  }, [tab, change]);

  // Back keeps your place: the scroll spot of each tab is remembered while you scroll, and put back when you come to the tab again
  // (from a card's detail page, from another tab, or from a sub-view such as the gear locker).
  const firstTab = useRef(true);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    setSpotContext(run.runId, tab);
    if (firstTab.current) { firstTab.current = false; restoreSpot(); } else restoreSpot({ toTop: true });
  }, [run.runId, tab]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onScroll = () => recordSpot(currentScroll());
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll); clearSpotContext(); };
  }, []);

  // ----- the Account screen's actions (Switch family is also in the header's family chip menu) -----
  // `land` is where the parent ends up: the Account screen when switching from there, Home when switching from the chip.
  const switchTo = useCallback(async (t: SwitchTarget, land: TabId = 'account'): Promise<string | null> => {
    const id = t === 'saved' ? savedFamilyId() : t;
    if (!id) { markStartOver(); navigate('/'); return null; } // no saved profile yet: the five questions
    try {
      let next: SavedRun | null = null;
      try { next = runFromStatus(await api.latestRun(id)); }
      catch (e) { if ((e as { status?: number }).status !== 404) throw e; }
      if (!next) {
        // Nothing saved for this family yet (a fresh server): check them now, on the checking screen.
        const { runId } = await api.startRun({ familyId: id });
        saveTab(runId, land);
        navigate(`/feed/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`);
        return null;
      }
      saveRun(next);
      saveTab(next.runId, land);
      setRun(next);
      setTab(land);
      navigate(`/feed/${encodeURIComponent(next.runId)}`, { replace: true });
      return null;
    } catch (e) {
      const err = e as Error & { status?: number };
      if (t === 'saved' && err.status === 404) { try { localStorage.removeItem(FAMILY_ID_KEY); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
      return err.message || 'Could not open that family. Please try again.';
    }
  }, [navigate]);
  const switchFromChip = useCallback((t: SwitchTarget) => { closeLocker(); return switchTo(t, 'home'); }, [switchTo, closeLocker]);
  const startOver = useCallback(() => navigate('/'), [navigate]);
  const forgot = useCallback(() => navigate('/'), [navigate]);
  const rerun = useCallback((runId: string) => { saveTab(runId, 'account'); navigate(`/feed/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`); }, [navigate]);
  // The amount a "Not relevant" tap takes off: only what counts toward the headline (a card with no counted money takes off $0).
  const act = useMemo(() => ({
    claim,
    undo,
    dismiss: (c: FeedCard) => {
      const before = moneyNumbers(run.result, {}, {});
      const after = moneyNumbers(run.result, {}, { [c.id]: true });
      dismiss(c.id, c.title, before.found - after.found);
    },
  }), [claim, undo, dismiss, run.result]);

  const props: TabProps = useMemo(() => ({
    run, stage, cards, claims, dismissed, act, go: changeTab, lines: owner ? lines : [],
    href: (id: string) => `/card/${encodeURIComponent(id)}?run=${encodeURIComponent(run.runId)}`,
    stateNote: comingSoonNote(run),
    owner,
  }), [run, stage, cards, claims, dismissed, act, changeTab, owner, lines]);

  const demoLabel = demoDateLabel(run.demoDate, run.today);
  const Screen = { home: HomeTab, taxes: TaxesTab, savings: SavingsTab, insurance: InsuranceTab, deals: DealsTab, account: null }[tab];

  return (
    <AppShell
      chipSlot={(() => { const label = familyChipParts(run.family, run.today, run.familyId); return label ? <FamilyChipMenu label={label} familyId={run.familyId} onSwitch={switchFromChip} onOpenAccount={openAccount} /> : null; })()}
      action={<ScanHeaderButton />}
      footer={<TabBar current={tab} onChange={changeTab} badge={badgeCount(cards, today, stage, run.family)} />}
    >
      {demoLabel && <p data-testid="demo-date" className="mt-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-2">{demoLabel}. Sample families are checked as of this date so the demo stays the same.</p>}
      {run.result.banner && (
        <p role="status" className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#F5C4B0] bg-coral-tint px-4 py-3 text-[15px] font-semibold text-coral-deep">{run.result.banner}</p>
      )}
      {scan.lockerOpen ? (
        <GearLockerView familyId={run.familyId} />
      ) : (
        <div role="region" aria-label={TAB_NAMES[tab]} data-testid={`tab-${tab}`}>
          {Screen ? <Screen {...props} /> : <AccountTab {...props} onSwitch={(t) => switchTo(t)} onStartOver={startOver} onForgot={forgot} onRerun={rerun} onBack={leaveAccount} />}
        </div>
      )}
      <ScanSheet familyId={run.familyId} />
      {tab === 'home' && !scan.lockerOpen && owner && (
        <div data-testid="owner-panel-slot" className="mt-6">{ownerPanel}</div>
      )}
 {bar && (
        <div role="status" data-testid="undo-bar" className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-[84px] z-30 mx-auto flex w-[calc(100%-32px)] max-w-[448px] items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-ink px-4 py-3 text-cream shadow-lg">
          <p className="text-[14.5px] font-semibold leading-snug">Dismissed.{bar.cents > 0 ? ` ${fmtUsdShort(bar.cents)} taken off Still to claim.` : ''}</p>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => { undo(bar.id); closeBar(); }} className="min-h-[44px] shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-paper px-4 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink">Undo</button>
        </div>
      )}
    </AppShell>
  );
}

const TAB_NAMES: Record<TabId, string> = { home: 'Home', taxes: 'Taxes', savings: 'Savings', insurance: 'Insurance', deals: 'Deals', account: 'Account' };

    expect(within(bar).queryByRole('button', { name: /Account/ })).toBeNull();

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, cleanup, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { ForgetItemsCard } from '../Extras';

afterEach(cleanup);

const open = () => fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /forget my items/i }));

describe('ForgetItemsCard', () => {
  it('does nothing until the parent confirms, and the confirm step says in plain words what is deleted', () => {
    const forget = jest.fn(async () => 2);
    render(<ForgetItemsCard familyId="maya" forget={forget} />);
    expect(screen.queryByRole('alertdialog')).toBeNull();
    open();
    const box = screen.getByRole('alertdialog');
    expect(box.textContent).toMatch(/delete/i);
    expect(box.textContent).toMatch(/cannot be undone/i);
    expect(forget).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('"Keep my items" closes the box without deleting anything', () => {
    const forget = jest.fn(async () => 2);
    render(<ForgetItemsCard familyId="maya" forget={forget} />);
    open();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /keep my items/i }));
    expect(screen.queryByRole('alertdialog')).toBeNull();
    expect(forget).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('confirming deletes for this family and says how many were removed', async () => {
    const forget = jest.fn(async () => 2);
    render(<ForgetItemsCard familyId="maya" forget={forget} />);
    open();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /yes, delete/i }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('status').textContent).toMatch(/removed 2 items/i));
    expect(forget).toHaveBeenCalledWith('maya');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('alertdialog')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('says so plainly when there was nothing saved', async () => {
    render(<ForgetItemsCard familyId="maya" forget={async () => 0} />);
    open();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /yes, delete/i }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('status').textContent).toMatch(/did not have any saved items/i));
  });

  it('shows a clear failure message, keeps the button so they can try again, and never claims success', async () => {
    const forget = jest.fn().mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('Could not remove your items. Please try again.')).mockResolvedValueOnce(1);
    render(<ForgetItemsCard familyId="maya" forget={forget} />);
    open();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /yes, delete/i }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/could not remove your items/i));
    expect(screen.queryByRole('status')).toBeNull();
    open();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /yes, delete/i }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('status').textContent).toMatch(/removed 1 item\b/i));
    expect(screen.queryByRole('alert')).toBeNull();
  });
});

import React from 'react';
import { cleanup, fireEvent, screen, within, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { mayaRun, showVersionB, goTab } from '@/__acceptance__/v2/helpers';

afterEach(() => { cleanup(); try { localStorage.clear(); sessionStorage.clear(); } catch { /* ignore */ } });

const open = (family: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => { showVersionB(mayaRun({ family })); goTab('Insurance'); };
const pillText = () => screen.getByTestId('countdown-pill').textContent;

describe('Insurance tab follows the insurance answer', () => {
  it.each([
    ['job', '30 days from birth to add baby', /10 days left/],
    ['marketplace', '60 days from birth to add baby', /By Dec 2/],
    ['tricare', '90 days to register baby in DEERS', /By Jan 1, 2027/],
  ])('%s: pill and deadline', (insurance, pill, due) => {
    open({ insurance });
    expect(pillText()).toBe(pill);
    const card = screen.getByRole('article', { name: /Add your baby to health insurance/ });
    expect(within(card).getByText(due as RegExp)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(card.textContent).toMatch(/Your answer:/);
  });
  it('Medicaid: covered for a year, a to-do, no countdown', () => {
    open({ insurance: 'medicaid', state: 'MA' });
    expect(pillText()).toBe('Baby is covered automatically for 1 year');
    const card = screen.getByRole('article', { name: /Add your baby to health insurance/ });
    expect(card.textContent).toMatch(/report the birth within 10 days/i);
    expect(within(card).queryByText(/days left/)).toBeNull();
  });
  it('no insurance / not sure: the baby may qualify for the state program', () => {
    open({ insurance: 'none_or_not_sure', state: 'MA' });
    expect(pillText()).toBe('Your baby may qualify for MassHealth');
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('card-breast-pump')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('booster-carrier')).toBeNull();
  });
});

    }
  });
});

// Lane C: every scan entry point opens the same sheet; the locker shows gear and receipts; "Forget" empties it.
import { screen, cleanup, fireEvent, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { fakeServer, callsTo, mayaRun, leoRun, showVersionB, goTab } from '@/__acceptance__/v2/helpers';
import { preparePhoto, type PhotoCodec } from '@/lib/photoPrep';

afterEach(() => { cleanup(); try { sessionStorage.clear(); localStorage.clear(); } catch { /* ignore */ } });

  recall: { found: false, source: 'NHTSA', recordsChecked: 69, checkedOn: '2026-10-25', registerUrl: 'https://www.gracobaby.com/product-registration' } };
const RECEIPT = { photoId: 2, kind: 'receipt', store: 'Made-up Baby Mart', purchasedOn: '2026-10-20', itemCount: 3, thumbnail: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,QUJD', items: [] };
const quiet = [/memory/i, () => ({ family: [], learned: [] })] as [RegExp, () => unknown];

const sheetOpen = () => screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: /What are you scanning\?/i });

  it('the Home card, the header Scan button and Home\'s empty "Money back now" button all open the same sheet', () => {
    fakeServer([quiet]);
    showVersionB(leoRun()); // Leo's run has no money-back cards: the empty bucket shows its button
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Scan gear or a receipt/i }));
    expect(sheetOpen()).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }));
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).toBeNull();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Scan$/ }));
    expect(sheetOpen()).toBeTruthy();

  });

    const card = screen.getByTestId('scan-card');
    fireEvent.click(within(card).getByRole('button', { name: /Scan gear or a receipt/i }));
    expect(sheetOpen()).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }));

    const locker = screen.getByTestId('gear-locker-card');

  });
});

describe('phone-side photo prep', () => {
  it('also makes a small thumbnail from the same photo, drawn before the full-size redraw closes it', async () => {
    const order: string[] = [];
    const codec: PhotoCodec = {
      decode: async () => ({ width: 4000, height: 3000, source: 'bmp' }),
      thumbnailJpeg: async (_s, w, h) => { order.push(`thumb ${w}x${h}`); return 'data:image/jpeg;base64,VEhVTUI='; },
      redrawAsJpeg: async (_s, w, h) => { order.push(`full ${w}x${h}`); return 'QUJD'; },
    };
    const out = await preparePhoto(new File(['x'], 'p.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' }), codec);
    expect(order).toEqual(['thumb 200x150', 'full 1600x1200']);
    expect(out).toEqual({ mimeType: 'image/jpeg', imageBase64: 'QUJD', thumbnail: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,VEhVTUI=' });
  });
  it('still works if the thumbnail cannot be made', async () => {
    const codec: PhotoCodec = {
      decode: async () => ({ width: 800, height: 600, source: 'bmp' }),
      thumbnailJpeg: async () => { throw new Error('no canvas'); },
      redrawAsJpeg: async () => 'QUJD',
    };
    expect(await preparePhoto(new File(['x'], 'p.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' }), codec)).toEqual({ mimeType: 'image/jpeg', imageBase64: 'QUJD' });
  });
});

// Lane D (Story 5) behaviour beyond the acceptance tests: practice-mode status, report card, thank-you count, card lines, ordering.
import { screen, cleanup, fireEvent, within, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { fakeServer, callsTo, mayaRun, showVersionB, goTab } from '../../../__acceptance__/v2/helpers';
import { ageLine, courtLine, guessAuditFields, minutesLine, onlyNew, orderDeals, valueLine } from '@/lib/offers';
import type { FeedCard, OfferFacts } from '@shared/bundle';

afterEach(() => { cleanup(); try { sessionStorage.clear(); localStorage.clear(); } catch { /* ignore */ } });

const facts = (over: Partial<OfferFacts> = {}): OfferFacts => ({
  court: 'approve', catches: [], subscriptionTraps: 0, hiddenFeeCents: 0, ruleCheckOnly: false, trueValueCents: 3500, minutes: 10,
  ageDays: 20, minAgeDays: 0, maxAgeDays: 365, ...over,
});
const card = (id: string, over: Partial<FeedCard> = {}): FeedCard => ({ id, kind: 'discount', title: id, body: '', amountCents: null, deadline: null, verdict: 'likely', sources: [{ label: 's', url: `https://x.test/${id}` }], traceId: '', ...over });

describe('the lines on an offer card (R5)', () => {
  it('says approved, catch and blocked in plain "Fine print" words', () => {
    expect(courtLine(facts()).text).toBe('Fine print: OK (no subscription traps, no hidden fees)');
    expect(courtLine(facts({ subscriptionTraps: 1, hiddenFeeCents: 599 })).text).toBe('Fine print: OK (1 subscription trap, $5.99 hidden fees)');
    expect(courtLine(facts({ court: 'approve_with_catch', catches: ['signs you up for a paid trial'] })).text).toBe('Fine print: OK, with a catch: signs you up for a paid trial');
    expect(courtLine(facts({ court: 'reject', catches: ['a paid membership is required'] })).text).toBe('Fine print: Blocked: a paid membership is required');
    expect(courtLine(facts({ ruleCheckOnly: true })).note).toMatch(/quick check only/i);
    expect(minutesLine(facts()).text).toBe('About 10 minutes');
    expect(valueLine(facts()).text).toBe('True value $35');
    expect(valueLine(facts({ trueValueCents: null })).text).toMatch(/not stated/);
  });

  it('says the baby\'s exact age in days', () => {
    expect(ageLine(facts())).toBe("Matches your baby's exact age (Day 20)");
    expect(ageLine(facts({ ageDays: 1, minAgeDays: -280, maxAgeDays: 182 }))).toBe("Matches your baby's exact age (Day 1)");
    expect(ageLine(facts({ ageDays: -44 }))).toBe("Matches your baby's exact age (due in 44 days)");
    expect(ageLine(facts({ ageDays: null }))).toBeNull();
  });

  it('guesses store and offer from pasted registry text', () => {
    expect(guessAuditFields('Babylist registry perk: free welcome box.\nTerms apply.')).toEqual({
      store: 'Babylist', offer: 'Babylist registry perk: free welcome box.',
    });
    expect(guessAuditFields('Target Circle baby deal')).toEqual({ store: 'Target', offer: 'Target Circle baby deal' });
    expect(guessAuditFields('Hi')).toEqual({ store: 'Pasted offer', offer: 'Pasted registry or store offer' });
  });

  it('orders by what the offer is worth to the parent (never by commission) and hides finds that are already saved', () => {
    const a = card('a', { offerFacts: facts({ trueValueCents: 900 }) });
    const b = card('b', { offerFacts: facts({ trueValueCents: 4000 }) });
    const c = card('c', { offerFacts: facts({ trueValueCents: null }) });
    expect(orderDeals([a, c, b]).map((x) => x.id)).toEqual(['b', 'a', 'c']);
    expect(onlyNew([card('a2', { sources: [{ label: 's', url: 'https://www.x.test/a/' }] }), card('n', { title: 'Brand new' })], [a]).map((x) => x.id)).toEqual(['n']);
    expect(onlyNew([card('dup', { sources: [{ label: 's', url: 'http://x.test/a?utm=1' }] })], [a])).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('Deals screen', () => {
  it('practice mode: the server says "practice" and the line stays "Checking N saved offers…" with the real count and day', async () => {
    fakeServer([[/offer-search/, () => ({ mode: 'practice' })]]);
    const run = mayaRun();

  it('a saved audit says "Added to the shared list" and thanks the parent with the real count', async () => {

    expect(await screen.findByText(/Added to the shared list/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/You’re helping other parents: 3 offers on the shared list came from parents\./)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(callsTo(server, /offers\/audit/)[0].body).toEqual({ store: 'Bitsy Box', offer: 'A free baby box', text: 'Free box. No purchase needed.' });
  });

  it('an unsaved audit says it is shown to this parent only, and a problem is said in plain words', async () => {
    fakeServer([[/offers\/audit/, () => ({ verdict: 'reject', summary: 'Hidden paid plan.', mode: 'quick', saved: false })]]);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Check this deal/i }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Blocked')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText(/Shown to you only; not added to the shared list\./)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/helping other parents/)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('the saved cards keep their claim buttons (Lane B) next to the new lines', async () => {
    fakeServer([[/offer-search/, () => ({ mode: 'practice' })]]);
    showVersionB(mayaRun());

    expect(within(diaper).getByRole('button', { name: /Not relevant/ })).toBeTruthy();

});

];

    const sent = callsTo(server, /\/api\/run$/)[0];
    expect(sent.method).toBe('POST');
    expect(sent.body).toMatchObject({ familyId: 'guest-ab12cd34', zip: '10001', birthDate: '2026-10-03', household: 'two', parent1Work: 'paycheck', parent2Work: 'paycheck', insurance: 'job' });
    await waitFor(() => expect(loc.history?.at(-1)).toBe('/feed/run-new'));
    expect(sessionStorage.getItem('bundle:tab:run-new')).toBe('account');
  });

  it('a wrong ZIP is explained and nothing is sent', () => {
    const server = fakeServer(QUIET);
    showVersionB(mayaRun({ familyId: 'guest-ab12cd34' }));
    openAccount();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit ZIP code' }));
    const editor = screen.getByTestId('editor-zip');
    fireEvent.change(within(editor).getByLabelText('ZIP code'), { target: { value: '12' } });
    fireEvent.click(within(editor).getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    expect(within(editor).getByRole('alert').textContent).toMatch(/valid 5-digit US ZIP/);
    expect(callsTo(server, /\/api\/run$/)).toHaveLength(0);
  });

    openAccount();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit Health insurance' }));

    fireEvent.click(within(editor).getByRole('button', { name: /Medicaid/ }));
    fireEvent.click(within(editor).getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(callsTo(server, /\/api\/run$/)).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(callsTo(server, /\/api\/run$/)[0].body).not.toHaveProperty('familyId');
    expect(callsTo(server, /\/api\/run$/)[0].body).toMatchObject({ zip: '02139', insurance: 'medicaid' });
    await waitFor(() => expect(localStorage.getItem('bundle_family_id')).toBe('guest-0a0a0a0a'));
  });

  it('the Insurance tab "Change" link opens the insurance answer on the Account tab', () => {
    fakeServer(QUIET);

    expect(screen.getByTestId('editor-insurance')).toBeTruthy();

  it('Forget everything deletes on the server, clears this browser, and goes to the first screen; a failure keeps everything', async () => {
    let fail = true;
    const server = fakeServer([...QUIET, [/\/api\/families\/guest-ab12cd34$/, () => { if (fail) throw new Error('boom'); return { ok: true }; }]]);
    localStorage.setItem('bundle_family_id', 'guest-ab12cd34');
    localStorage.setItem('bundle:claimed:guest-ab12cd34', '{"x":true}');
    const loc = showVersionB(mayaRun({ familyId: 'guest-ab12cd34' }));
    openAccount();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Forget everything/ }));
    const dialog = screen.getByRole('alertdialog');
    expect(dialog.textContent).toMatch(/can’t be undone/);
    fireEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Keep my data' }));
    expect(screen.queryByRole('alertdialog')).toBeNull();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Forget everything/ }));
    fireEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole('alertdialog')).getByRole('button', { name: 'Forget' }));
    expect((await within(screen.getByRole('alertdialog')).findByRole('alert')).textContent).toMatch(/boom|try again/i);
    expect(localStorage.getItem('bundle_family_id')).toBe('guest-ab12cd34'); // nothing was cleared
    fail = false;
    fireEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole('alertdialog')).getByRole('button', { name: 'Forget' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(loc.history?.at(-1)).toBe('/'));
    expect(callsTo(server, /\/api\/families\/guest-ab12cd34$/).map((c) => c.method)).toEqual(['DELETE', 'DELETE']); // the failed try, then the one that worked
    expect(localStorage.length).toBe(0);
  });
});

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, cleanup, fireEvent, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { Router } from 'wouter';
import { memoryLocation } from 'wouter/memory-location';
import VersionB from '../VersionB';
import { sampleRun } from '../../../test-support/sampleRuns';
import { fmtUsdShort } from '@/lib/bundle';

beforeAll(() => { window.scrollTo = jest.fn() as unknown as typeof window.scrollTo; });
afterEach(() => { cleanup(); try { sessionStorage.clear(); localStorage.clear(); } catch { /* ignore */ } });

function show(id: Parameters<typeof sampleRun>[0], opts: { owner?: boolean; withState?: boolean; ownerPanel?: React.ReactNode } = {}) {
  const run = sampleRun(id, { withState: opts.withState });
  const { hook } = memoryLocation({ path: `/feed/${run.runId}` });
  render(<Router hook={hook}><VersionB run={run} owner={!!opts.owner} ownerPanel={opts.ownerPanel} /></Router>);
  return run;
}
const tab = (name: string) => within(screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Main' })).getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(`^${name}`) });
const plus = () => screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Scan$/ });

describe('Version B tabs, baby is here (Maya)', () => {
  it('shows Home, Taxes, Savings, Insurance and Deals (Account opens from the family chip), starting on Home, with a "+" on every tab', () => {
    show('maya');
    const bar = screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Main' });
    expect(within(bar).getAllByRole('button').map((b) => b.textContent?.replace(/\d+$/, ''))).toEqual(['Home', 'Taxes', 'Savings', 'Insurance', 'Deals']);
    expect(tab('Home').getAttribute('aria-current')).toBe('page');
    for (const name of ['Home', 'Taxes', 'Savings', 'Insurance', 'Deals']) {
      fireEvent.click(tab(name));
      expect(tab(name).getAttribute('aria-current')).toBe('page');
      expect(plus()).toBeTruthy();
    }
  });

import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { FeedCard } from '@shared/bundle';
import FeedCardView from '@/components/FeedCardView';
import { cardState, claimableCards, homeTotals, type Stage, type TabId } from '@/lib/tabs';
import { fmtUsdShort, safeSources, type SavedRun, type TraceLine } from '@/lib/bundle';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

/** What every tab gets from the Version B container. */
export interface TabProps {
  run: SavedRun;
  stage: Stage;
  /** Cards on the run (from the real result). */
  cards: FeedCard[];
  /** Cards marked "I got this" and cards marked "Not relevant" (by card id). */
  claims: Record<string, boolean>;
  dismissed: Record<string, boolean>;
  /** "I got this", "Not relevant" and "Undo": the same three actions on every tab and on the detail page. */
  act: { claim: (id: string) => void; dismiss: (card: FeedCard) => void; undo: (id: string) => void };
  /** Link to a card's "How we checked" page. */
  href: (id: string) => string;
  go: (tab: TabId) => void;
  /** The "coming soon" sentence for a state we do not cover yet, or null. */
  stateNote: string | null;
  /** The finished run's audit lines (reviewer only; empty for a parent). */
  lines: TraceLine[];
  /** true when the reviewer code is set (the owner view). Parents never see owner-only things. */
  owner?: boolean;
}

export function CategoryHeader({ eyebrow, dot, title, sub }: { eyebrow: string; dot: string; title: string; sub: string }) {
  return (
    <section className="mt-5" data-testid="category-header">
      <p className="eyebrow flex items-center gap-1.5 text-ink-2"><span aria-hidden="true" className="inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full" style={{ background: dot }} />{eyebrow}</p>
      <h1 className="mt-1 text-[30px] font-extrabold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-0.03em]">{title}</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">{sub}</p>
    </section>
  );
}

/** "How we checked" is for cards we really checked for this family: deals (the fine print), money back and recalls. Benefits get a plain "Source" link. The owner keeps it on every card. */
export const showsHowWeChecked = (c: FeedCard, owner?: boolean): boolean => !!owner || c.kind === 'discount' || c.kind === 'clawback' || c.kind === 'recall';

/** Cards still to do, each with "I got this" and "Not relevant" when a parent can act on it. Finished and dismissed cards move to the drawers (see ClaimDrawers). */
export function CardStack({ cards, props, deadlineLabels, extras }: { cards: FeedCard[]; props: TabProps; deadlineLabels?: Record<string, string>; extras?: Record<string, ReactNode> }) {
  const ids = new Set(claimableCards(props.cards).map((c) => c.id));
  const open = cards.filter((c) => !ids.has(c.id) || cardState(c.id, props.claims, props.dismissed) === 'open');
  return (
    <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
      {open.map((c) => (
        <FeedCardView
          key={c.id}
          card={c}
          today={props.run.today}
          detailHref={showsHowWeChecked(c, props.owner) ? props.href(c.id) : undefined}
          sourceHref={!showsHowWeChecked(c, props.owner) && c.kind === 'benefit' ? safeSources(c.sources)[0]?.url : undefined}
          // An expecting family has no countdown yet: every benefit deadline counts from the birth.
          deadlineLabel={deadlineLabels?.[c.id] ?? (props.stage === 'expecting' && c.kind === 'benefit' && c.deadline ? 'Starts at birth' : undefined)}
          extra={extras?.[c.id]}
          actions={ids.has(c.id) ? { onGotIt: () => props.act.claim(c.id), onNotRelevant: () => props.act.dismiss(c) } : undefined}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** One closed drawer ("Claimed (2)" or "Dismissed (1)"). Opening it shows each card with its own Undo. */
function Drawer({ name, cards, props, note }: { name: 'Claimed' | 'Dismissed'; cards: FeedCard[]; props: TabProps; note: (c: FeedCard, cents: number) => string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const counted = new Map(homeTotals(props.run.result).parts.map((c) => [c.id, c.amountCents ?? 0]));
  const label = `${name} (${cards.length})`;
  const empty = name === 'Claimed' ? 'Cards you tap “I got this” on land here.' : 'Cards you mark “Not relevant” land here.';
  return (
    <section aria-label={label} className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-[#F4EFE8]" data-testid={`drawer-${name.toLowerCase()}`}>
      <button type="button" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)} className="flex min-h-[52px] w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 text-left text-[16px] font-extrabold text-ink">
        <span>{label}</span>
        <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.4" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" className={cn('transition-transform', open && 'rotate-180')}><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg>
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="space-y-2 px-3 pb-3">
          {cards.length === 0 && <p className="px-1 text-[14px] text-ink-2">{empty}</p>}
          {cards.map((c) => (
            <article key={c.id} aria-label={c.title} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-paper p-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-[15px] font-bold leading-snug text-ink">{c.title}</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] leading-snug text-ink-2">{note(c, counted.get(c.id) ?? 0)}</p>
              </div>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => props.act.undo(c.id)} className="min-h-[44px] shrink-0 rounded-xl border border-line bg-paper px-4 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink">Undo</button>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/** The "Claimed" and "Dismissed" drawers for the cards on one tab. Not shown on a tab with nothing a parent can act on. */
export function ClaimDrawers({ cards, props }: { cards: FeedCard[]; props: TabProps }) {
  const ids = new Set(claimableCards(props.cards).map((c) => c.id));
  const mine = cards.filter((c) => ids.has(c.id));
  if (mine.length === 0) return null;
  const claimed = mine.filter((c) => cardState(c.id, props.claims, props.dismissed) === 'claimed');
  const dismissed = mine.filter((c) => cardState(c.id, props.claims, props.dismissed) === 'dismissed');
  return (
    <div className="mt-4 space-y-2.5" data-testid="claim-drawers">
      <Drawer name="Claimed" cards={claimed} props={props} note={(_c, cents) => (cents > 0 ? `Claimed · ${fmtUsdShort(cents)} added to Claimed so far` : 'Claimed')} />
      <Drawer name="Dismissed" cards={dismissed} props={props} note={(_c, cents) => `Not relevant${cents > 0 ? ` · ${fmtUsdShort(cents)} taken off Still to claim` : ''} · told the Coach`} />
    </div>
  );
}

/** The honest "your state is coming soon" card. Federal programs still show; this is never an error. */
export function ComingSoonState({ note }: { note: string | null }) {
  if (!note) return null;
  return (
    <aside role="note" data-testid="state-coming-soon" className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-line bg-[#FDFBF8] p-4">
      <p className="eyebrow flex items-center gap-1.5 text-ink-2"><span aria-hidden="true" className="inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-ink-3" />Coming soon</p>
      <h3 className="mt-2 text-[17px] font-extrabold leading-snug tracking-[-0.01em]">Your state’s programs</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">{note}. For now we are showing the federal programs you may qualify for.</p>
    </aside>
  );
}

export function SectionTitle({ children, tone = 'plain', id }: { children: ReactNode; tone?: 'plain' | 'urgent'; id?: string }) {
  return <h2 id={id} className={cn('eyebrow mt-7', tone === 'urgent' ? 'text-coral-deep' : 'text-ink-2')}>{children}</h2>;
}

// Test helper: loads a real sample-mode run (output_examples/<family>.json, written by a real run of the server) so the
// screen tests use the real cards and totals, never hand-typed numbers.
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import type { BundleResult } from '@shared/bundle';
import type { SavedRun } from '@/lib/bundle';

const FAMILIES: Record<string, { name: string; birthDate: string | null; dueDate: string | null; state: string }> = {
  maya: { name: 'Maya (sample family)', birthDate: '2026-10-03', dueDate: null, state: 'MA' },
  leo: { name: 'Leo (sample family)', birthDate: null, dueDate: '2026-12-07', state: 'MA' },
  ava: { name: 'Ava (sample family)', birthDate: '2026-08-24', dueDate: null, state: 'OH' },
  fern: { name: 'Fern (sample family)', birthDate: '2026-10-10', dueDate: null, state: 'FL' },
};

export function sampleRun(id: keyof typeof FAMILIES, over: { withState?: boolean } = {}): SavedRun {
  const file = path.join(__dirname, '../../../output_examples', `${id}.json`);
  const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')) as BundleResult;
  const f = FAMILIES[id];
  return {
    runId: `run-${id}`, familyId: id, today: '2026-10-23', demoDate: true, result: raw,
    family: { name: f.name, birthDate: f.birthDate, dueDate: f.dueDate, ...(over.withState ? { state: f.state } : {}) },
  };
}

#### File: ./data/README.md
```
# Data notes

Plain-English summary: **every family and purchase in this project is made up.** The recalls, benefit rules
and store policies are real public facts, entered or fetched by hand and kept small on purpose.

## What is real and what is made up

| Kind | Real or made up |
|---|---|
| Families (maya, leo, ava), bank-style transactions, Amazon orders | Made up. Income figures are invented and never appear in logs. |
| Recalls (CPSC, FDA) | Real, from the government feeds below. |
| Benefit rules, FSA categories, store return/price policies, offers | Real public programmes and policies, summarised by hand with a source link each. |
| One offer ("Free newborn diaper box", Cuddle & Co) | **Made up on purpose** as a trap: it quietly turns into a paid membership. Its URL is a placeholder. |
| Saved Scout pages in `data/sample/saved-pages/` | **Hand-written short excerpts** (not copies) of public pages, with the source URL in each file and the capture date 2026-10-23. The live sites blocked automated download. |
| Zetaris replay cache in `data/sample/zetaris-cache/` | **Saved real Zetaris responses** (126 files) over the made-up family data and the real recall feeds. Captured 2026-10-23 between about 10:18 and 14:18 (US Eastern) by running the agents live. The capture times are the files' modification times (the files carry no timestamp inside). |

## Sources

| Source | Link | Licence / terms | What we used | Records | Rebuild | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CPSC recalls (US Consumer Product Safety Commission) | https://www.saferproducts.gov/RestWebServices/Recall?format=json | US government data, free to use | Recalls since 2025-06-01, read live through Zetaris table `bundle_live.cpsc_recalls` | 739 when captured (2026-10-23) | `npx tsx scripts/zetaris/register.ts` (creates the Zetaris table; needs Zetaris keys) | A recall is matched to a purchase by brand and model words, then confirmed by a second check. Titles on real receipts are messy, so a miss is possible. |
| openFDA food enforcement (infant formula) | https://api.fda.gov/food/enforcement.json | openFDA data is public domain (CC0) | First 100 results for "infant formula", through `bundle_live.fda_food_recalls` | 42 matches when captured | Same script as above | Capped at 100 results. Dates arrive as numbers and are normalised in the Recall Checker. |
| Benefit rules | Each rule links its own page (IRS, healthcare.gov, mass.gov, USDA, trumpaccounts.gov) | Public government pages, summarised by hand | 7 rules in `scripts/seed.ts` (`BENEFIT_RULES`), also `data/sample/fallback-rules.json` | 7 | `npm run seed` (needs DATABASE_URL) | Amounts and windows are as of 2026-10-23 and can change. The Fact-Checker needs a source link on every card. |
| Offers (registry gifts, rewards, trap) | The store page linked on each offer | Public marketing pages, summarised by hand | `OFFERS` in `scripts/seed.ts`, also `data/sample/fallback-offers.json` | 16 (15 real programmes, 1 planted trap) | `npm run seed` | Offer terms change often. Only one hand-checked snapshot; the Scout reads 3 saved pages as a demo of auto-refresh. |
| FSA/HSA categories | fsastore.com and IRS Publications 502/503 | Public pages, summarised by hand | 12 keyword rules (`FSA_CATEGORIES`) | 12 | `npm run seed` | Keyword matching, so unusual product names can be missed. |
| Store price-adjustment policies | Each store's help page | Public pages, summarised by hand | Target 14 days, Best Buy 15, Costco 30 | 3 | `npm run seed` | Policies change. Prices in `price_observations` are made-up saved observations. |
| Poverty guidelines 2026 | https://aspe.hhs.gov/topics/poverty-economic-mobility/poverty-guidelines | US government data | WIC screening income check | 8 household sizes | `npm run seed` | Figures were not independently re-verified. |
| ZIP prefix to state | Hand-written | n/a | MA, OH, NY, CA, TX, NH prefixes only (`server/sampleZips.ts`) | 164 prefixes | Edit the file | Other states are rejected with "Enter a valid US ZIP code". |

## Sample inputs (made up)

- `data/sample/families.json`: 3 families. `maya` (MA, baby born 2026-10-03), `leo` (MA, due 2026-12-07, no data connected), `ava` (OH, born 2026-08-24).
- `data/sample/plaid-transactions.json`: 15 bank-style transactions (Plaid's field shape).
- `data/sample/amazon-orders.csv`: 3 orders, for maya.
- Planted test cases and what a correct run does with each: see `data/sample/README.md`.

## Demo date

The sample families only make sense around 2026-10-23 (a price-adjustment window, a 30-day insurance window).
They therefore run at that **demo date** unless the `TODAY` setting overrides it, and the app labels it.
A family you type in uses the real date.

## Why a cache, and what it means for SAMPLE_MODE

Zetaris answers are saved by the exact SQL text. With `SAMPLE_MODE=true` and no Zetaris keys, the three sample
families replay these saved real responses, so a judge can run everything with no keys. A family you type in is never
saved, so it has no purchases and the Clawback and Recall agents skip their lookups; Benefits and the Fine Print Court
use only shared data (benefit rules, the offers table), whose answers are in the cache (captured for a spread of baby
ages), so it gets checked benefit and offer cards with no banner (see `output_examples/custom-family.json`). A query
that was never saved still fails safely (banner, "Not yet verified" stand-ins). With real keys the same code queries
Zetaris live. The offers table was re-seeded during the build, so the cache holds offers under two sets of ids; both are
real answers from the days they were captured.

## Re-capturing the cache

With Zetaris keys in `.env`: `npx tsx scripts/run-family.ts maya` (and `leo`, `ava`). Every live query is written to
`data/sample/zetaris-cache/`. To also cover typed-in families, run a few made-up families of different baby ages live
(the offers lookup is the same for everyone, the per-offer fact-check lookup depends on which offers fall in the age window).

#### File: ./data/sample/README.md
```
# Sample data

Everything here is **made up** (fake families, fake purchases). Only the recall
and the public rules referenced in the database are real.

- `families.json`: the three seed families. `maya` (MA, baby born 2026-10-03),
  `leo` (MA, due 2026-12-07, no data), `ava` (Ohio 43215, born 2026-08-24).
- `plaid-transactions.json`: bank-style purchases in the shape Plaid uses
  (positive amount = money out, negative = money in). Used for maya and ava.
- `amazon-orders.csv`: Amazon order history for maya only.

## Planted test cases (traps on purpose)

These exist so the agents have something real to catch. They are not mistakes.

| Where | Trap | What a correct run does |
|---|---|---|
| maya transactions | Target "Frida baby thermometer" $28.99 | flags as likely FSA/HSA-eligible |
| maya transactions | Target "Graco Pack 'n Play" $89.99, with a lower saved price | finds a price-adjustment refund inside Target's 14-day window |
| maya transactions | Carter's onesies refund (negative amount) | does not count a refund as spending |
| maya transactions | Walgreens diapers listed twice, same day and amount | counts it once |
| maya transactions | Bright Horizons monthly payments | recognizes daycare, suggests Dependent Care FSA |
| maya Amazon orders | KEAWIS Crib Mattress | matches a real CPSC recall (RecallID 10560) |
| offers table | "Free newborn diaper box" from Cuddle & Co | **trap offer**: fine print auto-enrolls you in a $29.99/month membership after 30 days; Fine Print Court must reject it |

Sources in the database were curated by hand; the Fact-Checker re-verifies them.
`Cuddle & Co` is a made-up store and its source URL is a placeholder.

```

#### File: ./data/sample/photos/README.md
```
Sample photos for the photo intake path. Only made-up images or credited public recall-notice photos go here
(never real family photos). Name a receipt image `receipt-<something>.png` so the recorder treats it as a receipt.

After adding photos, on a machine with the NVIDIA key run `npm run record-vision`; it saves the model's real answers
into `../vision-cache/`, and SAMPLE_MODE replays them. Until a photo has a saved answer, sample mode answers with the
labelled made-up answer in `../sample-photo-answers.json`.

What is here (all made up, drawn by a script on Oct 25 2026, no real people, addresses or card numbers):
- `item-graco-sample-label.png`: a made-up car-seat label (model SAMPLE-1042). Upload this in the Scan sheet.
- `receipt-made-up-baby-mart.png`: a made-up receipt (3 items, $46.47). Upload this in the Scan sheet.
- `*.browser.jpg`: the same two pictures exactly as Chrome sends them. Before upload the phone-side code redraws every
  photo as a fresh JPEG (to strip location data), so the uploaded bytes differ from the file. Recording these copies
  is what lets the upload above find its saved answer. If you change a PNG, remake its `.browser.jpg` (redraw it on a
  canvas in Chrome as `client/src/lib/photoPrep.ts` does, JPEG quality 0.85) and re-run `npm run record-vision`.
  Other browsers (Safari) may re-encode slightly differently and get the made-up fallback instead.

Added Oct 26 2026 (Lane C), drawn by `draw-example-labels.py` (Python + Pillow), all made up, clearly fictional brands:
- `item-example-car-seat-label.png`: a car-seat sticker, brand "ZOOBLEFERN" (made up), model ZF-CS100, date of manufacture
  2026/02/09, lot CS0209B.
- `item-example-stroller-label.png`: a stroller frame sticker, brand "TRUNDLEMOTH" (made up), model TM-ST200, date of
  manufacture 2026/03/14, lot 0314A.
These two are shown in the Scan sheet as "what to photograph" examples (served by `GET /api/photo/examples/car-seat` and
`/stroller`), with a "Try this example" button. Their `.browser.jpg` copies were made by redrawing the PNG on a canvas in
Chrome at JPEG quality 0.85, exactly as the app does, so the button finds the recorded answer in practice mode.

```

#### File: ./data/sample/photos/draw-example-labels.py
```
# Draws two made-up product labels (no real brands, no people) for the Bundle scan sheet examples.
import sys, random
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
OUT = sys.argv[1]
F = '/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/'
def font(name, size): return ImageFont.truetype(F + name, size)
B = lambda s: font('Arial Bold.ttf', s); R = lambda s: font('Arial.ttf', s); N = lambda s: font('Arial Narrow Bold.ttf', s)

def label(path, bg, lines, warn):
    W, H = 1200, 860
    img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), bg)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    random.seed(7)
    for _ in range(9000):  # plastic texture
        x, y = random.randrange(W), random.randrange(H); c = random.randint(-10, 10)
        d.point((x, y), fill=tuple(max(0, min(255, v + c)) for v in bg))
    sx, sy, sw, sh = 110, 90, 980, 680
    sh_img = Image.new('RGBA', (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0)); sd = ImageDraw.Draw(sh_img)
    sd.rounded_rectangle((sx + 10, sy + 14, sx + sw + 10, sy + sh + 14), 22, fill=(0, 0, 0, 90))
    img.paste(sh_img.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(10)), (0, 0), sh_img.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(10)))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    d.rounded_rectangle((sx, sy, sx + sw, sy + sh), 22, fill=(252, 252, 249), outline=(205, 205, 200), width=3)
    d.rectangle((sx, sy + 26, sx + sw, sy + 84), fill=(30, 30, 30))
    d.text((sx + sw / 2, sy + 55), 'SAMPLE IMAGE - MADE-UP LABEL FOR PRACTICE', font=B(30), fill=(255, 255, 255), anchor='mm')
    y = sy + 120
    for kind, text in lines:
        if kind == 'brand': d.text((sx + 50, y), text, font=font('Arial Black.ttf', 54), fill=(20, 20, 20)); y += 76
        elif kind == 'name': d.text((sx + 50, y), text, font=R(38), fill=(40, 40, 40)); y += 62
        elif kind == 'rule': d.line((sx + 50, y + 8, sx + sw - 50, y + 8), fill=(60, 60, 60), width=3); y += 30
        elif kind == 'field':
            k, v = text
            d.text((sx + 50, y), k, font=B(40), fill=(25, 25, 25))
            d.text((sx + 470, y), v, font=font('Arial Bold.ttf', 44), fill=(0, 0, 0)); y += 66
        elif kind == 'small': d.text((sx + 50, y), text, font=R(26), fill=(70, 70, 70)); y += 38
    d.rectangle((sx + 50, sy + sh - 92, sx + sw - 50, sy + sh - 40), outline=(200, 40, 30), width=3)
    d.text((sx + sw / 2, sy + sh - 66), warn, font=N(28), fill=(200, 40, 30), anchor='mm')
    img.save(path, optimize=True)

label(f'{OUT}/item-example-car-seat-label.png', (58, 60, 66), [
    ('brand', 'ZOOBLEFERN'), ('name', 'Made-up brand  |  Infant Car Seat'), ('rule', ''),
    ('field', ('Model No.:', 'ZF-CS100')), ('field', ('Date of Manufacture:', '2026/02/09')), ('field', ('Lot No.:', 'CS0209B')), ('rule', ''),
    ('small', 'For use with children 4-35 lb and up to 32 in. (made-up example text)'),
], 'NOT A REAL PRODUCT  -  FOR PRACTICE ONLY')
label(f'{OUT}/item-example-stroller-label.png', (112, 116, 122), [
    ('brand', 'TRUNDLEMOTH'), ('name', 'Made-up brand  |  City Stroller'), ('rule', ''),
    ('field', ('Model No.:', 'TM-ST200')), ('field', ('Date of Manufacture:', '2026/03/14')), ('field', ('Lot:', '0314A')), ('rule', ''),
    ('small', 'Maximum child weight 50 lb. (made-up example text)'),
], 'NOT A REAL PRODUCT  -  FOR PRACTICE ONLY')
print('ok')

```

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave (saved excerpt)</title>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://www.mass.gov/paid-family-and-medical-leave-pfml">
<meta name="saved-note" content="Hand-written excerpt saved 2026-10-23 for the Bundle demo. The live site blocked automated download, so this is a short paraphrase, not a copy of the page.">
</head><body>
<h1>Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML)</h1>
<p>Workers who earned wages in Massachusetts and paid into PFML can take paid leave to bond with a new child. Apply within one year of the birth.</p>
<p>The weekly benefit depends on your earnings, so there is no single dollar amount for everyone.</p>
</body></html>

```

<title>Trump Accounts: federal starter deposit (saved excerpt)</title>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://trumpaccounts.gov">
<meta name="saved-note" content="Hand-written excerpt saved 2026-10-23 for the Bundle demo. The live site blocked automated download, so this is a short paraphrase of the facts already listed in data/sample, not a copy of the page.">

<h1>Trump Accounts</h1>
<p>Children born from 2025 through 2028 who are U.S. citizens can receive a one-time $1,000 federal starter deposit into a Trump Account.</p>
<p>A parent opens the account and elects the deposit. There is no income test for the starter deposit.</p>
</body></html>

#### File: ./data/sample/vision-cache/README.md
```
Saved vision-model answers, one file per sample photo (named by the photo's fingerprint).
Written only by `npm run record-vision`; never edit by hand. First real recording: Oct 25 2026 (NVIDIA), four files
for the two sample photos in `../photos/` (each as a file and as Chrome uploads it).

```
